zh.tag: 基于 Claude Code 的 AI 求职申请框架
zh.what: 这是一个运行在你机器上的 AI 求职框架，利用 Claude Code 自动评估职位、定制简历、撰写求职信并准备面试。用户只需 Fork 仓库并填写个人资料，即可让 AI 代理完成求职流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Claude Code 工作流（/setup、/scrape、/apply、/interview），以及针对丹麦求职市场的职位搜索技能（Jobindex、Jobnet 等），但设计为可替换为本地求职网站。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Python 和 Claude Code，利用 Anthropic 的 Claude 模型进行自然语言处理。
zh.hot: 作者用该框架成功获得 AI 工程师职位，69 份申请换来 20 次面试，真实案例引发共鸣。34k+ 星标，日增 434，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第三。
uses: 求职者：自动化繁琐的申请流程，节省时间并提高效率。
开发者：学习如何构建基于 Claude Code 的 AI 代理工作流。
非丹麦用户：可修改代码以适配本地求职网站，实现定制化求职。

en.tag: AI job application framework built on Claude Code
en.what: This is an AI-powered job application framework that runs on your machine, using Claude Code to evaluate job postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, and prepare for interviews. Fork it, fill in your profile, and let the AI agent handle the job search process.
en.content: The repo contains a full Claude Code workflow (/setup, /scrape, /apply, /interview) and job portal search skills for the Danish market (Jobindex, Jobnet, etc.), but the pattern is designed to be swapped for local job boards.
en.stack: Primarily based on Python and Claude Code, leveraging Anthropic's Claude models for natural language processing.
en.hot: The author used this framework to land an AI engineer job, with 69 applications leading to 20 interviews, a real success story that resonates. With 34k+ stars and 434 daily additions, it hit #3 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Job seekers: automate tedious application processes, saving time and increasing efficiency.
Developers: learn how to build AI agent workflows on Claude Code.
Non-Danish users: modify the code to adapt to local job boards for customized job hunting.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，日志即运行时
zh.what: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，用于实际工作而非仅仅回答问题。它通过受控权限检查项目、执行工具、生成工件，并将模型消息和工具调用记录为可恢复的执行事实。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（Electron + React）、终端 TUI 和 CLI（maka, maka run）、评估工具（maka eval run），以及核心的 Runtime Host 和 Runtime Event Log 实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，桌面端基于 Electron 和 React，支持多种模型连接（云 API、本地模型或兼容网关），并包含本地工具如 Read、Write、Edit、Bash、Glob 和 Grep。
zh.hot: 今日新增 460 星，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜第 7，因其本地优先、日志即运行时的创新架构，以及 Apache 孵化项目的背书，吸引了关注 AI 代理可靠性和可恢复性的开发者。
uses: 日常 AI 辅助开发：在本地项目中安全地让代理读写文件、执行命令。
需要可审计、可恢复的 AI 代理工作流的团队，用于记录和回溯每次工具调用。
AI 代理评估：使用 maka eval 进行可复现的基准测试。
偏好本地优先、数据不出机器的隐私敏感用户。

en.tag: Local-first AI agent workspace with log-as-runtime architecture
en.what: Apache Maka is a local-first AI agent workspace built for real work. It inspects projects, executes tools, produces artifacts with controlled permissions, and preserves model messages and tool calls as recoverable execution facts.
en.content: The repo includes a desktop app (Electron + React), a terminal TUI and CLI (maka, maka run), an evaluation tool (maka eval run), and the core Runtime Host and Runtime Event Log implementation.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Electron and React for the desktop app, supporting multiple model connections (cloud API, local model, or compatible gateway), and local tools including Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, and Grep.
en.hot: With 460 stars added today and ranking #7 on the TypeScript trending list, its local-first, log-as-runtime architecture and Apache incubation status attract developers focused on AI agent reliability and recoverability.
uses: Daily AI-assisted development: let agents safely read/write files and run commands in local projects.
Teams needing auditable and recoverable AI agent workflows, with logs of every tool call.
AI agent evaluation: use maka eval for reproducible benchmark experiments.
Privacy-conscious users preferring local-first, data-stays-on-machine solutions.

zh.tag: 多智能体 LLM 金融交易框架
zh.what: TradingAgents 是一个基于多智能体 LLM 的金融交易框架，模拟真实交易公司中的角色（如研究分析师、交易员、风控经理等）协作决策。它通过多阶段工作流（研究、辩论、交易、风控）生成交易建议，并支持多种数据源和模型提供商。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、示例配置、文档和测试，以及用于数据获取和模型调用的模块。还提供 Docker 支持、环境变量配置和多种数据供应商集成（如 FRED、Polymarket）。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 LangChain、OpenAI 等 LLM 库，支持多种模型提供商（如 OpenAI、Claude、NVIDIA、Groq 等），并集成数据 API（如 Alpha Vantage、FRED）。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上获得超过 10 万星标，今日新增 218 星，位列日榜第五。其创新的多智能体协作方式和对金融交易的实际应用吸引了大量关注，且持续更新（v0.3.1 刚发布）。
uses: 量化交易研究员：利用多智能体框架模拟交易团队，辅助策略研究和回测。
AI 开发者：学习如何构建复杂的多智能体 LLM 系统，并集成多种数据源和模型。
金融科技爱好者：探索 LLM 在金融决策中的应用，进行实验和二次开发。

en.tag: Multi-agent LLM framework for financial trading
en.what: TradingAgents is a multi-agent LLM framework for financial trading that simulates roles in a real trading firm (e.g., research analysts, traders, risk managers) to collaborate on decisions. It generates trading recommendations through a multi-stage workflow (research, debate, trading, risk management) and supports various data sources and model providers.
en.content: The repo contains full framework code, example configs, documentation, and tests, along with modules for data fetching and model calls. It also offers Docker support, environment variable configuration, and integrations with multiple data vendors (e.g., FRED, Polymarket).
en.stack: Built on Python, leveraging LangChain and OpenAI libraries, supporting multiple model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, NVIDIA, Groq) and integrating data APIs (e.g., Alpha Vantage, FRED).
en.hot: With over 100k stars and 218 new stars today, ranking #5 on the daily trending list, its innovative multi-agent collaboration and practical application in financial trading have attracted huge attention, plus continuous updates (v0.3.1 just released).
uses: Quant researchers: simulate a trading team to assist strategy research and backtesting.
AI developers: learn to build complex multi-agent LLM systems with multiple data sources and models.
Fintech enthusiasts: explore LLM applications in financial decision-making for experiments and further development.

zh.tag: 用 Claude Code 打造自组织 AI 第二大脑，连接 Obsidian 知识图谱
zh.what: claude-obsidian 是一个本地优先的知识管理系统，集成 Claude Code 和 Obsidian。它自动捕获、链接和整理你的笔记，构建一个互联的知识图谱，所有内容都是纯 Markdown，完全由你掌控。它基于 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式，旨在成为 Notion 的开源替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含 15 个 Agent Skills（如捕获、检索、维护、可视化映射）、工作流文档、安装指南、以及用于构建知识循环的脚本和配置。输出是普通的 Markdown 和 JSON 文件，可在 Obsidian 中直接使用。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 Python，依赖 Claude Code 和 Agent Skills 框架，兼容 Obsidian 插件。使用内容寻址存储来保留源文件，并利用 Markdown 和 JSON 进行数据组织。
zh.hot: 凭借 11.8k 星标和日增 310 星，它抓住了 AI 笔记和个人知识管理的热潮，提供了开源、本地优先的 Notion 替代方案，并基于 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式，受到开发者社区追捧。
uses: 知识工作者：希望用 AI 自动整理笔记、构建个人知识库，同时保持数据完全本地可控。
开发者：想基于 Claude Code 和 Agent Skills 构建自定义 AI 工作流，或扩展 Obsidian 功能。
研究人员：需要从大量文献中提取、链接和引用信息，形成可追溯的知识网络。
Notion 用户：寻求开源、本地优先的替代方案，避免云锁定和隐私问题。

en.tag: Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code, turning sources into a connected knowledge graph
en.what: claude-obsidian is a local-first knowledge system that integrates Claude Code and Obsidian. It automatically captures, links, and organizes your notes into a connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown, fully owned by you. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern, it serves as an open-source alternative to Notion.
en.content: The repo includes 15 Agent Skills (capture, retrieval, maintenance, visual mapping), workflow docs, installation guides, and scripts/configs for the compounding knowledge loop. Output is plain Markdown and JSON files, usable directly in Obsidian.
en.stack: Primarily Python, built on Claude Code and Agent Skills framework, compatible with Obsidian plugins. Uses content-addressed storage for source preservation and Markdown/JSON for data organization.
en.hot: With 11.8k stars and +310 today, it taps into the AI note-taking and PKM trend, offering an open-source, local-first Notion alternative based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern, gaining rapid traction.
uses: Knowledge workers who want AI to auto-organize notes and build a personal knowledge base while keeping data fully local and controllable.
Developers looking to build custom AI workflows with Claude Code and Agent Skills, or extend Obsidian's capabilities.
Researchers needing to extract, link, and cite information from large corpora into a traceable knowledge network.
Notion users seeking an open-source, local-first alternative to avoid cloud lock-in and privacy concerns.

深度研究：利用 AI 进行深入的信息检索和分析。
开发者与 AI 爱好者：探索开源 AI 工具链和本地优先架构。

zh.tag: 100+ 个能直接跑起来的 AI Agent 和 RAG 应用合集
zh.what: 超大号 LLM 应用模板库：收录 100 多个亲手构建并端到端测试过的 AI agent、agent skill 和 RAG 应用，全部 Apache-2.0 可商用。兼容 Claude、Gemini、GPT、DeepSeek、Llama、Qwen 等主流模型，克隆下来装依赖就能跑，口号「clone, customize, ship」。
zh.content: 按难度和形态分目录：agent_skills/（npx 一键装技能）、starter_ai_agents/（单文件入门）、advanced_ai_agents/（多智能体团队）、voice_ai_agents/、always_on_agents/、RAG 教程等；每个模板配 README 和依赖清单，场景覆盖旅行规划、金融分析、播客生成、房屋装修等。
zh.stack: Python 为主，常见 Streamlit 前端 + 各家模型 SDK，部分用 CrewAI/AG2 等多智能体框架。
zh.hot: 它用大量可运行示例降低 LLM 应用试验成本，并通过 Agent Skill 模板与教程保持对实践者的持续价值。
uses: AI 入门开发者 —— 克隆单文件模板，一天跑通第一个 LLM 应用
创业团队 —— 基于成熟模板二开（旅行规划 / 金融分析 / 播客生成）快速验证 idea
企业技术选型 —— 横向对比 CrewAI / AG2 等框架的真实代码

en.tag: 100+ AI Agent & RAG apps you can actually run
en.what: A giant library of LLM app templates: 100+ hand-built, end-to-end-tested AI agents, agent skills and RAG apps, all Apache-2.0 (commercial use OK). Works with Claude, Gemini, GPT, DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen and more — clone, install deps, run. The motto: 'clone, customize, ship'.
en.content: Organized by difficulty and form: agent_skills/ (one-line npx installs), starter_ai_agents/ (single-file starters), advanced_ai_agents/ (multi-agent teams), voice_ai_agents/, always_on_agents/, RAG tutorials and more; each template ships a README and requirements, covering travel planning, financial analysis, podcast generation, home renovation…
en.stack: Mostly Python, usually a Streamlit frontend over OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic SDKs, some CrewAI/AG2 multi-agent frameworks.
en.hot: Its broad, example-led catalog lowers the cost of trying LLM applications, while agent-skill templates and tutorials keep the collection useful to practitioners.
uses: AI beginners — clone a single-file template and ship your first LLM app in a day
Startup teams — fork mature templates (travel planning, finance analysis, podcast generation) to validate ideas fast
Enterprise evaluators — compare CrewAI / AG2 and other frameworks on real code

zh.tag: 一份 CLAUDE.md，让 Claude Code 遵循 Karpathy 编码原则
zh.what: 这个仓库提供了一份基于 Andrej Karpathy 对 LLM 编码缺陷观察的 CLAUDE.md 文件，用于改进 Claude Code 的行为。它通过四个原则（先思考、简洁优先、外科手术式修改、目标驱动执行）来纠正模型常见的错误假设、过度复杂化等问题。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含一个 CLAUDE.md 文件，详细阐述了四个原则及其具体指导，并附有英文和简体中文的 README 说明。
zh.stack: 这是一个纯文档项目，无代码依赖，仅需 Claude Code 支持 CLAUDE.md 文件即可使用。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub Trending 日榜排名第 4，今日新增 588 星，总星数超过 20 万，反映出开发者对提升 AI 编码工具行为的高度关注。
uses: 使用 Claude Code 进行日常编码的开发者，希望减少 AI 的错误假设和过度设计。
团队希望统一 AI 编码助手的规范，提升代码质量和可维护性。
对 LLM 编码局限感兴趣的研究者，可参考此文件作为实践案例。

en.tag: A single CLAUDE.md to make Claude Code follow Karpathy's coding principles
en.what: This repo provides a single CLAUDE.md file derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls, aiming to improve Claude Code behavior. It addresses common issues like wrong assumptions and overcomplication through four principles: Think Before Coding, Simplicity First, Surgical Changes, and Goal-Driven Execution.
en.content: The repo mainly contains a CLAUDE.md file detailing the four principles with specific guidance, along with README in English and Simplified Chinese.
en.stack: This is a documentation-only project with no code dependencies; it only requires Claude Code to support CLAUDE.md files.
en.hot: Ranked #4 on GitHub Trending daily with +588 stars today and over 200k total stars, reflecting high interest in improving AI coding tool behavior.
uses: Developers using Claude Code daily who want to reduce AI's wrong assumptions and overengineering.
Teams looking to standardize AI coding assistant guidelines to improve code quality and maintainability.
Researchers interested in LLM coding limitations can use this file as a practical case study.

zh.tag: 终端里的轻量 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的本地运行编码代理，能在终端中直接执行代码任务。它支持与 ChatGPT 计划集成，也可通过 API 密钥使用，提供命令行交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、二进制发布包及文档，支持 npm、Homebrew 等安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 OpenAI API 或 ChatGPT 认证，支持跨平台（macOS、Linux、Windows）。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方开源项目，今日新增 2729 星，总星数突破 11 万，登顶 GitHub 日榜，开发者期待在终端中直接使用 AI 编程。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中快速执行 AI 辅助编码任务，无需离开命令行环境。
使用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 等计划的用户，可无缝集成现有订阅进行编程。
需要轻量级、可脚本化的代码生成与修改工具的技术团队。

en.tag: Lightweight AI coding agent that runs in your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. It executes coding tasks directly in the terminal, integrates with ChatGPT plans, and can also be used with an API key.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based CLI tool, installation scripts, binary release assets, and documentation, with support for npm and Homebrew installation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, it relies on OpenAI API or ChatGPT authentication, and supports cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows).
en.hot: As an official OpenAI open-source project, it gained 2,729 stars today, surpassing 110k total stars and topping the daily GitHub trending list. Developers are eager to use AI coding directly in the terminal.
uses: Developers who want to perform AI-assisted coding tasks quickly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Users with ChatGPT Plus/Pro plans who can seamlessly integrate their existing subscription for coding.
Tech teams needing a lightweight, scriptable tool for code generation and modification.

zh.tag: 开源基础模型研发框架，覆盖数据到评估全流程
zh.what: Marin 是一个开源框架，用于研究和开发基础模型，特别是大型语言模型。它涵盖了数据整理、转换、过滤、分词、预训练、后训练和评估等完整流程。Marin 强调开放开发，记录所有过程、实验和决策，包括失败的实验。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架代码、实验配置、数据处理流水线（如 Nemotron-CC 等混合数据集的确定性复现）、以及 Delphi 缩放套件（从 3e18 到 1e23 FLOPs 的缩放配方、训练套件和缩放定律）。还提供了 Hugging Face 上的检查点。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Google TPU Research Cloud 进行大规模训练，并利用 Hugging Face 发布模型检查点。
zh.hot: 今日新增 214 stars，总 stars 达 1745，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（Python）第 13 名。其开放开发理念和前沿的 MoE 模型预训练吸引关注。
uses: 研究人员和工程师，用于训练和评估大型语言模型，特别是混合专家模型。
对开放开发感兴趣的人，希望了解基础模型构建的全过程知识。
需要可复现的数据处理流水线和缩放定律的团队，用于预测更大模型的性能。

en.tag: Open-source framework for foundation model R&D, from data to evaluation
en.what: Marin is an open-source framework for researching and developing foundation models, especially large language models. It covers the entire pipeline including data curation, transformation, filtering, tokenization, pretraining, posttraining, and evaluation. Marin emphasizes open development, documenting all processes, experiments, and decisions, including failed experiments.
en.content: The repository contains core framework code, experiment configurations, data processing pipelines (e.g., deterministic reproduction of mixtures from Nemotron-CC, StarCoderData, ProofPile 2), and the Delphi scaling suite (scaling recipe from 3e18 to 1e23 FLOPs, training suite, and scaling law). Checkpoints are available on Hugging Face.
en.stack: Primarily Python, relies on Google TPU Research Cloud for large-scale training, and uses Hugging Face for releasing model checkpoints.
en.hot: Gained 214 stars today, reaching 1745 total, ranking #13 on GitHub Trending (Python). Its open development philosophy and frontier MoE pretraining attract attention.
uses: Researchers and engineers training and evaluating large language models, especially mixture-of-experts models.
Those interested in open development, seeking full process knowledge of building foundation models.
Teams needing reproducible data pipelines and scaling laws to predict larger model performance.

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理像最懒的高级工程师一样写最少代码
zh.what: Ponytail 是一个 JavaScript 库/技能包，注入到 AI 代理中，使其倾向于生成极简代码，避免过度工程。它通过内置的“懒人”提示和规则，让代理在实现功能时优先使用浏览器原生能力或现有依赖，从而大幅减少代码量、成本和延迟。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、CLI 工具、基准测试脚本和文档。核心是注入到代理的提示词和规则集，支持 20 多种代理；基准测试展示了在真实仓库上的代码量减少（平均 54%，最高 94%）。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 JavaScript，通过 npm 分发，兼容多种 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）。依赖较少，核心是提示词工程。
zh.hot: 11 万星且日增近千，因为直击 AI 编程痛点：过度工程。它用幽默的“懒人”形象，承诺减少代码量、成本和延迟，且保持安全，引发开发者共鸣。
uses: AI 编程工具使用者：希望减少 AI 生成的冗余代码，提升代码质量。
团队技术负责人：想降低维护成本，让 AI 代理产出更简洁的代码。
对提示工程感兴趣者：学习如何通过提示词约束 AI 行为。

en.tag: Makes your AI agent write minimal code like a lazy senior dev
en.what: Ponytail is a JavaScript library/skill pack that injects a 'lazy senior dev' mindset into AI agents, pushing them to write minimal code and avoid over-engineering. It uses built-in prompts and rules to make agents prefer native browser features or existing dependencies, cutting code volume, cost, and latency.
en.content: The repo contains the core library, CLI tools, benchmark scripts, and docs. The core is a set of prompts and rules injected into agents, supporting 20+ agents; benchmarks show code reduction (mean 54%, up to 94%) on real repos.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, distributed via npm, compatible with 20+ AI agents (e.g., Claude Code). Minimal dependencies, core is prompt engineering.
en.hot: 111k stars with ~1k daily, because it hits the pain point of AI coding: over-engineering. With a humorous 'lazy dev' persona, it promises less code, lower cost, and faster execution while staying safe, resonating with developers.
uses: AI coding tool users: want to reduce redundant code and improve code quality.
Tech leads: aim to lower maintenance costs and get cleaner code from AI agents.
Prompt engineering enthusiasts: learn how to constrain AI behavior via prompts.

zh.tag: Claude Code 官方插件市场，高质量插件目录
zh.what: 这是 Anthropic 官方维护的 Claude Code 插件目录，收录了内部开发的高质量插件以及经过审核的第三方插件。用户可以通过 Claude Code 的插件系统直接安装这些插件，扩展 Claude Code 的功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 /plugins 目录（Anthropic 内部插件）和 /external_plugins 目录（第三方插件），每个插件遵循标准结构，包含 plugin.json、可选命令、代理、技能和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，插件基于 Claude Code 插件系统，支持 MCP 服务器配置、斜杠命令、代理和技能定义。
zh.hot: 作为 Anthropic 官方插件市场，上线即受关注，3.4 万 star 显示开发者对 Claude Code 生态的高度热情。
uses: Claude Code 用户：发现并安装官方或社区插件，扩展编码助手功能。
插件开发者：参考内部插件示例，提交高质量第三方插件进入官方市场。
团队管理者：通过标准插件结构统一管理团队的工具链和自动化流程。

en.tag: Official Anthropic-managed marketplace for high-quality Claude Code plugins
en.what: This is the official Anthropic-managed directory of high-quality plugins for Claude Code, featuring both internally developed plugins and vetted third-party plugins. Users can install these plugins directly via Claude Code's plugin system to extend its functionality.
en.content: The repository contains /plugins (internal plugins) and /external_plugins (third-party plugins), each following a standard structure with plugin.json, optional commands, agents, skills, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily Python, plugins built on Claude Code's plugin system, supporting MCP server configs, slash commands, agents, and skill definitions.
en.hot: As the official Anthropic plugin marketplace, it gained immediate attention, with 34k stars reflecting high developer enthusiasm for the Claude Code ecosystem.
uses: Claude Code users: discover and install official or community plugins to extend the coding assistant.
Plugin developers: reference internal examples and submit high-quality third-party plugins to the official marketplace.
Team managers: standardize toolchains and automation workflows via the standard plugin structure.

zh.tag: 自建私有搜索引擎，索引浏览记录与本地文件
zh.what: Hister 是一个注重隐私的搜索引擎，可以索引你访问过的网页和本地文件的内容，支持全文搜索。它提供 Web 界面、终端界面和 MCP 接口，方便你随时找回信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web UI（基于 Svelte）、浏览器扩展（Firefox/Chrome）以及终端客户端。支持多用户、语义搜索、爬虫和浏览器历史导入。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 CGO（需要 C 编译器），Web 前端使用 npm 和 Svelte。
zh.hot: 今日新增 142 星，登上 Go 趋势榜第 4。在隐私担忧加剧的背景下，自托管搜索引擎需求上升，Hister 提供完整功能且易于部署。
uses: 注重隐私的个人用户，希望本地搜索自己的浏览历史和文件。
团队或组织，需要内部文档和网页的私有搜索解决方案。
开发者，希望集成 MCP 到 AI 助手，实现个性化信息检索。

en.tag: Self-hosted private search engine for your browsing history and local files
en.what: Hister is a privacy-focused search engine that indexes the full content of pages you visit and files you keep, enabling full-text search. It offers web, terminal, and MCP interfaces for easy information retrieval.
en.content: The repository includes a Go backend, a web UI (Svelte-based), browser extensions for Firefox/Chrome, and a terminal client. It supports multi-user, semantic search, crawler, and browser history import.
en.stack: Primarily Go, with CGO dependencies (requires C compiler), and npm/Svelte for the web frontend.
en.hot: Gained 142 stars today, ranking #4 on Go trending. Amid growing privacy concerns, self-hosted search engines are in demand, and Hister offers full features with easy deployment.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals who want to search their browsing history and files locally.
Teams or organizations needing a private search solution for internal documents and web pages.
Developers who want to integrate MCP into AI assistants for personalized information retrieval.

zh.tag: 自我进化的AI代理，跨平台陪伴成长
zh.what: Hermes Agent 是由 Nous Research 构建的自我改进型 AI 代理，具备内置学习循环：能从经验中创建技能、在使用中自我优化、主动持久化知识、搜索过往对话，并跨会话构建用户模型。它支持在低成本 VPS、GPU 集群或无服务器基础设施上运行，可通过 Telegram 等平台远程交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的代理源代码、文档、多语言 README（中文、乌尔都语、西班牙语等）、资产文件（如 banner.png）以及集成指南。提供 TUI 终端界面、消息平台网关（Telegram、Discord 等）、技能创建与改进机制、记忆管理、定时自动化等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，依赖 FTS5 进行会话搜索，集成 Honcho 进行用户建模，兼容 agentskills.io 开放标准。支持多种模型提供商（Nous Portal、OpenRouter、OpenAI 等），可通过 hermes model 命令切换。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上拥有 234,660 颗星，今日新增 443 颗，位列趋势榜第 18 名。其独特的自我改进能力和跨平台无缝体验吸引了大量关注，尤其是“与用户共同成长”的理念引发了广泛共鸣。
uses: 个人用户：希望拥有一个能记住偏好、跨设备持续对话的 AI 助手，可通过 Telegram 等随时交互。
开发者：需要可定制、可扩展的 AI 代理框架，用于自动化任务、技能开发或集成到现有工作流。
团队协作：在 Discord、Slack 等平台部署代理，实现团队知识管理和自动化操作，提升协作效率。

en.tag: Self-improving AI agent that grows with you across platforms
en.what: Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI agent built by Nous Research, featuring a built-in learning loop: it creates skills from experience, improves them during use, nudges itself to persist knowledge, searches past conversations, and builds a deepening user model across sessions. It runs on low-cost VPS, GPU clusters, or serverless infrastructure, and can be interacted with remotely via platforms like Telegram.
en.content: The repository contains the full agent source code, documentation, multilingual READMEs (Chinese, Urdu, Spanish, etc.), assets (e.g., banner.png), and integration guides. It features a TUI terminal interface, messaging platform gateways (Telegram, Discord, etc.), skill creation and improvement mechanisms, memory management, and scheduled automations.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, it uses FTS5 for session search, integrates Honcho for user modeling, and is compatible with the agentskills.io open standard. It supports multiple model providers (Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI, etc.) and can switch via the 'hermes model' command.
en.hot: With 234,660 stars and 443 new stars today, ranking 18th on the GitHub Trending daily list, the repo's unique self-improvement capabilities and seamless cross-platform experience have attracted significant attention, especially the concept of 'growing with the user' resonating widely.
uses: Individual users: want an AI assistant that remembers preferences and maintains continuous conversations across devices, accessible via Telegram and more.
Developers: need a customizable, extensible AI agent framework for automating tasks, developing skills, or integrating into existing workflows.
Team collaboration: deploy agents on platforms like Discord and Slack for team knowledge management and automated operations, enhancing productivity.

zh.tag: 把技术书 PDF 变成 Claude Code 技能，按需加载、即问即答
zh.what: book-to-skill 能将任何技术书籍、文档文件夹或资料集合转化为统一的代理技能（Agent Skill），供 GitHub Copilot CLI、Amp 或 Claude Code 等工具使用。它提取书中的框架、决策规则和反模式，生成按章节组织的文件，使代理能按需加载相关章节并基于真实内容回答，避免幻觉。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 命令行工具、文档（安装、使用、FAQ、性能、架构）以及示例技能输出。核心功能是三步流程：指定文件/文件夹/glob，提炼为技能，代理按需加载。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，支持 PDF、EPUB、DOCX、MD、HTML、RTF、MOBI 等格式。依赖包括文档解析库和与 Claude Code 等代理的集成接口。
zh.hot: 本周新增 3903 stars，总星数达 17689，登上 GitHub 周榜第 5。它解决了 AI 代理使用技术书籍时的上下文爆炸问题，声称比直接导入书籍节省 24×–51× 的 token，并保证基于真实内容回答，因此受到开发者追捧。
uses: 开发者：将技术书籍转化为可交互的代理技能，边写代码边查阅
学习爱好者：把 PDF 书籍变成按需问答的私人导师
团队：将内部文档或规范转化为统一技能，供 AI 助手使用
AI 工具用户：在 Claude Code、Copilot CLI 等环境中增强代理能力

en.tag: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — on-demand, no hallucination
en.what: book-to-skill converts any technical book, document folder, or collection of sources into a unified agent skill for use with GitHub Copilot CLI, Amp, or Claude Code. It extracts frameworks, decision rules, and anti-patterns, generating per-chapter files so the agent can load relevant chapters on demand and answer from real content, avoiding hallucinations.
en.content: The repo includes a Python CLI tool, documentation (install, usage, FAQ, performance, architecture), and example skill outputs. Core is a 3-step flow: point to a file/folder/glob, distill into a skill, agent loads on demand.
en.stack: Primarily Python, supporting PDF, EPUB, DOCX, MD, HTML, RTF, MOBI formats. Dependencies include document parsing libraries and integration interfaces with agents like Claude Code.
en.hot: Gained 3,903 stars this week, reaching 17,689 total and #5 on GitHub weekly trending. It solves the context explosion problem when using technical books with AI agents, claiming 24×–51× fewer tokens than dumping the book, and ensures answers from real content, driving its popularity.
uses: Developers: turn technical books into interactive agent skills for on-the-fly reference while coding
Learners: convert PDF books into on-demand Q&A personal tutors
Teams: transform internal docs or standards into unified skills for AI assistants
AI tool users: enhance agent capabilities in Claude Code, Copilot CLI, etc.

zh.tag: 免费聚合多款 AI 编码代理，每月 13 亿+免费 token
zh.what: 这是一个开源项目，让你免费使用 Claude Code、Codex、Pi、OpenCode 等 9 种编码代理，并接入 49 个合规的模型提供商，每月提供超过 13 亿免费 token。它提供一个统一的搜索界面，支持终端、桌面、IDE 或手机访问，还支持语音和故障转移。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包、CLI 工具、配置文件和文档，支持多种客户端接入，提供模型目录、故障转移和优化功能，如 RTK 过滤和 token 节省。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.14，使用 uv 管理依赖，采用 Pytest 测试、Ruff 格式化、Loguru 日志，并集成多个 AI 代理和提供商 API。
zh.hot: 凭借免费使用高级编码代理和巨额 token 的吸引力，star 数已达 4.7 万，今日新增 1040，登上 GitHub 日榜第 8 名。
uses: 开发者希望免费使用 Claude Code 等高级编码代理，降低 AI 编程成本。
需要跨多个模型提供商进行故障转移，确保编码任务不中断的团队。
在终端、IDE 或手机上灵活使用 AI 编码助手的个人用户。

en.tag: Free multi-agent coding hub with 1.3B+ monthly tokens
en.what: This open-source project lets you use 9 coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and OpenCode for free, with access to 49 ToS-friendly providers offering 1.3B+ free tokens monthly. It provides a unified searchable UI, works from terminal, desktop, IDE, or phone, and supports voice and automatic failover.
en.content: The repo includes a Python package, CLI tool, configuration files, and docs, supporting multiple clients, with a model catalog, failover, and optimizations like RTK filtering and token savings.

en.hot: With the appeal of free access to premium coding agents and huge token allowances, it has 47k stars, +1040 today, ranking #8 on GitHub daily trending.
uses: Developers who want to use premium coding agents like Claude Code for free, reducing AI coding costs.
Teams needing failover across multiple model providers to ensure uninterrupted coding tasks.
Individuals who prefer flexible AI coding assistance from terminal, IDE, or phone.

zh.tag: 自托管A股量化工作台：选股+监控+回测
zh.what: 这是一个面向个人散户和量化爱好者的自托管、零运维的A股量化工作台，集选股、监控、回测于一体。它基于TickFlow数据源，利用LLM能力实现策略定制、个股分析和复盘，并支持自由接入第三方数据源。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的量化工作台代码，涵盖选股引擎、指标流水线、回测研究、因子挖掘、市场环境分析、异动监控、监控中心、个股分析、连板梯队等模块，并提供Docker部署和详细文档。
zh.stack: 后端基于Python 3.11+，使用Polars进行高性能数据处理；前端使用React 18；数据源为TickFlow，支持插件化扩展；部署支持Docker。
zh.hot: 该项目在GitHub Trending日榜（Python）排名第17，今日新增82星，总星数达3509。其亮点在于结合LLM能力提供AI驱动的策略定制和个股分析，且完全自托管、零运维，吸引了大量个人量化爱好者。
uses: 个人散户：希望用开源工具进行A股量化选股和回测，无需自己搭建复杂基础设施。
量化爱好者：需要灵活的策略定制和因子挖掘，且希望数据源可插拔。
开发者：想学习或扩展一个完整的量化工作台，包括前端React和后端Python。

en.tag: Self-hosted A-share quant workbench: screening, monitoring, backtesting
en.what: A self-hosted, zero-maintenance quantitative workbench for A-shares, targeting individual investors and quant enthusiasts. It integrates stock screening, monitoring, and backtesting, powered by TickFlow data, with LLM capabilities for strategy customization, stock analysis, and review, and supports pluggable third-party data sources.
en.content: The repo contains a full quant workbench codebase, including modules for stock screening, indicator pipeline, backtesting, factor mining, market environment analysis, anomaly monitoring, monitoring center, stock analysis, and limit-up ladder, with Docker deployment and detailed docs.
en.stack: Backend in Python 3.11+, using Polars for high-performance data processing; frontend in React 18; data source is TickFlow with plugin support; deployment via Docker.
en.hot: Ranked #17 on GitHub Trending (Python) with 82 stars today and 3509 total. Its appeal lies in LLM-powered strategy customization and stock analysis, plus full self-hosting with zero maintenance, attracting many individual quant enthusiasts.
uses: Individual investors: seeking an open-source tool for A-share quant screening and backtesting without complex infrastructure.
Quant enthusiasts: needing flexible strategy customization and factor mining with pluggable data sources.
Developers: interested in learning or extending a full quant workbench with React frontend and Python backend.

zh.tag: 实时语音与多模态 AI 代理的开源 Python 框架
zh.what: Pipecat 是一个开源 Python 框架，用于构建实时语音和多模态对话代理。它支持构建单个语音代理或完整的多代理系统，其中专业代理可以交接、并行分发，并通过共享总线进行协调，支持本地或跨进程/机器分布式部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架、客户端 SDK（JavaScript、React、React Native、Swift、Kotlin、C++）、示例应用和文档。提供可插拔的 AI 服务集成、可组合的管道、多代理编排和实时传输（WebSockets、WebRTC）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖多种 AI 服务（如语音识别、文本转语音）和实时传输协议。支持与主流 AI 提供商集成，并可通过 pip 安装。
zh.hot: 随着实时 AI 代理需求激增，Pipecat 凭借其开源、多代理支持和低延迟特性吸引了大量开发者。近期每日新增 73 星，总星数达 14720，跻身 GitHub Python 趋势榜第 13 名。
uses: 开发者构建语音助手、AI 伴侣或客户支持机器人等实时对话应用
团队需要多代理协作系统，如专家交接、并行处理或分布式部署
研究人员或爱好者探索多模态交互（语音、视频、图像）和生成式媒体

en.tag: Open-source Python framework for real-time voice & multimodal AI agents
en.what: Pipecat is an open-source Python framework for building real-time voice and multimodal conversational agents. It enables building a single voice agent or a full multi-agent system where specialists hand off, fan out in parallel, and coordinate over a shared bus, locally or distributed across processes and machines.
en.content: The repository contains the core framework, client SDKs (JavaScript, React, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, C++), example apps, and documentation. It offers pluggable AI service integrations, composable pipelines, multi-agent orchestration, and real-time transports (WebSockets, WebRTC).
en.stack: Primarily Python, integrating various AI services (e.g., speech recognition, text-to-speech) and real-time transport protocols. Supports integration with major AI providers and is installable via pip.
en.hot: With the surge in real-time AI agent demand, Pipecat attracts developers due to its open-source nature, multi-agent support, and low latency. Gaining 73 stars daily, it reached 14,720 total stars, ranking 13th on GitHub's Python trending list.
uses: Developers building real-time conversational apps like voice assistants, AI companions, or customer support bots
Teams needing multi-agent collaboration systems with handoff, parallel processing, or distributed deployment
Researchers or enthusiasts exploring multimodal interactions (voice, video, images) and generative media

zh.tag: NVIDIA 官方大规模 Transformer 训练库
zh.what: Megatron-LM 是 NVIDIA 开源的深度学习框架，用于高效训练大规模 Transformer 模型。它包含 Megatron-LM 参考实现和 Megatron Core 可组合库，支持多种并行策略和混合精度训练。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Megatron-LM 参考示例（含预配置训练脚本）和 Megatron Core 库（提供 Transformer 构建模块、并行策略、混合精度支持等）。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 和 PyTorch，依赖 CUDA 和 NVIDIA GPU，支持 FP16/BF16/FP8/FP4 混合精度。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA 官方库，是训练 GPT 等大模型的关键工具，近期新增 DeepSeek-V4 支持，持续吸引研究者关注。
uses: 研究团队：快速搭建和训练大规模 Transformer 模型，进行分布式训练实验。
机器学习工程师：利用 Megatron Core 构建自定义训练框架，优化 GPU 资源利用。
框架开发者：集成先进并行策略和混合精度支持，提升模型训练效率。

en.tag: NVIDIA's official GPU-optimized library for large-scale Transformer training
en.what: Megatron-LM is NVIDIA's open-source deep learning framework for efficiently training large-scale Transformer models. It includes the Megatron-LM reference implementation and the Megatron Core composable library, supporting various parallelism strategies and mixed-precision training.
en.content: The repository contains the Megatron-LM reference example (with pre-configured training scripts) and the Megatron Core library (providing Transformer building blocks, parallelism strategies, mixed-precision support, etc.).
en.stack: Built on Python and PyTorch, relies on CUDA and NVIDIA GPUs, supports FP16/BF16/FP8/FP4 mixed precision.
en.hot: As NVIDIA's official library, it's a key tool for training large models like GPT, with recent DeepSeek-V4 support, continuously attracting researchers.
uses: Research teams: quickly build and train large-scale Transformer models for distributed training experiments.
ML engineers: use Megatron Core to build custom training frameworks and optimize GPU utilization.
Framework developers: integrate advanced parallelism and mixed-precision support to improve training efficiency.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 记忆系统，零 API 调用
zh.what: MemPalace 是一个开源 AI 记忆系统，以原文形式存储对话历史，并通过语义搜索检索。它不进行摘要或改写，而是将内容组织为结构化的“宫殿”概念（翼、房间、抽屉），支持可插拔的检索后端。所有数据默认保留在本地，除非用户选择上传。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包（mempalace）、CLI 工具、文档（docs/）以及资产（assets/）。核心代码包括后端接口（mempalace/backends/base.py）和默认的 ChromaDB 实现。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 ChromaDB、numpy、grpcio 等。推荐使用 uv 或 pipx 安装 CLI，以隔离环境避免依赖冲突。
zh.hot: 凭借 96.6% R@5 的 LongMemEval 基准成绩和零 API 调用的本地优先特性，迅速获得 58k+ star，成为 AI 记忆领域的热门选择。
uses: 开发者希望为 AI 助手或应用添加持久记忆，同时保持数据隐私和低成本。
Claude Code 用户需要长期会话保留，避免 30 天过期问题。
对 AI 记忆架构感兴趣的研究者，可参考其可插拔后端设计。

en.tag: Local-first AI memory with verbatim storage and pluggable backends
en.what: MemPalace is an open-source AI memory system that stores conversation history verbatim and retrieves it via semantic search. It avoids summarization or paraphrasing, organizing content into a structured 'palace' metaphor (wings, rooms, drawers), with a pluggable retrieval backend. Data stays local unless you opt in.
en.content: The repo contains the Python package (mempalace), a CLI tool, docs (docs/), and assets (assets/). Core code includes the backend interface (mempalace/backends/base.py) and the default ChromaDB implementation.
en.stack: Built on Python with dependencies like ChromaDB, numpy, and grpcio. The CLI is recommended to be installed via uv or pipx in an isolated environment to avoid dependency conflicts.
en.hot: With a 96.6% R@5 score on LongMemEval and a local-first approach with zero API calls, it quickly gained 58k+ stars, becoming a popular choice in AI memory.
uses: Developers seeking persistent memory for AI assistants or apps while maintaining data privacy and low cost.
Claude Code users needing long-term session retention to avoid 30-day expiration issues.
Researchers interested in AI memory architectures can reference its pluggable backend design.

zh.tag: 开箱即用的智能体框架，支持子代理、文件系统、持久记忆等
zh.what: Deep Agents 是一个开箱即用的智能体框架，基于 LangGraph 构建，提供丰富的内置功能，如子代理、文件系统访问、上下文管理、Shell 执行、持久记忆、人工介入、技能和工具集成。它支持任何支持工具调用的 LLM，并可通过 LangSmith 进行追踪、评估和部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 库（可通过 uv add deepagents 安装），提供 create_deep_agent 等 API，以及文档、示例和 CLI 工具（如 Deep Agents Code）。
zh.stack: 基于 LangGraph，支持多种 LLM（如 OpenAI、本地模型），集成 LangSmith 用于追踪和评估，提供 Python 和 JavaScript/TypeScript 版本。
zh.hot: 作为 LangChain 官方推出的智能体框架，它提供了开箱即用的完整功能，吸引了大量开发者。Star 数已达 28k，今日新增 175，位列 Python 趋势榜第 12 名。
uses: 开发者快速构建生产级 AI 代理，无需从零搭建基础设施
需要子代理、文件操作、Shell 执行等复杂任务的自动化场景
希望结合 LangSmith 进行追踪、评估和部署的团队

en.tag: Batteries-included agent harness with sub-agents, filesystem, memory, and more
en.what: Deep Agents is an out-of-the-box agent harness built on LangGraph, offering rich built-in features like sub-agents, filesystem access, context management, shell execution, persistent memory, human-in-the-loop, skills, and tool integration. It works with any LLM that supports tool calling and provides tracing, evaluation, and deployment via LangSmith.
en.content: The repository contains a Python library (installable via uv add deepagents) with APIs like create_deep_agent, along with documentation, examples, and a CLI tool (Deep Agents Code).
en.stack: Built on LangGraph, supports various LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, local models), integrates LangSmith for tracing and evaluation, and offers Python and JavaScript/TypeScript versions.
en.hot: As an official LangChain agent framework, it offers a complete out-of-the-box experience, attracting many developers. With 28k stars and 175 added today, it ranks #12 on the Python trending list.
uses: Developers quickly building production-grade AI agents without starting from scratch
Automation scenarios requiring sub-agents, file operations, shell execution, etc.
Teams wanting to integrate tracing, evaluation, and deployment with LangSmith

zh.tag: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的企业 AI 生产力操作系统
zh.what: Cloudflare OS 是一个为 AI 生产力设计的“操作系统”，最初在 Cloudflare 内部使用，帮助员工（从工程到销售）完成日常工作。它提供代理聊天界面、沙盒应用开发和名为 Gatekeepers 的安全框架，让非技术用户也能安全地使用 AI 和构建应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Cloudflare OS v2 代码，包括代理聊天界面、小应用（gadgets）开发环境、Gatekeepers 安全框架，以及用于本地运行和部署的配置。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，运行在 Cloudflare Workers 和 workerd 上，使用 pnpm 管理依赖，支持本地运行和部署到 Cloudflare 账户。
zh.hot: 作为 Cloudflare 内部使用的 AI 生产力工具开源，提供企业级安全框架和沙盒应用开发，吸引了大量开发者关注，今日新增 94 星，总星数达 9196。
uses: 企业团队希望安全地让员工使用 AI 代理完成文档、演示文稿等任务
开发者希望基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建自定义 AI 工作区和内部工具
技术负责人需要为 AI 应用和代理提供安全护栏和治理框架

en.tag: An AI productivity OS on Cloudflare Workers for enterprise agents and apps
en.what: Cloudflare OS is an 'operating system' for AI productivity, originally used inside Cloudflare to help employees across roles do their jobs. It provides an agent chat UI, sandboxed app development, and a security framework called Gatekeepers, enabling non-technical users to safely leverage AI and build apps.
en.content: The repo contains the full Cloudflare OS v2 codebase, including the agent chat UI, gadget development environment, Gatekeepers security framework, and configuration for local running and deployment.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, runs on Cloudflare Workers and workerd, uses pnpm for dependencies, supports local run and deployment to Cloudflare accounts.
en.hot: Open-sourcing an internal AI productivity tool with enterprise-grade security and sandboxed app development has attracted many developers, gaining 94 stars today and reaching 9196 total.
uses: Enterprise teams wanting to safely let employees use AI agents for documents, slides, and more
Developers looking to build custom AI workspaces and internal tools on Cloudflare Workers
Tech leaders needing security guardrails and governance for AI apps and agents

zh.tag: 聚合34家免费LLM提供商的统一API网关
zh.what: FreeLLMAPI 是一个开源项目，将数十家免费 LLM 提供商的免费额度聚合到一个 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 端点后面。它提供智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥管理，让开发者无需管理多个 API 密钥即可访问大量免费模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 TypeScript 编写的 API 网关，支持 Docker 自托管、桌面应用（macOS/Windows）和 Android 应用。它提供了一个仪表板，用于监控每月 token 预算，并包含一个自动更新的模型目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，支持 Docker 部署，并提供桌面和移动端应用。依赖 OpenAI 兼容 API 标准，集成多个 LLM 提供商。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得近 2 万星标，日增 174 星。它解决了开发者对免费 LLM 资源分散、难以管理的痛点，提供了一站式解决方案。
uses: 个人开发者：快速集成多个免费 LLM，无需单独注册和付费。
原型开发：在项目初期使用免费模型验证想法，降低开发成本。
学习与研究：探索不同 LLM 的能力，进行对比实验。
自动化工具：为聊天机器人、内容生成等应用提供统一 API 接口。

en.tag: Unified API gateway aggregating 34 free LLM providers
en.what: FreeLLMAPI is an open-source project that aggregates free tiers from dozens of LLM providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. It offers smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key management, allowing developers to access a vast array of free models without managing multiple API keys.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based API gateway with Docker self-hosting, desktop apps for macOS/Windows, and an Android app. It includes a dashboard for monitoring monthly token budgets and an auto-updating model catalog.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Docker deployment and desktop/mobile apps. Relies on OpenAI-compatible API standards and integrates multiple LLM providers.
en.hot: The project has gained nearly 20k stars with 174 new stars today, addressing the pain point of scattered free LLM resources by offering a one-stop solution.
uses: Individual developers: Quickly integrate multiple free LLMs without separate registrations and payments.
Prototyping: Validate ideas with free models in early stages, reducing development costs.
Learning and research: Explore capabilities of different LLMs and run comparative experiments.
Automation tools: Provide a unified API for chatbots, content generation, and more.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理提供 33 项技能的插件，让每次工程变更都更轻松。
zh.what: Compound Engineering 是一个为 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex）设计的插件，包含 33 项技能。它围绕一个循环组织工作：头脑风暴、规划、构建、审查，然后记录所学，以便知识在下次变更时可用。
zh.content: 仓库包含插件源码、文档（docs/）和技能定义（skills），支持通过市场安装到多个代理宿主。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖各代理的插件市场机制，如 Claude Code 的 /plugin 命令和 Cursor 的 /add-plugin。
zh.hot: 24.5k 星且登上 TypeScript 趋势榜，因为它解决了 AI 编码代理知识不共享的痛点，跨 14 个宿主通用。
uses: 使用 Claude Code 的开发者，希望通过插件市场快速安装并提升编码效率。
在 Cursor 或 Codex 中工作的团队，需要统一的工作流程和知识沉淀。
对 AI 代理技能感兴趣的研究者，可参考其技能定义和循环设计。

en.tag: A plugin of 33 skills for AI coding agents, making each engineering change easier.
en.what: Compound Engineering is a plugin for AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) with 33 skills. It structures work around a loop: brainstorm, plan, build, review, then capture what you learned, so knowledge is available for the next change.
en.content: The repo contains plugin source, docs, and skill definitions, installable via marketplaces on multiple agent hosts.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, leveraging each agent's plugin marketplace (e.g., /plugin for Claude Code, /add-plugin for Cursor).
en.hot: With 24.5k stars and trending in TypeScript, it addresses the pain point of knowledge sharing in AI coding agents, working across 14 hosts.
uses: Developers using Claude Code who want to install via plugin marketplace and boost coding efficiency.
Teams working in Cursor or Codex needing a unified workflow and knowledge capture.
Researchers interested in AI agent skills, can reference its skill definitions and loop design.

zh.tag: 开源项目管理平台，Jira/Linear 替代品
zh.what: Plane 是一个开源的项目管理平台，旨在替代 Jira、Linear、Monday 和 ClickUp。它帮助团队管理任务、迭代（Cycles）、文档和问题分类（Triage），提供现代化的用户体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的项目管理系统源码，包括前端（TypeScript/React）、后端（Python/Django）以及部署配置（Docker、Kubernetes）。提供丰富的功能：工作项、周期、模块、视图等。
zh.stack: 前端使用 TypeScript 和 React，后端使用 Python 和 Django，数据库采用 PostgreSQL，支持 Docker 和 Kubernetes 部署。
zh.hot: Plane 在 GitHub 上拥有 56k+ stars，今日新增 98 个，位列 Trending 日榜第 15。其开源替代商业项目管理工具的理念吸引了大量开发者，且功能丰富、部署灵活。
uses: 团队项目管理：适合需要任务跟踪、迭代管理和文档协作的团队。
自托管需求：对数据隐私和基础设施有控制要求的企业或组织。
开发者社区：对开源项目管理工具感兴趣，希望参与贡献或定制的开发者。

en.tag: Open-source project management platform, Jira/Linear alternative
en.what: Plane is an open-source project management platform designed as an alternative to Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp. It helps teams manage tasks, cycles, docs, and triage with a modern user experience.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the project management system, including frontend (TypeScript/React), backend (Python/Django), and deployment configurations (Docker, Kubernetes). It offers rich features: work items, cycles, modules, views, etc.
en.stack: Frontend uses TypeScript and React, backend uses Python and Django, database is PostgreSQL, supports Docker and Kubernetes deployment.
en.hot: Plane has 56k+ stars on GitHub, with 98 new stars today, ranking 15th on the daily trending list. Its open-source alternative to commercial project management tools attracts many developers, with rich features and flexible deployment.
uses: Team project management: suitable for teams needing task tracking, cycle management, and document collaboration.
Self-hosting needs: enterprises or organizations requiring control over data and infrastructure.
Developer community: developers interested in open-source project management tools, wanting to contribute or customize.

zh.tag: 自托管 AI 伴侣，复刻 Neuro-sama，支持实时语音与游戏
zh.what: AIRI 是一个自托管的 AI 伴侣项目，旨在复刻虚拟主播 Neuro-sama 的交互体验。它支持实时语音聊天、Minecraft 和 Factorio 等游戏互动，让用户拥有属于自己的 AI 虚拟角色。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端（Web/macOS/Windows）、服务端代码、文档和 Discord/Telegram 等社区链接。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 和现代 Web 技术栈，支持跨平台部署。
zh.hot: 4.4 万 Star 且日增 572，因其复刻热门虚拟主播 Neuro-sama 的独特概念，结合自托管与游戏互动功能，吸引了大量 AI 和二次元爱好者。
uses: AI 爱好者 —— 自托管专属 AI 伴侣，体验实时语音互动
二次元/虚拟主播粉丝 —— 复刻 Neuro-sama，打造个性化虚拟角色
游戏玩家 —— 在 Minecraft/Factorio 中与 AI 伴侣一起游玩
开发者 —— 学习或贡献 TypeScript 全栈 AI 应用

en.tag: Self-hosted AI companion, recreating Neuro-sama, with real-time voice and game support
en.what: AIRI is a self-hosted AI companion project that recreates the interactive experience of virtual streamer Neuro-sama. It supports real-time voice chat and game interactions like Minecraft and Factorio, giving users their own AI virtual character.
en.content: The repo includes full client (Web/macOS/Windows) and server code, documentation, and community links like Discord/Telegram.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, relies on Node.js and modern web tech stack, supports cross-platform deployment.
en.hot: 44k stars with 572 daily, driven by the unique concept of recreating popular virtual streamer Neuro-sama, combined with self-hosting and game interaction, attracting AI and anime fans.
uses: AI enthusiasts — self-host a personal AI companion with real-time voice
Anime/vTuber fans — recreate Neuro-sama and customize virtual characters
Gamers — play Minecraft/Factorio with an AI companion
Developers — learn or contribute to a full-stack TypeScript AI app

zh.tag: 开源 WhatsApp 与多渠道消息 REST API
zh.what: Evolution API 是一个生产就绪的开源 REST API，用于 WhatsApp 和多渠道消息集成。它支持基于 Baileys 的 WhatsApp Web API 和官方 WhatsApp Cloud API，并提供与 Typebot、Chatwoot、Dify、OpenAI、RabbitMQ、Apache Kafka 等系统的集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 API 源码、Docker 镜像、文档和社区资源。支持多种连接类型，并作为 Evolution Foundation 生态的一部分，被 Evo CRM 等项目用作 WhatsApp 提供方。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，基于 Baileys 库，支持 Docker 部署，并集成 RabbitMQ、Kafka、SQS、Socket.io、S3/MinIO 等。
zh.hot: 凭借 9415 颗星和稳定增长，它成为 WhatsApp 集成领域的热门选择，今日新增 11 星并登上 TypeScript 日榜第 7 名。其开源特性和多渠道支持吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者构建 WhatsApp 机器人或集成消息功能到业务系统
企业需要多渠道消息平台，如 CRM、客服系统或自动化流程
希望使用官方 Cloud API 或非官方 Web API 的灵活方案

en.tag: Open-source REST API for WhatsApp and multi-channel messaging
en.what: Evolution API is a production-ready open-source REST API for WhatsApp and multi-channel messaging. It supports both the Baileys-based WhatsApp Web API and the official WhatsApp Cloud API, with integrations for Typebot, Chatwoot, Dify, OpenAI, RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full API source code, Docker images, documentation, and community resources. It supports multiple connection types and is part of the Evolution Foundation ecosystem, used as a WhatsApp provider by projects like Evo CRM.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, built on the Baileys library, with Docker deployment support and integrations for RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, Socket.io, S3/MinIO, etc.
en.hot: With 9,415 stars and steady growth, it's a popular choice for WhatsApp integration, gaining 11 stars today and ranking #7 on the TypeScript daily trending list. Its open-source nature and multi-channel support attract many developers.
uses: Developers building WhatsApp bots or integrating messaging into business systems
Enterprises needing a multi-channel messaging platform for CRM, customer support, or automation
Those seeking flexibility between official Cloud API and unofficial Web API

zh.tag: 现代 TypeScript 框架，构建 AI 应用与智能体
zh.what: Mastra 是一个用于构建 AI 驱动应用和智能体的 TypeScript 框架，提供从原型到生产所需的一切。它支持模型路由、智能体、工作流、人机协同和上下文管理等功能，可集成 React、Next.js、Node 等前端后端框架，也可独立部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架代码、文档、示例和集成，提供 agents、workflows、model routing、memory 等模块，以及 CLI 工具和开发服务器。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，依赖 Node.js 环境，支持多种 LLM 提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等），可与 React、Next.js 等前端框架集成。
zh.hot: 凭借 2.7 万+ stars 和日增 30 星的热度，Mastra 成为 TypeScript AI 开发者的热门选择，其全面的功能和易用性吸引了大量关注。
uses: 适合使用 TypeScript 构建 AI 应用或智能体的开发者，希望快速从原型到生产。
需要集成多种 LLM 提供商或构建复杂工作流与多步骤任务的团队。
希望在前端框架（如 React/Next.js）中嵌入 AI 功能，或独立部署 AI 服务的开发者。

en.tag: Modern TypeScript framework for building AI apps and agents
en.what: Mastra is a TypeScript framework for building AI-powered applications and agents, providing everything from prototype to production. It supports model routing, agents, workflows, human-in-the-loop, and context management, and integrates with frontend/backend frameworks like React, Next.js, and Node, or can be deployed standalone.
en.content: The repository contains core framework code, documentation, examples, and integrations, offering modules for agents, workflows, model routing, memory, plus CLI tools and a dev server.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript, requires Node.js, supports multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.), and integrates with frontend frameworks like React and Next.js.
en.hot: With 27k+ stars and 30 new stars daily, Mastra is a hot choice for TypeScript AI developers, attracting attention for its comprehensive features and ease of use.
uses: Developers building AI apps or agents in TypeScript, wanting to go from prototype to production quickly.
Teams needing to integrate multiple LLM providers or build complex workflows and multi-step tasks.
Developers who want to embed AI features in frontend frameworks like React/Next.js or deploy AI services standalone.

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理安全花你的钱，一次性支付凭证
zh.what: Link CLI 是 Stripe 推出的命令行工具，让 AI 代理能从 Link 钱包获取一次性支付凭证（虚拟卡或共享支付令牌）代为购物，而无需暴露真实卡号。每次购买都需你批准，确保安全可控。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 CLI 工具，支持登录、支付方式管理、地址管理、创建支付请求等命令，并提供 LLM 友好的输出格式（toon、json 等）。还支持作为 MCP 服务器运行，便于集成到 AI 代理环境中。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，通过 npm 分发，支持 npx 直接运行。集成了 MCP（Model Context Protocol）和 HTTP 服务器能力，依赖 Link 账户体系。
zh.hot: 作为 Stripe 官方推出的代理支付工具，填补了 AI 代理安全支付的空白，上线即登 GitHub Trending 日榜，今日新增 19 星，总星数 712，引发开发者关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理集成安全支付能力，实现自动购物或服务订阅
个人用户：授权 AI 助手代为消费，同时保持对每笔交易的审批控制
企业平台：通过 MCP 服务器集成，为内部 AI 工具提供受控支付接口

en.tag: Let AI agents spend securely with one-time payment credentials
en.what: Link CLI is a Stripe command-line tool that lets AI agents obtain one-time payment credentials (virtual card or shared payment token) from a Link wallet to make purchases on your behalf, without exposing your real card details. Every purchase requires your approval, ensuring security and control.
en.content: The repo contains a full CLI tool with commands for login, payment method management, address management, spend requests, etc., and offers LLM-friendly output formats (toon, json, etc.). It can also run as an MCP server for easy integration with AI agent environments.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, distributed via npm, and runnable via npx. Integrates MCP (Model Context Protocol) and HTTP server capabilities, depending on the Link account system.
en.hot: As Stripe's official tool for agent payments, it fills the gap in secure AI agent payments. It hit the GitHub Trending daily list upon release, gaining 19 stars today (total 712), attracting developer attention.
uses: AI agent developers: integrate secure payment capabilities into agents for automated purchases or subscriptions
Individual users: authorize AI assistants to spend on their behalf while keeping approval control over each transaction
Enterprise platforms: integrate via MCP server to provide controlled payment interfaces for internal AI tools

zh.tag: 跨平台个人AI助手，连接模型、工具与聊天渠道
zh.what: OpenClaw 是一个运行在你设备上的个人 AI 助手，通过统一的 Gateway 连接模型、工具和消息渠道。它专为单个操作者设计，让你在常用的聊天应用中就能使用 AI。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的安装脚本、CLI 工具、Gateway 服务、控制面板 UI 以及文档。支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows，可通过 npm 包或安装脚本部署。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 运行时（版本 22.22.3+ 等），使用 npm 作为包管理器，并集成 CI 和 Discord 社区。
zh.hot: 凭借 38.7 万星标和今日新增 173 星，OpenClaw 因其跨平台、开源且高度可定制的个人 AI 助手特性而广受关注，满足了用户对自主 AI 工具的需求。
uses: 个人用户：希望拥有一个可自托管的 AI 助手，集成到日常使用的聊天应用中。
开发者：需要扩展 AI 助手功能，通过 Gateway 连接自定义模型和工具。
隐私敏感者：希望数据保留在自己的设备上，不依赖云端服务。

en.tag: Cross-platform personal AI assistant connecting models, tools, and chat channels
en.what: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant that runs on your devices and connects models, tools, and messaging channels through one Gateway. Designed for a single operator, it lets you use AI in the channels you already use.
en.content: The repo includes installation scripts, CLI tools, Gateway service, control UI, and documentation. Supports macOS, Linux, and Windows, deployable via npm package or installer scripts.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js (v22.22.3+ etc.), uses npm for package management, and integrates CI and Discord community.
en.hot: With 387k stars and +173 today, OpenClaw gains traction for its cross-platform, open-source, highly customizable personal AI assistant, meeting the demand for autonomous AI tools.
uses: Individual users: want a self-hosted AI assistant integrated into their daily chat apps.
Developers: need to extend the assistant with custom models and tools via Gateway.
Privacy-conscious: prefer data staying on their own devices, not relying on cloud services.

zh.tag: 终端 AI 编程代理，内置 IDE 能力
zh.what: oh-my-pi 是一个终端 AI 编程代理，将 IDE 的编辑能力集成到命令行中。它支持哈希锚定的编辑、优化的工具集、LSP、Python、浏览器和子代理等功能，旨在提供开箱即用且高度可定制的编码体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 代码库（约 8 万行）、TypeScript 编写的编码代理包，以及安装脚本和文档。提供 60+ 提供商、31 个内置工具、14 个 LSP 操作和 28 个 DAP 操作。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 和 TypeScript，运行时支持 Bun（推荐），并支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。依赖包括 LSP 和 DAP 协议，以及多种 AI 提供商。
zh.hot: 作为 Pi 的 fork，它提供了更强大的代理表面，并持续根据真实使用进行调优。本周新增 1739 星，总星数达 22525，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 16 名，反映了开发者对终端 AI 编码工具的高度关注。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中直接获得 AI 辅助编码，无需切换 IDE
需要高度可定制和可扩展的 AI 代理，支持多种提供商和工具
喜欢使用 Rust 和 TypeScript 构建高性能命令行工具的技术爱好者
希望利用 LSP 和 DAP 集成进行代码导航和调试的开发者

en.tag: Terminal AI coding agent with IDE wired in
en.what: oh-my-pi is a terminal AI coding agent that integrates IDE capabilities into the command line. It supports hash-anchored edits, an optimized tool harness, LSP, Python, browser, and subagents, aiming to provide an out-of-the-box yet deeply customizable coding experience.
en.content: The repository contains a core Rust codebase (~80k lines), a TypeScript coding agent package, and installation scripts and docs. It offers 60+ providers, 31 built-in tools, 14 LSP ops, and 28 DAP ops.
en.stack: Primarily Rust and TypeScript, with Bun as the recommended runtime, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows. It leverages LSP and DAP protocols and integrates with multiple AI providers.
en.hot: As a fork of Pi, it offers a more capable agent surface and is continuously tuned by real-world use. With 1,739 stars added this week and a total of 22,525, ranking #16 on the TypeScript weekly trending, it reflects high developer interest in terminal AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want AI-assisted coding directly in the terminal without switching IDEs
Those needing a highly customizable and extensible AI agent with multiple providers and tools
Tech enthusiasts interested in building high-performance CLI tools with Rust and TypeScript
Developers who want to leverage LSP and DAP integration for code navigation and debugging

zh.tag: AI 代理编排中枢，统一上下文与多代理协作
zh.what: Traycer 是一个开源的 AI 编排应用，用于高级代理编排。你可以自带已有的模型订阅，并行运行多个代理，并通过共享内存保持上下文不丢失。它还支持在同一代理内即时切换模型、代理间通信和实时协作。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（支持 macOS、Windows、Linux），提供下载安装包、文档、发布版本和贡献指南。主要功能包括 BYOA（自带代理）、统一上下文、代理间通信、协作和跨设备同步。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，可能基于 Electron 或类似框架构建跨平台桌面应用。依赖模型提供商的 API 和共享内存机制。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码代理的普及，Traycer 解决了多代理协作和上下文共享的痛点，上线不久即获得 1300+ 星，今日新增 27 星，位列 TypeScript 趋势榜第五。
uses: 开发者希望整合多个 AI 编码代理，统一管理上下文和模型切换。
团队需要实时协作和代理间通信，以进行代码审查或架构讨论。
追求跨设备同步和自带模型订阅的用户，避免重复付费。

en.tag: Nerve center for agentic coding with unified context and multi-agent orchestration
en.what: Traycer is an open-source AI orchestration app for advanced agent orchestration. Bring your existing provider subscriptions and run multiple agents in parallel without losing context, using shared memory across all models and providers. Switch models instantly within the same agent, orchestrate agent-to-agent communication, and collaborate in real time.
en.content: The repository hosts a desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with download links, docs, releases, and contributing guidelines. Key features include BYOA, unified context, agent-to-agent communication, collaboration, and cross-device sync.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, likely built on Electron or similar for cross-platform desktop. Depends on model provider APIs and shared memory mechanisms.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, Traycer addresses the pain point of multi-agent collaboration and context sharing, quickly gaining 1300+ stars with 27 new today, ranking 5th on the TypeScript trending list.
uses: Developers who want to integrate multiple AI coding agents and manage context and model switching centrally.
Teams needing real-time collaboration and agent-to-agent communication for code review or architecture debates.
Users who want cross-device sync and to bring their own model subscriptions to avoid double payment.

zh.tag: 自由职业者的一站式 AI 商业助手
zh.what: Midday 是一个为自由职业者、承包商、顾问和独立创业者设计的一体化工具，整合了发票、时间跟踪、文件对账、存储和财务概览等功能。它还内置了一个 AI 助手，提供财务洞察和文档查找等能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的应用代码，采用 monorepo 结构，包括前端（Next.js/React）、后端（Bun/TypeScript）、移动端（Expo）和桌面端（Tauri）。主要功能模块有时间跟踪、发票、Magic Inbox（自动匹配收据）、Vault（安全存储）、导出和 AI 助手。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 TypeScript、React、Next.js、Bun、Supabase、Tauri、Expo、TailwindCSS。依赖的服务有 Supabase、Railway、Vercel、Cloudflare、Trigger.dev、Resend、GitHub Actions、GoCardLess、Plaid、Teller、OpenPanel、Polar、Typesense、Gemini 和 OpenAI。
zh.hot: Midday 在 GitHub 上获得近 1.5 万星标，因其精准解决自由职业者的痛点，将多种工具整合为一，并融合 AI 助手，受到广泛关注。今日新增 13 星，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 13 名。
uses: 自由职业者：管理发票、时间跟踪和财务概览，提升工作效率。
独立开发者：利用 AI 助手获取财务洞察，优化成本。
小型团队：协作处理项目时间跟踪和文件存储。

en.tag: All-in-one AI business assistant for freelancers
en.what: Midday is an all-in-one tool designed for freelancers, contractors, consultants, and solo entrepreneurs, integrating invoicing, time tracking, file reconciliation, storage, and financial overview. It also features an AI assistant that provides financial insights and document retrieval.
en.content: The repository contains the full application code in a monorepo structure, including frontend (Next.js/React), backend (Bun/TypeScript), mobile (Expo), and desktop (Tauri). Key modules include time tracking, invoicing, Magic Inbox (automatic receipt matching), Vault (secure storage), export, and AI assistant.
en.stack: Tech stack includes TypeScript, React, Next.js, Bun, Supabase, Tauri, Expo, TailwindCSS. Services used: Supabase, Railway, Vercel, Cloudflare, Trigger.dev, Resend, GitHub Actions, GoCardLess, Plaid, Teller, OpenPanel, Polar, Typesense, Gemini, and OpenAI.
en.hot: Midday has gained nearly 15k stars on GitHub, resonating with freelancers by consolidating multiple tools into one and integrating an AI assistant. With 13 new stars today, it ranks #13 on the TypeScript daily trending list.
uses: Freelancers: manage invoices, time tracking, and financial overview to boost productivity.
Solo developers: leverage AI assistant for financial insights and cost optimization.
Small teams: collaborate on project time tracking and file storage.

zh.tag: 高质量 TypeScript 类型定义仓库
zh.what: DefinitelyTyped 是 TypeScript 社区维护的高质量类型定义仓库，为没有自带类型的 npm 包提供 .d.ts 文件。它通过社区贡献和严格审查，确保类型定义的准确性和可用性。
zh.content: 仓库包含数千个包的 @types 定义，采用 pnpm monorepo 结构，每个包独立管理，并有完善的贡献指南和自动化检查。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 pnpm 管理依赖，dtslint 进行类型检查和 lint，GitHub Actions 用于 CI。
zh.hot: 作为 TypeScript 生态的基础设施，star 数高达 51k，虽今日新增不多，但持续被开发者依赖和贡献。
uses: TypeScript 开发者：为缺少类型的 npm 包安装 @types 定义，提升开发体验。
库作者：通过贡献类型定义，让更多用户受益，同时提升自身库的可用性。
维护者/贡献者：参与社区审查，确保类型定义质量，积累开源经验。

en.tag: High-quality TypeScript type definitions repository
en.what: DefinitelyTyped is a community-maintained repository providing high-quality TypeScript type definitions (.d.ts files) for npm packages that lack built-in types. It relies on community contributions and rigorous review to ensure accuracy and usability.
en.content: The repo contains thousands of @types definitions for various packages, organized as a pnpm monorepo with independent package management, comprehensive contribution guidelines, and automated checks.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript, uses pnpm for dependency management, dtslint for type-checking and linting, and GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: As a foundational piece of the TypeScript ecosystem, it has 51k stars; despite modest daily growth, it remains heavily relied upon and contributed to by developers.
uses: TypeScript developers: install @types definitions for packages lacking types to improve DX.
Library authors: contribute type definitions to benefit users and enhance library usability.
Maintainers/contributors: participate in community review to ensure quality and gain OSS experience.

zh.tag: 多 AI 编程代理并行编排的桌面与移动工作平台
zh.what: Orca 是一款 Agent Development Environment（ADE），让用户能够并行运行多种主流 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等），各自在隔离的 git worktree 中执行任务。同时提供移动端伴侣应用，方便用户随时随地监控、接收通知并追加指令。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面端应用源码（支持 macOS/Windows/Linux）、移动端配套应用（iOS/Android），以及用于多代理并行执行、git worktree 管理与结果对比合并的核心模块。
zh.stack: 主要基于 TypeScript 构建，提供跨平台桌面客户端与移动端配套应用，通过集成多家第三方 AI 编程代理的 API 实现统一调度。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程代理百花齐放的背景下，Orca 以「并行工作树 + 移动端遥控」解决了多代理对比与随时监控的痛点；一周内新增 5,409 Star 并以 21.3k 总星数冲上 GitHub 周榜第 7，足见开发者对统一代理调度界面的强烈需求。
uses: 需要同时对比多个 AI 编程代理输出的开发者——在独立 git worktree 中并行运行多个代理，择优合并结果
追求随时随地掌控编码任务的技术团队——通过移动端伴侣应用远程监控代理状态并追加指令
希望统一调度自有 AI 订阅工具的高级用户——将 Codex、Claude Code 等集中在一套桌面环境中管理
需要保持代码库隔离的谨慎工程师——每个代理在独立工作树中操作，避免污染主分支

en.tag: Parallel AI coding agent orchestrator for desktop and mobile
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment (ADE) that lets developers run a fleet of popular coding agents—such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode—in parallel within isolated git worktrees. It also offers a mobile companion app to monitor progress, receive notifications, and send follow-up instructions from anywhere.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop application source (macOS/Windows/Linux), a mobile companion app (iOS and Android), and core modules for parallel agent execution, git worktree management, and result comparison/merging.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript, it provides cross-platform desktop clients and mobile companion apps, integrating third-party AI coding agent APIs for unified orchestration.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, Orca's parallel worktrees and mobile companion solve the pain of comparing multiple agents and monitoring them on the go; the project gained 5,409 stars this week, hitting #7 on GitHub Trending with 21.3k total stars, reflecting strong demand for a unified agent orchestration interface.
uses: Developers who want to benchmark multiple AI agents side-by-side—run several agents in isolated git worktrees and merge the best result
Teams needing on-the-go oversight—monitor and steer agents from the mobile companion app anywhere
Power users with multiple AI subscriptions—unify Codex, Claude Code, and others under one desktop orchestrator
Engineers prioritizing code safety—each agent operates in its own git worktree to avoid polluting the main branch

zh.tag: 开源自托管部署平台，内置 CI/CD
zh.what: Openship 是一个开源、可自托管的部署平台，内置 CI/CD 功能。你只需指向一个仓库，它就能自动构建、发布、路由并处理 TLS 终止。你可以通过桌面应用、Web 仪表盘或 CLI 来操作它。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的部署平台代码，包括控制平面（桌面应用、服务器、云）和文档。支持多种运行模式：桌面应用、自托管服务器（Compose 或 bare 模式）、以及托管云服务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，基于 Node.js 生态。依赖 npm 包管理，支持通过 SSH 连接服务器，并提供 CLI 工具。
zh.hot: Openship 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，目前拥有 11,689 颗星，今日新增 48 颗，位列 TypeScript 趋势榜第 16 名。它提供了类似 Vercel 的部署体验，但完全自托管，吸引了大量希望掌控自己部署流程的开发者。
uses: 独立开发者：在单台机器上使用桌面应用快速部署个人项目，无需运维经验。
小型团队：通过自托管服务器实现推送即部署，将应用托管在自己的基础设施上。
追求隐私的用户：不想依赖第三方云服务，希望完全掌控自己的部署环境。

en.tag: Open-source self-hosted deployment platform with built-in CI/CD
en.what: Openship is an open-source, self-hostable deployment platform with built-in CI/CD. Point it at a repo, and it builds, ships, routes, and TLS-terminates your app. You can drive it from a desktop app, web dashboard, or CLI.
