zh.tag: 为AI编码代理提供生产级工程技能的技能包
zh.what: 这个仓库提供了一套编码技能，将资深工程师的工作流程、质量门禁和最佳实践编码成AI代理可以遵循的规范。它通过斜杠命令和自动触发机制，覆盖从规格定义到部署的整个开发周期。
zh.content: 仓库包含24个技能，每个技能位于skills/目录下，并配有references/目录存放参考文档。提供8个斜杠命令（如/spec、/plan、/build）对应开发阶段，还支持通过skills CLI安装到70多种AI代理中。
zh.stack: 主要语言是JavaScript，依赖Vercel Labs的skills CLI进行安装和管理。技能本身是Markdown格式的指令集，可被Claude Code、Cursor、Codex等代理识别。
zh.hot: 该仓库在GitHub Trending上排名靠前，拥有近9万星标，因为AI编码代理的普及使得开发者急需标准化的工程实践来提升代码质量。它提供即插即用的技能，简化了代理的工作流程。
uses: AI代理用户：希望让Claude Code、Cursor等代理遵循资深工程师的最佳实践。
开发团队：需要统一编码规范和质量门禁，提升代码审查和测试效率。
技术管理者：希望自动化开发流程，减少人工干预，同时保持质量。

en.tag: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents
en.what: This repository provides a set of coding skills that encode the workflows, quality gates, and best practices of senior engineers into guidelines AI agents can follow. It covers the entire development lifecycle from spec to deployment via slash commands and automatic triggers.
en.content: The repo contains 24 skills, each in the skills/ directory, with a references/ directory for supporting docs. It offers 8 slash commands (e.g., /spec, /plan, /build) mapped to development phases, and can be installed into 70+ AI agents via the skills CLI.
en.stack: Primary language is JavaScript, with the Vercel Labs skills CLI for installation and management. The skills are Markdown-formatted instruction sets recognized by agents like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.
en.hot: With nearly 90k stars and trending on GitHub, this repo addresses the growing need for standardized engineering practices in AI coding agents. It offers plug-and-play skills that streamline agent workflows and improve code quality.
uses: AI agent users: want agents like Claude Code, Cursor to follow senior engineer best practices.
Development teams: need unified coding standards and quality gates to improve code review and testing efficiency.
Tech leads: want to automate development workflows, reduce manual steps, while maintaining quality.

zh.tag: 轻量级 Bitwarden 自托管服务器
zh.what: Vaultwarden 是 Bitwarden 的第三方轻量级服务器实现，用 Rust 编写，兼容官方客户端。它允许用户在低资源环境下自托管密码管理器，替代官方资源密集型的服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器端代码，支持 Docker、Podman 等多种部署方式，提供 Web Vault、API 和后台管理功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 语言，使用 Rocket 框架，依赖 SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL 数据库，支持 Docker 容器化部署。
zh.hot: 拥有 64,210 星标，是自托管密码管理领域的标杆项目。其轻量、安全且完全兼容官方客户端的特性，吸引了大量追求隐私和资源优化的用户。
uses: 个人用户 —— 在低配 VPS 或 NAS 上自托管密码管理器
小型团队 —— 无需付费订阅即可使用 Bitwarden 功能
隐私爱好者 —— 完全掌控密码数据，避免云服务依赖

en.tag: Lightweight self-hosted Bitwarden server
en.what: Vaultwarden is an alternative lightweight server implementation of Bitwarden, written in Rust and compatible with official Bitwarden clients. It enables self-hosted password management on low-resource environments, replacing the official resource-heavy service.
en.content: The repository contains the complete server-side code, supports deployment via Docker, Podman, and others, and provides Web Vault, API, and admin features.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Rocket framework, supports SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL databases, and offers Docker containerization.
en.hot: With 64,210 stars, it's a benchmark in self-hosted password management. Its lightweight, secure, and fully compatible nature attracts users seeking privacy and resource efficiency.
uses: Individual users — self-host password manager on low-end VPS or NAS
Small teams — use Bitwarden features without paid subscription
Privacy enthusiasts — full control over password data, avoiding cloud dependency

zh.tag: 纯 Rust 实现的 Git，追求安全、快速与地道
zh.what: gitoxide 是用 Rust 从头实现的 Git，旨在为追求正确性和性能的未来应用提供开发基础。它既可作为 Rust 库（gix crate）集成到应用中，也可作为命令行工具（gix 和 ein）用于测试和日常开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个子 crate，如 gix 作为高层入口，以及 gix-config、gix-lock 等底层功能模块。还提供了两个二进制：gix 用于 API 测试，ein 提供工作流增强工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 crates.io 生态，遵循 semver 和稳定性指南。
zh.hot: Git 的 Rust 实现备受关注，因其安全性和性能优势，且项目活跃，star 数已超 1.1 万，今日新增 10 星，位列 Rust 日榜第 11。
uses: 希望用 Rust 构建与 Git 交互的应用开发者，可集成 gix 库。
需要高性能、内存安全的 Git 替代工具的用户，可试用 gix 命令行。
对 Git 内部实现感兴趣，想学习或贡献的 Rust 开发者。

en.tag: A pure Rust Git implementation prioritizing safety, speed, and idiomatic design
en.what: gitoxide is a from-scratch Git implementation in Rust, designed for future-proof applications that value correctness and performance. It can be used as a Rust library (the gix crate) or as command-line tools (gix and ein) for testing and development.
en.content: The repository contains multiple sub-crates, with gix as the high-level entry point and lower-level modules like gix-config and gix-lock. Two binaries are provided: gix for API testing and ein for workflow-enhancing tools.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem, following semver and a stability guide.
en.hot: A Rust implementation of Git attracts attention for its safety and performance benefits. With over 11k stars and 10 new stars today, it ranks 11th on the Rust daily trending list.
uses: Developers building Rust applications that need Git integration via the gix library.
Users seeking a high-performance, memory-safe Git alternative using the gix CLI.
Rust developers interested in Git internals, for learning or contributing.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品
zh.what: OpenLogi 是一个开源的罗技外设配置工具，通过 HID++ 协议直接与设备通信，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift 等功能。它无需罗技账号，不收集遥测数据，所有配置以本地 TOML 文件保存，强调隐私和本地优先。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个组件：OpenLogi GUI（GPUI 桌面应用，提供交互式鼠标图示、按键动作选择器、DPI 预设、SmartShift、RGB 键盘灯效、按应用配置文件等）、OpenLogi agent（后台服务，负责输入钩子和设备 I/O）以及相关的文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，GUI 基于 GPUI（Zed 编辑器所用的框架），通过 HID++ 协议与罗技设备通信，支持 Logi Bolt、Unifying 接收器、蓝牙直连和 USB 连接。
zh.hot: 作为罗技官方 Options+ 的开源替代品，它解决了用户对官方软件臃肿、遥测和账号要求的痛点，在 Rust 社区和追求隐私的用户中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已超 8600，今日新增 115。
uses: 罗技外设用户：希望摆脱官方 Options+ 的臃肿和遥测，获得本地优先的配置体验
Rust 开发者：对 GPUI 桌面应用开发或 HID++ 协议实现感兴趣的开发者
隐私倡导者：拒绝账号绑定和数据收集，偏好开源软件的用户

en.tag: A native, local-first Logitech Options+ alternative in Rust
en.what: OpenLogi is an open-source Logitech peripheral configuration tool that communicates directly with devices via HID++, supporting button remapping, DPI adjustment, and SmartShift. It requires no Logitech account, collects no telemetry, and stores all configuration in local TOML files, emphasizing privacy and local-first principles.
en.content: The repository contains three components: OpenLogi GUI (a GPUI desktop app with interactive mouse diagram, per-button action picker, DPI presets, SmartShift, RGB keyboard lighting, per-application profiles), OpenLogi agent (background service owning input hook and device I/O), plus documentation and config examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, the GUI is built with GPUI (the framework used by Zed editor), communicates with Logitech devices via HID++ protocol, supporting Logi Bolt, Unifying receivers, Bluetooth-direct, and USB connections.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Logitech's official Options+, it addresses user pain points with bloat, telemetry, and account requirements, quickly gaining popularity in the Rust community and among privacy-conscious users, with over 8.6k stars and 115 added today.
uses: Logitech peripheral users who want a local-first config experience without bloat and telemetry
Rust developers interested in GPUI desktop app development or HID++ protocol implementation
Privacy advocates who reject account requirements and data collection, preferring open-source software

zh.tag: 本地模型网关，让 Cursor 接入任意 API
zh.what: cursor-byok 是 Cursor 后端的本地实现，作为一个开源模型网关运行在你的机器上。它允许你将 Cursor 连接到自定义的模型 API，并保留工具调用、Skills 和 MCP 等 Agent 能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的服务端、跨平台桌面应用（macOS/Windows/Linux）、模型管理界面、连接基准测试工具和会话指标面板。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 构建，支持 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兼容 API，以及自定义端点。
zh.hot: 凭借 2512 颗星和日增 23 颗的热度，它满足了用户对 Cursor 模型提供商灵活性的需求，成为热门 Rust 项目。
uses: 希望使用自有或第三方模型 API 的 Cursor 用户，避免平台锁定。
需要精细控制模型端点、密钥和请求参数的高级开发者。
关注 token 用量和成本，想要监控会话指标的技术团队。

en.tag: Local model gateway connecting Cursor to any API
en.what: cursor-byok is a local implementation of Cursor's backend, acting as an open-source model gateway on your machine. It lets you connect Cursor to custom model APIs while preserving Agent capabilities like tool calling, Skills, and MCP.
en.content: The repo includes a Rust-based server, cross-platform desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux), model management UI, connection benchmark tools, and session metrics dashboard.
en.stack: Built primarily with Rust, supporting OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, as well as custom endpoints.
en.hot: With 2512 stars and 23 new stars today, it addresses the demand for model provider flexibility in Cursor, making it a trending Rust project.
uses: Cursor users who want to use their own or third-party model APIs to avoid vendor lock-in.
Advanced developers needing fine-grained control over endpoints, keys, and request parameters.
Teams monitoring token usage and costs with session metrics.

zh.tag: 类型安全、可扩展的友好编程语言
zh.what: Gleam 是一门面向类型安全和可扩展系统设计的友好编程语言。它结合了函数式编程的简洁性与静态类型的可靠性，旨在让开发者能够轻松构建健壮的应用程序。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Gleam 编译器的完整实现，包括解析器、类型检查器、代码生成器以及标准库。项目采用 Rust 编写，并配有丰富的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 开发，依赖 Rust 生态中的多个库，如 serde、clap 等，用于序列化、命令行解析等。
zh.hot: Gleam 因其友好的语法和强大的类型系统而受到关注，在 Rust 社区中持续获得高热度，今日新增 31 星，总星数达 21819，位列日榜第七。
uses: 适合希望使用静态类型语言但追求更简洁语法的开发者，用于构建 Web 服务、CLI 工具等。
适合函数式编程爱好者，希望在不牺牲性能的前提下享受类型安全的保障。
适合教学场景，作为入门级函数式编程语言，帮助理解类型系统和编译原理。

en.tag: A friendly, type-safe language for building scalable systems
en.what: Gleam is a friendly programming language designed for building type-safe and scalable systems. It combines the simplicity of functional programming with the reliability of static typing, aiming to let developers easily build robust applications.
en.content: The repository contains the complete implementation of the Gleam compiler, including parser, type checker, code generator, and standard library. The project is written in Rust and comes with extensive documentation and examples.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, leveraging various libraries from the Rust ecosystem such as serde and clap for serialization and command-line parsing.
en.hot: Gleam gains attention for its friendly syntax and powerful type system, maintaining high popularity in the Rust community with 31 new stars today, reaching 21,819 total and ranking 7th on the daily trending list.
uses: Ideal for developers who prefer static typing but desire a cleaner syntax, suitable for building web services, CLI tools, etc.
Great for functional programming enthusiasts who want type safety without sacrificing performance.
Useful in educational settings as an introductory functional language to understand type systems and compiler design.

zh.tag: 人类与AI代理共存的蜂巢思维协作平台
zh.what: Buzz是一个自托管的团队协作空间，人类和AI代理可以在同一频道中共同工作。所有消息、操作和事件都记录在Nostr中继上，形成统一的审计日志。它让代理像人类队友一样参与代码审查、工作流运行和项目管理。
zh.content: 仓库包含Rust实现的核心中继、客户端界面、文档（愿景、架构等）以及截图示例。提供频道、画布、工作流、语音会议等功能，并支持代理自主操作。
zh.stack: 主要使用Rust编写，基于Nostr协议，依赖大量Rust crate。前端可能使用Web技术，但核心是Rust后端。
zh.hot: 在GitHub Trending月榜排名第一，28.7k星，本月新增301星。它解决了AI代理协作中的信任和审计问题，提供统一的事件日志，吸引了开发者和团队。
uses: 团队希望让AI代理参与开发流程，同时保持完整审计记录。
开发者需要自托管的协作平台，数据完全掌控。
对Nostr协议感兴趣，想探索去中心化社交与工作结合。
研究AI代理安全与权限管理的场景。

en.tag: A self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents collaborate on a Nostr relay
en.what: Buzz is a self-hosted team workspace where humans and AI agents collaborate in shared channels. Every message, action, and event is recorded on a Nostr relay, creating a unified audit trail. Agents can participate in code review, workflow runs, and project management like human teammates.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-implemented core relay, client UI, documentation (vision, architecture, etc.), and screenshot examples. It offers channels, canvases, workflows, voice huddles, and agent autonomy.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the Nostr protocol, with a suspicious number of Rust crates. The frontend may use web technologies, but the core is Rust backend.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending monthly with 28.7k stars and +301 this month. It addresses trust and audit in AI agent collaboration with a unified event log, attracting developers and teams.
uses: Teams wanting AI agents in dev workflows with full audit trails.
Developers needing self-hosted collaboration with data ownership.
Those interested in Nostr and decentralized social-work integration.
Researchers exploring AI agent security and permissioning.

zh.tag: 跨 50+ 编码工具的 AI Agent 技能统一管理桌面应用
zh.what: Skills Manager 是一个轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、同步和组织 AI 代理（如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等）的技能。它提供集中式技能库、市场浏览、预设分组以及多设备备份同步功能，帮助开发者高效管理跨工具的技能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的桌面应用源码，提供技能库、市场、预设、全局/代理/项目工作区、备份与多设备同步等模块，并附有演示截图和视频介绍。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 开发，依赖 Tauri 框架（推测）构建跨平台桌面应用，支持 Git、本地文件夹、压缩包等技能来源。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码工具激增，开发者需要统一管理技能，该应用填补了这一需求。今日新增 60 星，总星数达 4060，登上 GitHub 趋势榜（Rust 日榜第 9），说明社区关注度高。
uses: 使用多个 AI 编码工具（如 Claude Code、Cursor）的开发者，希望统一管理技能库。
需要跨设备同步技能配置的团队或个人，确保工作环境一致。
喜欢从市场发现和安装新技能，并希望按项目或代理分组管理的进阶用户。

en.tag: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools
en.what: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more. It offers a unified skill library, marketplace browsing, preset grouping, and multi-device backup sync to help developers manage skills efficiently across tools.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-based desktop app source code, featuring modules for skill library, marketplace, presets, global/agent/project workspaces, backup and multi-device sync, along with demo screenshots and video introductions.
en.stack: Built primarily with Rust, likely using the Tauri framework for a cross-platform desktop app, supporting skill sources from Git repos, local folders, and archives.
en.hot: With the proliferation of AI coding tools, developers need unified skill management, and this app fills that gap. Gaining 60 stars today to reach 4060 total, it hit #9 on GitHub Trending (Rust daily), showing strong community interest.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor who want a unified skill library.
Teams or individuals needing to sync skill configurations across devices for consistent environments.
Advanced users who enjoy discovering and installing new skills from a marketplace and organizing them by project or agent.

zh.tag: Windows 工具，让俄罗斯用户无需 VPN 使用 Google Antigravity
zh.what: 这是一个针对俄罗斯用户的解锁工具，允许他们无需 VPN 或更改 Google 账户区域即可使用 Antigravity（Google 的 AI 编程代理）。它通过修改系统 DNS 规则和二进制文件来绕过区域限制，并支持 Antigravity 2.0、IDE、CLI 和 Gemini CLI。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的解锁程序源代码，提供 Windows 可执行文件（通过 Releases 下载）。包含说明文档、视频教程链接和 Telegram 群组链接，用于获取免费许可证代码。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，涉及 Windows 系统编程、DNS 配置（NRPT 规则）和二进制文件修改（protobuf 描述符）。依赖系统网络功能。
zh.hot: 在俄罗斯用户中迅速流行，因为 Antigravity 官方不支持俄罗斯地区，此工具提供了免费且简单的解决方案。今日新增 20 星，总星数 359，登上 Rust 趋势榜。
uses: 俄罗斯开发者或用户，希望无需 VPN 使用 Google 的 AI 编程工具 Antigravity。
需要同时使用多个国家 Google 账户访问 Antigravity 的用户，一次解锁即可。
对技术感兴趣，想了解如何通过修改 DNS 和二进制文件绕过区域限制的学习者。

en.tag: Windows tool to unlock Google Antigravity for Russian users without VPN or region change
en.what: This is an unlocker for Russian users to use Antigravity (Google's AI coding agent) without VPN or changing Google account region. It modifies DNS rules and binary files to bypass regional restrictions, supporting Antigravity 2.0, IDE, CLI, and Gemini CLI.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code for the unlocker, with Windows executables available via Releases. It includes documentation, a video tutorial link, and a Telegram group link for obtaining a free license code.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, involving Windows system programming, DNS configuration (NRPT rules), and binary patching (protobuf descriptors). Relies on system networking features.
en.hot: Quickly popular among Russian users because Antigravity is not officially available in Russia; this tool offers a free and simple workaround. Gained 20 stars today, total 359, trending on Rust daily.
uses: Russian developers or users who want to use Google's AI coding tool Antigravity without VPN.
Users needing to access Antigravity with multiple Google accounts from different countries; one-time unlock suffices.
Learners interested in how regional restrictions can be bypassed via DNS and binary patching.

zh.tag: 一站式开发环境管理工具
zh.what: mise 是一个开发工具、环境变量和任务运行器的统一 CLI。它通过一个 mise.toml 文件管理项目工具、环境变量和任务，确保新 shell、检出和 CI 作业从相同的设置开始。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、演示 GIF 和配置文件。核心功能包括安装和切换数百种开发工具、按项目目录加载环境变量（包括 .env 文件），以及定义和运行构建、测试、lint 和部署任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 crates.io 生态。支持多种后端，如 npm、pip、go 等，用于安装工具。
zh.hot: mise 在 Rust 社区中热度高，今日新增 258 星，总星数达 31926。它解决了开发环境配置的痛点，将多个工具整合为一个 CLI，受到开发者的欢迎。
uses: 开发者：需要管理多个项目工具版本和环境的个人开发者
团队：希望统一开发环境配置，减少新成员上手成本的团队
CI/CD：需要确保 CI 作业与本地环境一致的持续集成场景
多语言开发者：频繁切换 Node、Python、Go 等语言的开发者

en.tag: All-in-one dev environment manager
en.what: mise is a unified CLI for dev tools, environment variables, and task runner. It manages project tools, env vars, and tasks in one mise.toml file, ensuring new shells, checkouts, and CI jobs start from the same setup.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, demo GIFs, and configuration files. Core features include installing and switching between hundreds of dev tools, loading environment variables per project directory (including .env files), and defining and running tasks for building, testing, linting, and deploying.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem. Supports various backends like npm, pip, go, etc., for installing tools.
en.hot: mise is trending in the Rust community with 258 stars today and 31,926 total. It solves the pain point of dev environment setup by consolidating multiple tools into one CLI, gaining popularity among developers.
uses: Developers: individuals managing multiple project tool versions and environments
Teams: teams wanting to unify dev environment config and reduce onboarding cost
CI/CD: continuous integration scenarios needing consistency with local environments
Polyglot developers: those frequently switching between Node, Python, Go, etc.

zh.tag: Rust 终端 UI 框架，轻松构建 TUI 应用
zh.what: Ratatui 是一个 Rust 库，用于在终端中创建文本用户界面（TUI）。它提供简单灵活的方式构建命令行应用、仪表盘等交互式控制台程序。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库源码、文档、示例（widget 和 app 示例）、模板（用于快速开始）、以及架构说明等。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 编写，依赖 crossterm 等终端处理库，支持多种终端特性。
zh.hot: 拥有 22k+ stars，是 Rust 生态中流行的 TUI 框架，今日新增 22 stars，位列 GitHub 趋势榜 Rust 第 12 名。
uses: 适合需要构建终端交互界面的 Rust 开发者，如 CLI 工具增强、仪表盘等。
适合学习 Rust 并希望掌握 TUI 开发的人群，提供丰富示例和模板。
适合希望快速搭建终端应用原型的开发者，通过 cargo-generate 模板快速启动。

en.tag: Rust crate for building terminal user interfaces (TUIs) easily
en.what: Ratatui is a Rust library for creating text-based user interfaces in the terminal. It offers a simple and flexible way to build command-line apps, dashboards, and other interactive console programs.
en.content: The repository contains the core library source, documentation, examples (widget and app examples), templates for quick start, and architecture notes.
en.stack: Written in Rust, depends on crossterm and other terminal handling libraries, supports various terminal features.
en.hot: With 22k+ stars, it's a popular TUI framework in the Rust ecosystem, gaining 22 stars today and ranking 12th on GitHub Trending for Rust.
uses: For Rust developers needing terminal interactive UIs, such as CLI tool enhancements and dashboards.
For those learning Rust and wanting to master TUI development, with rich examples and templates.
For developers who want to quickly prototype terminal apps using cargo-generate templates.

zh.tag: 极速轻量级矢量瓦片服务器与 MBTiles 工具链
zh.what: Martin 是一个用 Rust 编写的极速轻量级瓦片服务器，能够从 PostGIS 数据库和 GeoJSON 文件实时生成矢量瓦片，并支持从 PMTiles、MBTiles 等文件提供瓦片服务。它还提供工具用于批量生成瓦片、检查和管理 MBTiles 文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Martin 核心瓦片服务器、martin-cp 批量生成工具、mbtiles 命令行工具，以及完整的文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 编写，依赖 PostGIS、DuckDB（可选）、PMTiles/MBTiles 规范，支持 HTTP 和 CLI 两种运行方式。
zh.hot: 凭借极速性能和轻量设计，在 GIS 开发者中广受欢迎，GitHub 星标近 4k，今日新增 8 星，位列 Rust 日榜第 13 名。
uses: 需要高性能矢量瓦片服务的 GIS 应用开发者
需要将 PostGIS 数据快速发布为矢量瓦片的地图平台
需要批量生成或管理 MBTiles 文件的数据工程师

en.tag: Blazing-fast lightweight vector tile server and MBTiles tooling
en.what: Martin is a blazing-fast and lightweight tile server written in Rust that generates vector tiles on the fly from PostGIS databases and GeoJSON files, and serves tiles from PMTiles, MBTiles, and more. It also includes tools for bulk tile generation and MBTiles management.
en.content: The repository contains the core Martin tile server, the martin-cp bulk generation tool, the mbtiles CLI tool, along with comprehensive documentation and configuration examples.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging PostGIS, optional DuckDB, and PMTiles/MBTiles specs; supports both HTTP server and CLI usage.
en.hot: With its blazing speed and lightweight design, it's popular among GIS developers, boasting nearly 4k stars and ranking #13 on today's Rust trending list with 8 new stars.
uses: GIS developers needing high-performance vector tile serving
Map platforms that need to publish PostGIS data as vector tiles quickly
Data engineers who need to bulk-generate or manage MBTiles files

zh.tag: 开源远程桌面，自托管替代 TeamViewer
zh.what: RustDesk 是一款用 Rust 编写的开源远程桌面软件，开箱即用，无需配置。它允许用户完全控制自己的数据，支持自建中继/中转服务器，是 TeamViewer 的隐私友好替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端和服务器端代码，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 等多平台。提供二进制下载、Docker 构建方式，以及多语言翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Flutter 用于跨平台 UI，使用 Sciter 或原生 GUI。服务器端基于 Rust 的异步网络框架。
zh.hot: 拥有 119k+ Stars，今日新增 121，因其完全开源、自托管、隐私安全且性能优异，成为 TeamViewer 等商业软件的热门替代。
uses: 个人用户：需要安全远程访问家庭或办公电脑
企业 IT：自建远程支持平台，保障数据隐私
开发者：定制远程桌面功能或集成到自有系统

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop, self-hosted alternative to TeamViewer
en.what: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application written in Rust, working out of the box with no configuration. It gives users full control over their data and supports self-hosted rendezvous/relay servers, serving as a privacy-friendly alternative to TeamViewer.
en.content: The repository contains full client and server code, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and more. It offers binary downloads, Docker build instructions, and multilingual translation files.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Flutter for cross-platform UI and Sciter or native GUI. The server side uses Rust's async networking framework.
en.hot: With 119k+ stars and 121 new today, it's a hot alternative to commercial software like TeamViewer due to its fully open-source, self-hosted, privacy-focused, and high-performance nature.
uses: Individual users: secure remote access to home or office computers
Enterprise IT: self-hosted remote support platform with data privacy
Developers: customize remote desktop features or integrate into own systems

zh.tag: Rust 异步 SQL 工具包，编译期检查查询
zh.what: SQLx 是一个为 Rust 设计的异步 SQL 工具包，支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL、MariaDB 和 SQLite。它提供编译时检查的查询，无需 DSL，并强调真正的异步操作和纯 Rust 实现。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、数据库驱动（Postgres、MySQL、SQLite）、运行时适配（async-std、tokio、actix）和 TLS 后端（native-tls、rustls），以及丰富的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 的 async/await，使用零 unsafe 代码（除 SQLite 驱动外），支持多种异步运行时和 TLS 库。
zh.hot: SQLx 在 Rust 社区广受欢迎，因其编译时查询检查能显著减少运行时错误，同时保持高性能和纯 Rust 特性。17k+ 的 star 数反映了其作为数据库访问层的可靠选择。
uses: Rust 后端开发者需要安全高效的数据库访问，避免运行时 SQL 错误。
项目要求异步性能，并支持多种数据库（Postgres、MySQL、SQLite）的场景。
希望使用纯 Rust 且无 unsafe 代码的团队，确保内存安全。

en.tag: Async pure-Rust SQL toolkit with compile-time checked queries
en.what: SQLx is an async SQL toolkit for Rust, supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, and SQLite. It offers compile-time checked queries without a DSL, emphasizing true async operations and pure Rust implementation.
en.content: The repository includes the core library, database drivers (Postgres, MySQL, SQLite), runtime adapters (async-std, tokio, actix), and TLS backends (native-tls, rustls), along with extensive documentation and examples.
en.stack: Built on Rust's async/await, using zero unsafe code (except SQLite driver), supporting multiple async runtimes and TLS libraries.
en.hot: SQLx is popular in the Rust community for its compile-time query checking that reduces runtime errors, while maintaining high performance and pure Rust characteristics. The 17k+ stars reflect its reliability as a database access layer.
uses: Rust backend developers needing safe and efficient database access to avoid runtime SQL errors.
Projects requiring async performance and support for multiple databases (Postgres, MySQL, SQLite).
Teams preferring pure Rust with no unsafe code for memory safety.

zh.tag: 开源可扩展的离线语音转录桌面工具
zh.what: Handy 是一款跨平台的桌面语音转文字应用，主打完全离线、隐私优先的转录体验。用户只需按下可配置的快捷键说话，即可将语音实时转换为文本并自动输入到任意文本框中。所有音频处理均在本地完成，无需联网或上传云端。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面客户端源码、基于 Rust 的本地音频处理管线，以及集成 Whisper 和 Parakeet V3 的离线转录引擎，同时提供了 Raycast 插件等扩展集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，使用 Silero VAD 进行语音活动检测，支持 Whisper（Small/Medium/Turbo/Large）和 Parakeet V3 本地模型，并可在 GPU 加速下运行。
zh.hot: 在隐私焦虑与云服务费高涨的背景下，Handy 以「完全开源、完全离线」的差异化定位迅速获得开发者关注，本月新增近 3,000 Star，累计突破 2.6 万，登榜 GitHub Rust 月榜第 17 名。
uses: 隐私敏感用户 —— 需要在本地完成语音输入、拒绝云端上传的写作者与专业人士。
开发者与极客 —— 希望 Fork 并二次扩展自定义模型或工作流的技术用户。
跨平台办公场景 —— 在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上追求高效语音转文字输入的远程工作者。
可访问性需求者 —— 需要无障碍语音输入工具但不愿付费订阅的辅助功能使用者。

en.tag: Free, open-source & extensible offline speech-to-text desktop app
en.what: Handy is a cross-platform desktop speech-to-text app that transcribes your voice entirely offline with a privacy-first approach. Press a configurable shortcut, speak, and it pastes the transcribed text directly into any text field. All audio processing happens locally on your machine, with no data sent to the cloud.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop client source, a Rust-based local audio pipeline, and an offline transcription engine integrating Whisper and Parakeet V3 models, plus integrations like a Raycast extension.
en.stack: Built in Rust, it uses Silero VAD for voice-activity detection and supports local Whisper (Small/Medium/Turbo/Large) and Parakeet V3 models with optional GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Amid rising privacy concerns and cloud-service costs, Handy's 'fully open-source and fully offline' positioning has resonated strongly with developers, adding nearly 3,000 stars this month to reach 26.7K+ and ranking 17th on GitHub's Rust monthly trending list.
uses: Privacy-conscious users — writers and professionals who need local voice input without cloud uploads.
Developers & tinkers — technical users who want to fork and extend custom models or workflows.
Cross-platform workers — remote workers on Windows, macOS, or Linux seeking efficient offline dictation.
Accessibility seekers — users needing assistive voice-input tools without paid subscriptions.

zh.tag: Rust 语言官方主仓库，含编译器、标准库与文档
zh.what: 这是 Rust 编程语言的核心源代码仓库，包含编译器（rustc）、标准库以及官方文档。它旨在让每个人都能构建可靠且高效的软件，强调性能、可靠性和生产力。
zh.content: 仓库包含编译器、标准库、文档以及相关工具链的源代码，还提供了贡献指南和架构说明（rustc-dev-guide）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言编写，依赖 Cargo 作为包管理和构建工具，并包含 rustfmt、Clippy 和 rust-analyzer 等工具。
zh.hot: Rust 语言持续受到开发者青睐，star 数高达 11.6 万，今日新增 232，稳居 Rust 趋势榜前列，体现了其作为系统编程语言的强劲生命力。
uses: 系统编程开发者：需要编写高性能、内存安全的后端服务或嵌入式程序。
编译器爱好者：希望研究 rustc 架构或参与 Rust 语言本身开发。
学习 Rust 的初学者：通过官方仓库获取最新文档和示例。
工具链维护者：需要集成 Cargo、rustfmt 等工具到自己的项目。

en.tag: Official main repository for Rust, including compiler, stdlib, and docs
en.what: This is the main source code repository for the Rust programming language, containing the compiler (rustc), standard library, and documentation. It aims to empower everyone to build reliable and efficient software, emphasizing performance, reliability, and productivity.
en.content: The repository contains source code for the compiler, standard library, documentation, and related tooling, along with contribution guidelines and architecture details (rustc-dev-guide).
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, using Cargo for package management and build, and includes tools like rustfmt, Clippy, and rust-analyzer.
en.hot: Rust continues to gain developer traction with 116k stars and +232 today, ranking high on the Rust trending list, reflecting its strong vitality as a systems programming language.
uses: Systems programmers: need to write high-performance, memory-safe backend services or embedded programs.
Compiler enthusiasts: want to study rustc architecture or contribute to Rust language development.
Rust beginners: access official docs and examples to learn the language.
Toolchain maintainers: need to integrate Cargo, rustfmt, and other tools into their projects.

zh.tag: 基于YAML模板的快速可定制漏洞扫描器
zh.what: Nuclei 是一个由全球安全社区驱动的快速、可定制的漏洞扫描器，基于简单的 YAML 模板 DSL。它帮助用户发现应用、API、网络、DNS 和云配置中的漏洞，通过模板模拟真实攻击场景，减少误报。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Nuclei 扫描器的核心代码，以及用于构建漏洞检测模板的 DSL 文档和示例。模板库（nuclei-templates）是独立仓库，由社区贡献数千个模板。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 YAML 解析和网络请求库，支持多平台编译。
zh.hot: Nuclei 拥有超过 3 万星标，今日新增 89，因其高效的模板化扫描和社区驱动的模板库而广受欢迎，成为安全测试人员的必备工具。
uses: 安全研究人员快速检测目标资产中的已知漏洞
DevOps 团队在 CI/CD 流程中集成安全扫描
渗透测试人员使用自定义模板进行针对性漏洞验证

en.tag: Fast and customizable vulnerability scanner powered by YAML templates
en.what: Nuclei is a fast, customizable vulnerability scanner powered by the global security community, built on a simple YAML-based DSL. It helps find vulnerabilities in applications, APIs, networks, DNS, and cloud configurations, using templates to mimic real-world conditions and reduce false positives.
en.content: The repository contains the core scanner code, along with DSL documentation and examples for creating vulnerability templates. The template library (nuclei-templates) is a separate repository with thousands of community-contributed templates.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, it relies on YAML parsing and HTTP client libraries, and supports cross-platform compilation.
en.hot: With over 30k stars and 89 new today, Nuclei is popular for its efficient template-based scanning and community-driven template library, making it a must-have for security testers.
uses: Security researchers quickly scan target assets for known vulnerabilities
DevOps teams integrate security scanning into CI/CD pipelines
Penetration testers use custom templates for targeted vulnerability validation

zh.tag: 全球最快的静态网站生成框架
zh.what: Hugo 是一个用 Go 编写的静态网站生成器，以速度极快和灵活性著称。它能在几秒内渲染完整网站，支持多语言、强大的分类系统和高级模板。广泛用于企业、文档、博客、作品集等各类网站。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Hugo 的完整源代码、文档、测试和贡献指南。主要目录包括命令实现、核心引擎、模板系统、资源处理等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 模块管理，支持多种平台（Linux、macOS、Windows、BSD）。可选集成 Dart Sass 等工具。
zh.hot: Hugo 凭借其极快的构建速度和灵活性长期占据 GitHub 高星位置，目前拥有 89,530 星，今日新增 22 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 6。其活跃的社区和持续的更新也推动了热度。
uses: 开发者快速搭建个人博客、作品集或文档站点，享受秒级构建体验。
企业或组织创建公司官网、新闻发布、活动页面等静态内容网站。
技术团队构建项目文档、API 文档或知识库，利用 Hugo 的主题和模板系统。
静态网站爱好者或前端开发者，利用 Hugo 的灵活性和多语言支持进行创意项目。

en.tag: The world's fastest framework for building websites
en.what: Hugo is a static site generator written in Go, known for its exceptional speed and flexibility. It renders complete sites in seconds, with multilingual support, powerful taxonomies, and advanced templating. Widely used for corporate, documentation, blog, portfolio sites, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, tests, and contribution guidelines for Hugo. Key directories include command implementation, core engine, template system, and asset processing.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, using Go modules for dependency management, and supports multiple platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows, BSD). Optional integration with tools like Dart Sass.
en.hot: Hugo maintains a high star count due to its blazing build speed and flexibility, currently at 89,530 stars with 22 new today, ranking #6 on the Go trending list. Its active community and continuous updates also drive popularity.
uses: Developers quickly build personal blogs, portfolios, or documentation sites with second-level build times.
Businesses or organizations create corporate websites, news releases, event pages, and other static content sites.
Technical teams build project documentation, API docs, or knowledge bases using Hugo's themes and templates.
Static site enthusiasts or front-end developers leverage Hugo's flexibility and multilingual support for creative projects.

zh.tag: 行业标准容器运行时，强调简单、稳健与可移植性
zh.what: containerd 是一个行业标准的容器运行时，专注于简单性、健壮性和可移植性。它以守护进程形式运行于 Linux 和 Windows，管理宿主机上容器的完整生命周期，包括镜像传输与存储、容器执行与监督、底层存储与网络挂载等。它被设计为嵌入到更大的系统中，而不是直接供开发者或最终用户使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 containerd 的源代码、构建配置、文档（包括架构设计文档）以及 CI/CD 工作流。项目采用 Go 语言编写，并遵循 CNCF 的治理模型，包含多个子项目。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Linux/Windows 系统调用，并集成 CNCF 生态工具。构建系统支持 Makefile 和 GitHub Actions。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，containerd 是 Kubernetes 等主流平台的默认运行时，拥有 21168 颗星，持续获得社区关注。其稳定性与广泛采用使其成为容器基础设施的核心组件。
uses: 平台工程师：集成 containerd 以构建容器平台或 Kubernetes 节点，管理容器生命周期。
容器运行时开发者：基于 containerd 扩展或定制运行时功能，满足特定需求。
DevOps 团队：利用 containerd 的高效镜像管理和稳定运行，优化 CI/CD 流水线。
安全研究人员：审查和贡献安全补丁，参与 CNCF 安全顾问团队。

en.tag: Industry-standard container runtime emphasizing simplicity, robustness, and portability
en.what: containerd is an industry-standard container runtime with an emphasis on simplicity, robustness, and portability. It is available as a daemon for Linux and Windows, managing the complete container lifecycle of its host system: image transfer and storage, container execution and supervision, low-level storage and network attachments, etc. It is designed to be embedded into a larger system, rather than being used directly by developers or end-users.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, build configuration, documentation (including architecture design docs), and CI/CD workflows for containerd. The project is written in Go and follows CNCF governance, with multiple subprojects.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on Linux/Windows system calls and integrating with CNCF ecosystem tools. Build system supports Makefile and GitHub Actions.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, containerd is the default runtime for mainstream platforms like Kubernetes, with 21,168 stars and ongoing community attention. Its stability and widespread adoption make it a core component of container infrastructure.
uses: Platform engineers: Integrate containerd to build container platforms or Kubernetes nodes, managing container lifecycles.
Container runtime developers: Extend or customize runtime features based on containerd to meet specific needs.
DevOps teams: Leverage containerd's efficient image management and stable operation to optimize CI/CD pipelines.
Security researchers: Review and contribute security patches, participate in CNCF security advisor team.

zh.tag: 开源基础设施即代码工具，Terraform 的替代品
zh.what: OpenTofu 是一个开源的基础设施即代码工具，允许用户以声明式方式安全高效地构建、更改和版本化管理云基础设施。它支持众多主流服务提供商和自定义内部解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenTofu 的完整源代码、贡献指南、社区会议信息以及关键特性文档，如执行计划、资源图和变更自动化。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖云提供商 SDK 和 Terraform 生态。
zh.hot: 作为 Terraform 的社区驱动分支，OpenTofu 在许可证变更后迅速获得关注，近 3 万星标表明其作为开源替代方案的强劲需求。
uses: 云基础设施工程师：使用代码管理多云环境，实现版本控制和自动化部署。
DevOps 团队：通过执行计划和资源图优化变更流程，减少人为错误。
寻求开源 IaC 解决方案的企业：避免商业许可限制，保持对基础设施管理的控制。

en.tag: Open-source Infrastructure as Code tool, a Terraform alternative
en.what: OpenTofu is an open-source Infrastructure as Code tool that lets you declaratively manage cloud infrastructure safely and efficiently. It supports popular service providers and custom in-house solutions.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, contribution guide, community meeting info, and documentation of key features like execution plans, resource graph, and change automation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging cloud provider SDKs and the Terraform ecosystem.
en.hot: As a community-driven fork of Terraform, OpenTofu gained traction after license changes, with nearly 30k stars indicating strong demand for an open-source alternative.
uses: Cloud infrastructure engineers: manage multi-cloud environments with code, enabling version control and automated deployment.
DevOps teams: optimize change processes with execution plans and resource graphs, reducing human errors.
Enterprises seeking open-source IaC: avoid commercial license restrictions and maintain control over infrastructure management.

zh.tag: Kubernetes 上的 AI 代理沙箱编排器
zh.what: agent-sandbox 是一个 Kubernetes 控制器，通过自定义资源定义（CRD）管理隔离的、有状态的、单例工作负载。它特别适合 AI 代理运行时和强化学习等场景，提供稳定的身份和持久化存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心的 Sandbox CRD 和控制器，以及扩展模块，如 SandboxTemplate、SandboxClaim 和 SandboxWarmPool，用于模板化、声明和预热沙箱池。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言，使用 Kubernetes 的 controller-runtime 和 client-go 构建，支持通过 RuntimeClass 集成 gVisor 或 Kata Containers 等安全沙箱运行时。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理的兴起，对隔离、有状态运行时的需求激增。该项目由 Kubernetes SIG 官方维护，提供标准化 API，star 数已达 3623，并登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为每个代理提供隔离的、有状态的运行环境，支持持久化和稳定网络身份。
强化学习研究：管理需要长时间运行、状态保持的仿真环境或训练任务。
平台工程师：在 Kubernetes 上提供轻量级、单容器 VM 体验，简化工作负载管理。

en.tag: Kubernetes-native sandbox orchestrator for AI agents
en.what: agent-sandbox is a Kubernetes controller that manages isolated, stateful, singleton workloads via a custom resource definition (CRD). It is ideal for AI agent runtimes and reinforcement learning, providing stable identity and persistent storage.
en.content: The repository contains the core Sandbox CRD and controller, plus extensions like SandboxTemplate, SandboxClaim, and SandboxWarmPool for templating, claiming, and pre-warming sandbox pools.
en.stack: Built with Go, using Kubernetes controller-runtime and client-go, with support for secure sandbox runtimes like gVisor or Kata Containers via RuntimeClass.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents, demand for isolated, stateful runtimes has surged. Officially maintained by Kubernetes SIG, it offers a standardized API, reaching 3623 stars and trending on GitHub.
uses: AI agent developers: provide isolated, stateful runtime for each agent with persistence and stable network identity.
Reinforcement learning researchers: manage long-running, stateful simulation environments or training tasks.
Platform engineers: offer a lightweight, single-container VM experience on Kubernetes, simplifying workload management.

zh.tag: 把文档变成可查询RAG、自主推理Agent和自维护Wiki的LLM知识平台
zh.what: WeKnora是腾讯开源的LLM知识平台，将原始文档转化为可查询的RAG、自主推理的Agent和自维护的Wiki。它支持多源数据导入、树状文件夹视图、块编辑与版本回滚，并提供交互式知识图谱。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、架构文档、API参考、开发者指南，以及多语言README（中英日韩）。核心功能包括RAG快速问答、ReAct Agent、Wiki模式、知识图谱、多源导入（飞书、Notion、语雀、RSS等）和网站嵌入组件。
zh.stack: 主语言为Go，基于LLM能力构建，涉及RAG、ReAct Agent、MCP工具集成、向量检索等技术。支持多种文档格式和外部服务（如飞书、Notion、RSS）。
zh.hot: 上线后迅速获得2万+星标，今日新增105星，位列GitHub Go语言日榜第5。其将文档自动转化为可交互知识图谱和自维护Wiki的能力，解决了企业知识管理的痛点，备受开发者关注。
uses: 企业知识库建设：将内部文档自动整理为可查询的RAG和自维护Wiki，提升员工检索效率。
智能客服与问答系统：利用RAG快速问答能力，构建基于私有知识的对话机器人。
复杂任务自动化：通过ReAct Agent编排检索、工具调用和网络搜索，完成多步骤分析。
个人知识管理：导入个人文档，生成知识图谱和Wiki，辅助学习和研究。

en.tag: Open-source LLM knowledge platform turning documents into queryable RAG, autonomous agent, and self-maintaining Wiki
en.what: WeKnora is an open-source LLM knowledge platform from Tencent that transforms raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki. It supports multi-source ingestion, tree-structured folder views, chunk editing with revision history, and an interactive knowledge graph.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, architecture docs, API reference, developer guide, and multi-language READMEs (EN, CN, JA, KO). Key features include RAG-based Q&A, ReAct Agent, Wiki mode, knowledge graph, multi-source ingestion (Feishu, Notion, Yuque, RSS, etc.), and website embed widgets.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on LLM capabilities, incorporating RAG, ReAct Agent, MCP tool integration, and vector retrieval. Supports various document formats and external services like Feishu, Notion, and RSS.
en.hot: Quickly gained over 20k stars with 105 new stars today, ranking #5 on GitHub Go daily trending. Its ability to auto-convert documents into interactive knowledge graphs and self-maintaining wikis addresses enterprise knowledge management pain points, drawing significant developer attention.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: Automatically organize internal documents into queryable RAG and self-maintaining Wiki to boost employee retrieval efficiency.
Intelligent customer service and Q&A systems: Leverage RAG-based quick Q&A to build chatbots grounded in private knowledge.
Complex task automation: Use ReAct Agent to orchestrate retrieval, tool calls, and web search for multi-step analysis.
Personal knowledge management: Import personal documents to generate knowledge graphs and wikis for learning and research.

zh.tag: 多协议多用户的 Xray 管理面板
zh.what: 3X-UI 是一个开源的 Xray-core 服务器管理面板，提供多语言 Web 界面，支持部署、配置和监控多种代理协议。它支持单节点和多节点部署，并提供了丰富的用户管理功能，如流量限制、到期时间和 IP 限制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的面板源码、多语言翻译文件、文档和自定义订阅模板。主要组件包括 Web 界面、RESTful API、Telegram 机器人以及内置的订阅服务器。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，依赖 Xray-core 作为核心代理引擎。前端使用 Vue.js 和 Element Plus 构建，后端采用 Gin 框架，并支持 SQLite 和 PostgreSQL 数据库。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 45k 星标，今日新增 86 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 8。其强大的功能、活跃的社区和持续的更新使其成为 Xray 面板的热门选择。
uses: 个人用户：搭建和管理自己的代理服务器，支持多种协议和用户管理
小型团队或组织：在多台服务器上部署统一管理面板，实现集中监控和配置
开发者：通过 RESTful API 集成到自己的应用或服务中，实现自动化管理

en.tag: Multi-protocol, multi-user Xray management panel
en.what: 3X-UI is an open-source web control panel for managing Xray-core servers, offering a multi-language interface for deploying, configuring, and monitoring various proxy protocols. It supports both single and multi-node setups, with per-client management including traffic quotas, expiry dates, and IP limits.
en.content: The repository contains the full panel source code, multi-language translation files, documentation, and custom subscription templates. Key components include a web interface, RESTful API, Telegram bot, and built-in subscription server.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging Xray-core as the core proxy engine. The frontend is built with Vue.js and Element Plus, while the backend uses the Gin framework, with support for SQLite and PostgreSQL databases.
en.hot: With over 45k stars and 86 new stars today, ranking 8th on the Go trending list, its powerful features, active community, and continuous updates make it a popular choice for Xray panels.
uses: Individual users: set up and manage their own proxy servers with multi-protocol support and user management
Small teams or organizations: deploy a unified panel across multiple servers for centralized monitoring and configuration
Developers: integrate via RESTful API into their own applications or services for automated management

zh.tag: 实时基础设施监控与可观测性平台
zh.what: Netdata 是一个开源的实时监控和可观测性平台，能够以每秒一次的频率收集并可视化服务器、容器和应用的各项指标。它旨在为精简团队提供 AI 驱动的全栈可观测性，无需复杂配置即可快速部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Netdata 代理的完整源代码，包括用 C 语言编写的核心采集器、用 Go 编写的部分组件、Web 仪表盘、告警引擎以及机器学习模块。还提供了 Docker 镜像、安装脚本和详细的文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C 语言编写核心，部分组件用 Go 实现，支持多种操作系统和容器环境。依赖包括 libuuid、zlib 等，并支持与 Prometheus、Graphite 等集成。
zh.hot: Netdata 拥有超过 8 万颗星，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的监控项目之一。其零配置、实时可视化和 AI 驱动的异常检测能力吸引了大量开发者和运维人员。
uses: 系统管理员和 DevOps 工程师需要实时监控服务器和基础设施性能
开发人员希望快速定位应用性能瓶颈和异常
小型团队或初创公司寻求轻量级、易部署的全栈可观测性解决方案

en.tag: Real-time infrastructure monitoring and observability platform
en.what: Netdata is an open-source real-time monitoring and observability platform that collects and visualizes metrics from servers, containers, and applications at one-second granularity. It aims to provide AI-powered full-stack observability for lean teams with quick deployment and minimal configuration.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the Netdata agent, including collectors written in C, some components in Go, a web dashboard, alerting engine, and machine learning modules. It also includes Docker images, installation scripts, and comprehensive documentation.
en.stack: Core is written in C, with some components in Go, supporting various OS and container environments. Dependencies include libuuid, zlib, and integrations with Prometheus, Graphite, and more.
en.hot: With over 80k stars, Netdata is one of the most popular monitoring projects on GitHub. Its zero-configuration setup, real-time visualization, and AI-powered anomaly detection attract a large community of developers and operators.
uses: System administrators and DevOps engineers needing real-time server and infrastructure performance monitoring
Developers who want to quickly identify application performance bottlenecks and anomalies
Small teams or startups seeking lightweight, easy-to-deploy full-stack observability solutions

zh.tag: 高性能 Go 版 WhatsApp 集成 API
zh.what: Evolution Go 是一个用 Go 构建的高性能 WhatsApp API，属于 Evolution Foundation 生态的一部分。它基于 whatsmeow 库，提供轻量级、健壮的 WhatsApp 集成解决方案，支持 RESTful API、实时事件、媒体处理等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 API 服务源码、Docker 配置、Swagger 文档、示例环境文件以及 Makefile 构建脚本。核心功能包括 QR 码配对、媒体存储（MinIO/S3）、消息持久化（PostgreSQL）、许可证管理和多事件推送（WebSocket/Webhook/AMQP/NATS）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 whatsmeow 库进行 WhatsApp 协议交互，支持 PostgreSQL 存储、MinIO/S3 对象存储，以及 RabbitMQ/NATS 消息队列。提供 Docker 镜像和 Swagger 文档。
zh.hot: 今日新增 21 星，总星数 739，位列 Go 语言日榜第 10。作为 Evolution Foundation 生态的核心组件，它提供了高性能、轻量级的 WhatsApp 集成方案，吸引了大量需要稳定 API 的开发者。
uses: 开发人员需要将 WhatsApp 集成到自己的应用或 CRM 系统中，可快速部署 RESTful API。
企业或开发者希望利用 Docker 容器化部署，实现高可用和可扩展的 WhatsApp 消息服务。
对实时事件推送有需求，如通过 Webhook 或消息队列接收消息状态更新的场景。

en.tag: High-performance WhatsApp integration API built in Go
en.what: Evolution Go is a high-performance WhatsApp API built in Go, part of the Evolution Foundation ecosystem. It leverages the whatsmeow library to provide a robust, lightweight solution for WhatsApp integration, featuring RESTful API, real-time events, and media handling.
en.content: The repository contains the complete API service source code, Docker configuration, Swagger documentation, sample environment files, and Makefile build scripts. Core features include QR code pairing, media storage (MinIO/S3), message persistence (PostgreSQL), license management, and multi-event push (WebSocket/Webhook/AMQP/NATS).
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, it relies on the whatsmeow library for WhatsApp protocol interaction, supports PostgreSQL storage, MinIO/S3 object storage, and RabbitMQ/NATS message queues. It provides Docker images and Swagger documentation.
en.hot: With 21 stars added today and a total of 739, it ranks 10th on the Go daily trending list. As a core component of the Evolution Foundation ecosystem, it offers a high-performance, lightweight WhatsApp integration solution, attracting developers who need a stable API.
uses: Developers who need to integrate WhatsApp into their applications or CRM systems can quickly deploy the RESTful API.
Enterprises or developers looking to leverage Docker containerization for high availability and scalable WhatsApp messaging services.
Those requiring real-time event push, such as receiving message status updates via webhooks or message queues.

zh.tag: App Store Connect API 的快速脚本化 CLI
zh.what: 这是一个用 Go 编写的命令行工具，用于自动化 App Store Connect 的各种操作，如 TestFlight、构建、提交、签名、分析、截图和订阅管理等。它旨在从终端、IDE 或 CI/CD 管道中简化 iOS、macOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 的发布流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 的源代码、文档、安装脚本，以及用于自动化工作流的 Agent Skills（23 个技能），可通过 `asc install-skills` 安装。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，支持 Homebrew、安装脚本和 WinGet 等多种安装方式，依赖 Git 用于技能安装。
zh.hot: 凭借 6222 颗星和每日新增 45 颗，它满足了开发者对高效自动化 App Store 发布流程的需求，尤其是在 CI/CD 集成方面。
uses: iOS/macOS 开发者希望在 CI/CD 中自动化 TestFlight 和 App Store 提交
需要批量管理应用元数据、截图和订阅的发布工程师
希望通过命令行快速执行 App Store Connect 操作的独立开发者

en.tag: Fast, scriptable CLI for App Store Connect API
en.what: A Go-based CLI for automating App Store Connect tasks like TestFlight, builds, submissions, signing, analytics, screenshots, and subscriptions. It streamlines release workflows for iOS, macOS, tvOS, and visionOS from terminal, IDE, or CI/CD.
en.content: The repo includes the CLI source, docs, install scripts, and Agent Skills (23 skills) for automating workflows, installable via `asc install-skills`.
en.stack: Built with Go, supports Homebrew, install script, and WinGet. Requires Git for skills installation.
en.hot: With 6222 stars and +45 daily, it meets the demand for efficient automation of App Store releases, especially in CI/CD.
uses: iOS/macOS developers automating TestFlight and App Store submissions in CI/CD
Release engineers managing metadata, screenshots, and subscriptions at scale
Indie developers seeking quick CLI access to App Store Connect operations

zh.tag: 统一 AI 模型网关与资产管理平台
zh.what: New API 是一个集中式 AI 模型网关，支持将多种 LLM 统一转换为 OpenAI、Claude 或 Gemini 兼容格式，便于聚合与分发。它提供个人和企业级模型管理、认证、用量统计与成本核算，并支持私有化部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web 前端（基于 React 等）、Docker 部署配置、多语言 README（中英法日等）以及详细的文档和快速入门指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端可能采用 React 等现代框架，依赖 Docker 进行容器化部署，并集成多种 LLM API 协议转换。
zh.hot: 凭借 45.5k 星标和日增 115 星，New API 成为 AI 基础设施的热门选择，因其解决了多模型统一接入的痛点，并支持私有化部署，深受开发者和企业青睐。
uses: 开发者：需要统一管理多个 LLM API 密钥和调用格式的开发者
企业：希望构建内部 AI 网关，实现成本控制和审计的企业
自托管用户：偏好私有化部署，避免依赖第三方服务的用户
AI 应用团队：需要将不同模型快速集成到现有应用中的团队

en.tag: Unified AI model gateway and asset management platform
en.what: New API is a centralized AI model gateway that aggregates and distributes various LLMs by converting them into OpenAI-compatible, Claude-compatible, or Gemini-compatible formats. It offers personal and enterprise-grade model management, authentication, usage analytics, cost accounting, and supports private deployment.
en.content: The repository includes a Go-based backend service, a web frontend (e.g., React), Docker deployment configurations, multilingual READMEs (Chinese, English, French, Japanese, etc.), and comprehensive documentation and quick-start guides.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with a modern frontend framework like React, containerized via Docker, and integrates protocol conversion for various LLM APIs.
en.hot: With 45.5k stars and 115 new stars today, New API is a popular choice for AI infrastructure, solving the pain point of unified multi-model access and supporting private deployment, which appeals to developers and enterprises.
uses: Developers: those needing to manage multiple LLM API keys and formats in one place
Enterprises: seeking an internal AI gateway for cost control and auditing
Self-hosters: users preferring private deployment to avoid third-party dependencies
AI application teams: teams needing to quickly integrate various models into existing apps

zh.tag: 多智能体工作区管理器，持久化任务状态
zh.what: Gas Town 是一个工作区管理器，用于协调多个 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、GitHub Copilot 等）处理不同任务。它通过 git 支持的钩子持久化工作状态，解决代理重启后丢失上下文的问题，支持可靠的多代理工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心概念如 Mayor（AI 协调器）、Town（工作区目录）、Rigs（项目容器）、Crew Members（个人工作区）、Polecats（工作代理）、Hooks（持久化存储）、Convoys（工作跟踪单元）和 Beads（git 支持的问题跟踪系统）。架构图展示了各组件之间的关系。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 git 和 git worktree 实现持久化，与 Claude Code、GitHub Copilot 等 AI 代理集成。
zh.hot: 随着多代理工作流需求增长，Gas Town 解决了代理重启后上下文丢失的痛点，支持扩展到 20-30 个代理，star 数已达 17k+，在 GitHub Trending 上表现亮眼。
uses: 开发团队需要协调多个 AI 编码代理并行处理任务时，可使用 Gas Town 管理代理生命周期和状态。
个人开发者希望持久化 AI 代理的工作进度，避免重启后丢失上下文，适合使用此工具。
研究多代理系统架构的开发者，可参考其设计模式（如 Mayor、Rigs、Beads）进行学习。

en.tag: Multi-agent workspace manager with persistent work tracking
en.what: Gas Town is a workspace manager that coordinates multiple AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) on different tasks. It persists work state in git-backed hooks, solving the context loss problem on agent restart and enabling reliable multi-agent workflows.
en.content: The repo includes core concepts like Mayor (AI coordinator), Town (workspace directory), Rigs (project containers), Crew Members (personal workspace), Polecats (worker agents), Hooks (persistent storage), Convoys (work tracking units), and Beads (git-backed issue tracking). An architecture diagram shows the relationships.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, relies on git and git worktree for persistence, integrates with AI agents like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.
en.hot: As multi-agent workflows grow, Gas Town addresses the pain point of context loss on agent restart, scales to 20-30 agents, and has gained 17k+ stars, trending on GitHub.
uses: Development teams coordinating multiple AI coding agents in parallel can use Gas Town to manage agent lifecycle and state.
Individual developers wanting to persist AI agent work progress and avoid context loss on restart will find this tool useful.
Developers researching multi-agent system architecture can learn from its design patterns (e.g., Mayor, Rigs, Beads).

zh.tag: Go 语言构建、评估、部署 AI 代理的开源工具包
zh.what: google/adk-go 是 Google 推出的 Agent Development Kit (ADK) 的 Go 版本，用于构建、评估和部署复杂的 AI 代理。它采用代码优先的开发方式，提供灵活性和控制力，并针对 Gemini 优化，但模型无关。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 模块、示例代码、文档和测试，核心是提供代理开发框架，支持工具集成、多代理系统和云原生部署。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Google Cloud 生态，支持与 Gemini 等模型集成，并兼容其他框架。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方 ADK 的 Go 版本，凭借其代码优先、高性能和云原生特性，在开发者中迅速获得关注，star 数已达 8704。
uses: Go 开发者构建云原生 AI 代理应用，利用 Go 的并发和性能优势。
需要灵活控制代理逻辑、工具和编排的团队，实现可测试和版本化的代理。
希望部署到 Google Cloud Run 等云环境的代理应用。

en.tag: Open-source, code-first Go toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying AI agents
en.what: google/adk-go is Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK) for Go, designed for building, evaluating, and deploying sophisticated AI agents. It is code-first, offering flexibility and control, optimized for Gemini but model-agnostic.
en.content: The repository contains Go modules, examples, documentation, and tests, providing a framework for agent development with tool integration, multi-agent systems, and cloud-native deployment.
en.stack: Primarily Go, leveraging Google Cloud ecosystem, integrates with Gemini and other models, and compatible with other frameworks.
en.hot: As Google's official ADK for Go, it quickly gained traction among developers due to its code-first, high-performance, and cloud-native features, amassing 8.7k stars.
uses: Go developers building cloud-native AI agent applications, leveraging Go's concurrency and performance.
Teams needing flexible control over agent logic, tools, and orchestration for testable and versioned agents.
Those deploying agents to cloud environments like Google Cloud Run.

zh.tag: 为AI编码代理提供持久化结构化记忆的分布式图式问题追踪器
zh.what: Beads 是一个为 AI 编码代理设计的分布式图式问题追踪器，提供持久化、结构化的记忆。它用依赖感知的图取代混乱的 Markdown 计划，帮助代理处理长周期任务而不丢失上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Beads CLI 工具源码、安装脚本、文档以及多种代理集成（如 Codex CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等）。用户通过 `bd` 命令初始化项目、创建/关闭问题、同步远程代理。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 开发，底层依赖 Dolt（分布式版本化数据库）实现图存储和同步。支持通过 npm 和 PyPI 安装 MCP 相关包。
zh.hot: GitHub 日增 95 星，总星数 25601，位列 Go 语言日榜第 11。AI 编码代理的持久记忆需求旺盛，Beads 以轻量 CLI 和分布式图方案解决痛点。
uses: AI 编码代理开发者 —— 为代理提供持久化记忆和任务管理
使用 Codex CLI、Claude Code 等工具的开发者 —— 集成 Beads 以提升长周期任务处理能力
团队协作场景 —— 多代理通过 Dolt 同步工作状态和依赖图

en.tag: A distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents with persistent structured memory
en.what: Beads is a distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents, providing persistent structured memory. It replaces messy markdown plans with a dependency-aware graph, helping agents handle long-horizon tasks without losing context.
en.content: The repo contains the Beads CLI tool source code, installation scripts, documentation, and integrations for various agents (Codex CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.). Users interact via `bd` commands to init projects, create/close issues, and sync with remote agents.
en.stack: Built with Go, leveraging Dolt (distributed versioned database) for graph storage and sync. Also provides npm and PyPI packages for MCP integration.
en.hot: Gaining 95 stars daily, total 25601, ranking #11 on Go daily trending. The demand for persistent memory in AI coding agents is high, and Beads addresses it with a lightweight CLI and distributed graph approach.
uses: AI coding agent developers — provide persistent memory and task management for agents
Developers using Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc. — integrate Beads to improve long-horizon task handling
Team collaboration — multiple agents sync work status and dependency graph via Dolt

zh.tag: 可编程管道的 OpenTelemetry Collector 发行版
zh.what: Grafana Alloy 是一个开源的 OpenTelemetry Collector 发行版，内置 Prometheus 管道，支持指标、日志、追踪和性能剖析。它提供基于表达式的可编程管道，用于配置强大的可观测性管道，并支持与多种遥测生态系统集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Alloy 的源代码、文档、示例配置和内置 UI，用于可视化和调试管道。支持模块共享、集群自动负载分配和集中配置管理。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，基于 OpenTelemetry Collector，并集成 Prometheus、Loki、Pyroscope 等组件。
zh.hot: 作为 Grafana 官方的可观测性数据采集器，Alloy 提供了可编程管道和 Kubernetes 原生支持，简化了遥测数据收集，因此在 GitHub 上受到关注，当前星标 3467。
uses: 可观测性工程师：需要统一采集指标、日志、追踪和性能数据的团队。
Kubernetes 用户：希望原生集成 Kubernetes 资源，无需额外 Operator。
Grafana 生态用户：需要与 Prometheus、Loki 等无缝集成的场景。

en.tag: OpenTelemetry Collector distribution with programmable pipelines
en.what: Grafana Alloy is an open-source OpenTelemetry Collector distribution with built-in Prometheus pipelines, supporting metrics, logs, traces, and profiles. It offers a rich expression-based syntax for configuring powerful observability pipelines and integrates with multiple telemetry ecosystems.
en.content: The repository contains Alloy's source code, documentation, example configurations, and a built-in UI for visualizing and debugging pipelines. It supports module sharing, clustering for automatic workload distribution, and centralized configuration management.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, built on OpenTelemetry Collector, integrating components like Prometheus, Loki, and Pyroscope.
en.hot: As Grafana's official observability collector, Alloy offers programmable pipelines and Kubernetes-native support, simplifying telemetry collection, which has gained attention on GitHub with 3,467 stars.
uses: Observability engineers: teams needing unified collection of metrics, logs, traces, and profiles.
Kubernetes users: those wanting native integration with Kubernetes resources without extra operators.
Grafana ecosystem users: scenarios requiring seamless integration with Prometheus, Loki, etc.

zh.tag: AI 代理集群驱动的自主渗透测试工具
zh.what: Pentest-Swarm-AI 是一个基于 AI 代理集群的自主渗透测试工具，通过多个智能体并行执行侦察、分类、利用和报告生成。它支持漏洞赏金、持续监控和 CTF 模式，并利用 ReAct 推理协调工作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心引擎、多个 AI 代理模块、与 7 种以上安全工具的集成，以及演示和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Claude API 或 OpenAI 兼容模型，也可本地运行 Ollama/LM Studio，并集成多种安全工具。
zh.hot: 作为首个基于真实集群而非简单多代理的开源渗透测试工具，它解决了传统扫描器误报多和人工渗透成本高的问题，因此迅速获得关注。
uses: 安全团队进行持续监控和漏洞赏金，自动化渗透测试流程
CTF 玩家和红队成员快速模拟攻击并生成报告
开发者集成到 CI/CD 管道中，实现安全左移

en.tag: Autonomous pentesting powered by a swarm of AI agents
en.what: Pentest-Swarm-AI is an autonomous penetration testing tool powered by a swarm of AI agents, orchestrating recon, classification, exploitation, and reporting in parallel. It supports bug bounty, continuous monitoring, and CTF modes, using ReAct reasoning for coordination.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based core engine, multiple AI agent modules, integrations with 7+ security tools, plus demos and documentation.
en.stack: Built with Go, leveraging Claude API or OpenAI-compatible models, with local support for Ollama/LM Studio, and integrations with various security tools.
en.hot: As the first open-source pentesting tool built on a real swarm, not just sequential agents, it addresses scanner false positives and costly manual pentests, quickly gaining traction.
uses: Security teams for continuous monitoring and bug bounty, automating pentesting workflows
CTF players and red teamers to quickly simulate attacks and generate reports
Developers integrating into CI/CD pipelines for security shift-left

zh.tag: 用 Markdown 定义 AI 代理工作流，安全运行于 GitHub Actions
zh.what: gh-aw 是 GitHub 官方的 CLI 扩展，让开发者用 Markdown 加 YAML frontmatter 定义 AI 代理工作流，并编译为标准的 GitHub Actions 工作流。它用于需要推理或解释的任务，如问题分类、PR 审查、CI 失败调查等，补充而非替代传统 CI/CD。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 扩展源码、文档（快速开始、工作原理、安全指南）、示例工作流以及社区贡献。核心是编译命令 `gh aw compile`，将 Markdown 源文件转换为 GitHub Actions 执行的 `.lock.yml` 工作流。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，作为 GitHub CLI 扩展构建。内置 AI 引擎支持 GitHub Copilot、Claude Code、OpenAI Codex、Google Gemini 和 Pi，依赖 GitHub Actions 执行。
zh.hot: GitHub 官方出品，将 AI 代理与 Actions 安全结合，引发关注。本周新增 56 星，总星数近 5000，位列 Go 周榜第 19，反映开发者对 AI 自动化工作流的需求。
uses: 开发者希望用 AI 自动化仓库维护任务，如 issue 分类、PR 审查、CI 失败调查。
团队需要在现有 CI/CD 流程中安全引入 AI 代理，且不牺牲安全性和可控性。
对 GitHub Actions 熟悉，想探索 AI 代理工作流最佳实践的技术负责人。

en.tag: Define AI agent workflows in Markdown, run securely on GitHub Actions
en.what: gh-aw is an official GitHub CLI extension that lets developers define AI-powered repository automation in Markdown with YAML frontmatter, compiling each workflow into a standard GitHub Actions workflow. It handles tasks requiring reasoning or interpretation, such as issue triage, PR review, CI failure investigation, complementing rather than replacing traditional CI/CD.
en.content: The repository contains the CLI extension source, documentation (quick start, how it works, security), sample workflows, and community contributions. The core is the `gh aw compile` command that transforms Markdown source into `.lock.yml` workflows executed by GitHub Actions.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built as a GitHub CLI extension. Built-in AI engines include GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Gemini, and Pi, relying on GitHub Actions for execution.
en.hot: Official GitHub project combining AI agents with Actions securely, gaining traction. With 56 new stars this week and nearly 5k total, ranking #19 on Go weekly trending, it reflects developer demand for AI-driven automation workflows.
uses: Developers looking to automate repo maintenance tasks like issue triage, PR review, and CI failure investigation with AI.
Teams wanting to safely integrate AI agents into existing CI/CD pipelines without compromising security and control.
Tech leads familiar with GitHub Actions who want to explore best practices for AI agent workflows.

zh.tag: 复古终端音乐播放器，致敬 Winamp
zh.what: cliamp 是一款受 Winamp 启发的复古终端音乐播放器，支持播放本地文件、流媒体、播客、YouTube、Spotify 等众多来源。它提供频谱可视化、参数均衡器和播放列表管理，将现代音乐服务带入终端环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 Go 编写的完整播放器代码，基于 Bubbletea、Lip Gloss、Beep 和 go-librespot 构建。提供安装脚本、Homebrew、AUR、Nix 等多种安装方式，并附有文档和演示视频。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Charmbracelet 的 Bubbletea 和 Lip Gloss 构建 TUI，使用 Beep 处理音频，go-librespot 支持 Spotify。可选依赖包括 ffmpeg 和 yt-dlp 以扩展格式和平台支持。
zh.hot: 凭借对 Winamp 的怀旧情怀和强大的多平台支持，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，3.4k stars 且日增 61，登上 Go 趋势榜第 4 名。
uses: 终端爱好者：喜欢在终端中完成所有操作，追求极客风格的音乐播放体验。
多平台用户：需要统一播放本地、流媒体、播客等多种来源的音乐，且跨平台使用。
怀旧玩家：怀念 Winamp 的界面和功能，希望在终端中重现类似体验。

en.tag: Retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp
en.what: cliamp is a retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp, supporting local files, streams, podcasts, YouTube, Spotify, and more. It features a spectrum visualizer, parametric EQ, and playlist management, bringing modern music services to the terminal.
en.content: The repository contains the full player code written in Go, built with Bubbletea, Lip Gloss, Beep, and go-librespot. It offers multiple installation methods including script, Homebrew, AUR, Nix, and includes documentation and demo videos.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, using Charmbracelet's Bubbletea and Lip Gloss for the TUI, Beep for audio processing, and go-librespot for Spotify support. Optional dependencies include ffmpeg and yt-dlp for extended format and platform support.
en.hot: Riding on Winamp nostalgia and robust multi-platform support, it quickly gained traction with 3.4k stars and 61 daily additions, ranking #4 on the Go trending list.
uses: Terminal enthusiasts: enjoy doing everything in the terminal and seek a geeky music playback experience.
Multi-platform users: need a unified player for local files, streams, podcasts, etc., across different OSes.
Nostalgic users: miss Winamp's interface and features and want a similar experience in the terminal.

zh.tag: Go 语言实现的 WhatsApp 多设备 API 库
zh.what: whatsmeow 是一个用 Go 编写的库，用于与 WhatsApp 的 Web 多设备 API 交互。它允许开发者以编程方式发送和接收消息、管理群组、处理收据等，无需使用官方 WhatsApp Business API。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 库源码，提供丰富的 API 文档（godoc）和简单的使用示例。支持消息收发、群组管理、状态更新、已读回执等功能，并包含实验性的状态消息支持。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言，依赖 go.mau.fi/whatsmeow 模块，使用 WebSocket 与 WhatsApp 服务器通信，并利用 protobuf 进行消息序列化。
zh.hot: 作为 WhatsApp 非官方 API 的可靠选择，star 数达 7131，今日新增 9，位居 Go 趋势榜第 20 名。其活跃的社区和持续的功能更新吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者构建自定义 WhatsApp 聊天机器人或自动化工具，实现消息自动回复、群发通知等。
需要集成 WhatsApp 消息功能到现有 Go 后端服务的团队，用于客户支持或业务通知。
对 WhatsApp 协议感兴趣的研究者，可参考其实现来理解多设备 API 的工作原理。

en.tag: Go library for the WhatsApp web multidevice API
en.what: whatsmeow is a Go library for interacting with WhatsApp's Web multidevice API. It enables developers to programmatically send and receive messages, manage groups, handle receipts, and more, without using the official WhatsApp Business API.
en.content: The repository contains the full Go library source code, comprehensive API documentation (godoc), and a simple usage example. It supports messaging, group management, status updates, read receipts, and experimental status message support.
en.stack: Built with Go, depends on the go.mau.fi/whatsmeow module, communicates with WhatsApp servers via WebSocket, and uses protobuf for message serialization.
en.hot: As a reliable unofficial WhatsApp API, it has 7131 stars with 9 new today, ranking 20th on the Go trending list. Its active community and continuous feature updates attract many developers.
uses: Developers building custom WhatsApp chatbots or automation tools for auto-replies, bulk notifications, etc.
Teams integrating WhatsApp messaging into existing Go backends for customer support or business alerts.
Researchers interested in the WhatsApp protocol, using the implementation to understand the multidevice API.

zh.tag: 命令行下载 iOS App 的 ipa 包工具
zh.what: ipatool 是一个命令行工具，允许用户从 App Store 搜索 iOS 应用并下载其 ipa 包。它支持认证、搜索、购买授权和列出可用版本等操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具源码，提供 auth、search、purchase、list-versions 等子命令，支持文本和 JSON 输出格式。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Apple 的 App Store API，支持跨平台（Windows、Linux、macOS），可通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 尽管今日新增 star 不多，但累计近万星，因其为开发者提供了便捷的 ipa 下载途径，在逆向工程和应用分发场景中广受欢迎。
uses: iOS 开发者需要获取 ipa 包进行测试或分析
安全研究人员分析应用安全性或进行逆向工程
需要批量下载应用包以用于存档或分发

en.tag: CLI tool to search and download iOS app ipa packages
en.what: ipatool is a command-line tool that allows users to search for iOS apps on the App Store and download their ipa packages. It supports authentication, search, purchase licensing, and listing available versions.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of a Go-based CLI tool with subcommands like auth, search, purchase, and list-versions, supporting text and JSON output formats.
en.stack: Developed in Go, relies on Apple's App Store API, cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macOS), installable via Homebrew.
en.hot: Despite modest daily star growth, it has nearly 10k stars, popular among developers for convenient ipa downloading, especially in reverse engineering and app distribution.

Security researchers analyzing app security or reverse engineering
