zh.tag: 跨语言内存列式格式与数据交换工具箱
zh.what: Apache Arrow 是一种跨语言的列式内存格式，用于高效的数据交换和内存分析。它提供了一套标准化的数据表示和通信协议，使不同系统之间能够快速、零拷贝地共享数据。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Arrow 列式格式规范、IPC 序列化格式、Flight RPC 协议，以及 C++、Python、Java 等多种语言的库实现。还包含 Gandiva 表达式编译器和 ADBC 数据库连接标准。
zh.stack: 核心实现以 C++ 为主，并提供了 C/GLib、.NET、Go、Java、JavaScript、Julia、Python 等多种语言绑定。依赖 LLVM 用于 Gandiva 表达式编译。
zh.hot: 作为大数据生态的基础组件，Arrow 被众多项目采用，持续获得稳定关注。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但其 17k+ 的 star 数反映了长期的高认可度。
uses: 数据工程师：用于构建高性能数据管道，实现跨系统零拷贝数据共享。
数据分析师：利用 Arrow 加速内存分析，提升查询性能。
数据库开发者：集成 Arrow 格式以支持高效列式存储和查询。
机器学习平台：使用 Arrow 作为特征存储和模型推理的数据交换格式。

en.tag: Universal columnar format and multi-language toolbox for fast data interchange and in-memory analytics
en.what: Apache Arrow is a cross-language columnar in-memory format for efficient data interchange and in-memory analytics. It provides a standardized data representation and communication protocols, enabling fast, zero-copy data sharing between different systems.
en.content: The repository contains the Arrow columnar format specification, IPC serialization format, Flight RPC protocol, and library implementations in multiple languages including C++, Python, Java, and more. It also includes the Gandiva expression compiler and the ADBC database connectivity standard.
en.stack: Core implementation is in C++, with bindings for C/GLib, .NET, Go, Java, JavaScript, Julia, Python, and more. It depends on LLVM for the Gandiva expression compiler.
en.hot: As a foundational component in the big data ecosystem, Arrow is widely adopted by many projects, maintaining steady attention. Despite modest daily star gains, its 17k+ stars reflect long-term high recognition.
uses: Data engineers: build high-performance data pipelines with zero-copy data sharing across systems.
Data analysts: accelerate in-memory analytics and improve query performance using Arrow.
Database developers: integrate Arrow format for efficient columnar storage and querying.
ML platforms: use Arrow as the data interchange format for feature stores and model inference.

zh.tag: 一键式摄影测量 GUI，轻松生成 3D 模型
zh.what: 这是一个基于 Flutter 的图形界面工具，简化了摄影测量流程。用户只需选择图像文件夹和输出文件夹，即可自动生成带纹理的 3D 模型（textured.obj）。它封装了 COLMAP 和 OpenMVS 等复杂工具，让非专业用户也能轻松使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Flutter 前端界面、Python 脚本（用于图像缩放和网格简化）、以及 Linux 编译脚本（Docker/AppImage）。支持 Windows、Linux 和 Nix 构建，并提供 CUDA 和 CPU 两种运行模式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++（底层工具）和 Dart（Flutter 界面），依赖 COLMAP、OpenMVS、OpenCV 等摄影测量库，以及 Python 脚本（pyinstaller 打包）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 76 星，登上 C++ 趋势榜第 4。它让摄影测量变得像点击按钮一样简单，吸引了大量对 3D 建模感兴趣但不想折腾命令行工具的用户。
uses: 3D 建模爱好者：无需编程基础，快速将照片集转换为可用的 3D 模型。
考古与文物保护：用于记录文物或遗址，生成数字化档案。
游戏与影视开发：快速生成真实物体的 3D 资产，用于场景搭建。
教育科研：在课堂上演示摄影测量原理，或用于科研项目的初步建模。

en.tag: One-click photogrammetry GUI for easy 3D model generation
en.what: This is a Flutter-based GUI tool that simplifies the photogrammetry workflow. Users just select an image folder and an output folder to automatically generate a textured 3D model (textured.obj). It wraps complex tools like COLMAP and OpenMVS, making it accessible to non-experts.
en.content: The repo includes a Flutter frontend, Python scripts for image resizing and mesh decimation, and Linux build scripts (Docker/AppImage). It supports Windows, Linux, and Nix builds, with both CUDA and CPU variants.
en.stack: Primarily C++ (underlying tools) and Dart (Flutter UI), relying on photogrammetry libraries like COLMAP, OpenMVS, OpenCV, plus Python scripts packaged with PyInstaller.
en.hot: Gained 76 stars today, ranking #4 on the C++ trending list. It makes photogrammetry as simple as clicking a button, attracting many users interested in 3D modeling who don't want to deal with command-line tools.
uses: 3D modeling enthusiasts: convert photo sets into usable 3D models without programming skills.
Archaeology and cultural heritage: digitize artifacts or sites for archival purposes.
Game and film development: quickly generate 3D assets of real objects for scene creation.
Education and research: demonstrate photogrammetry principles in class or for initial modeling in research projects.

zh.tag: Google 开源的端到端机器学习框架与生态平台
zh.what: TensorFlow 是 Google 开发的端到端开源机器学习平台，提供从研究到生产部署的完整工具链与库生态。它让研究者能够推进机器学习前沿，也让开发者轻松构建和部署 AI 驱动的应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 运行时、Python 与 C++ API、Keras 高级接口，以及 TensorFlow Lite、TensorFlow.js 等跨平台推理部署工具和丰富的官方示例。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 构建高性能计算后端，通过 Python 提供主要前端接口；支持 CUDA GPU 加速、Bazel 构建系统及 Docker 部署，并提供多语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为深度学习领域最具影响力的基础框架之一，TensorFlow 凭借 196,329 星（本周新增 365 颗）和工业级稳定性，持续获得学术界与工业界的广泛采用。
uses: 机器学习研究者 —— 需要灵活底层接口进行模型创新与算法实验
AI 应用开发者 —— 希望借助 Keras 和 TF Lite 快速训练并部署到端侧或服务器
工程团队 —— 寻求从训练到推理的规模化、可移植生产流水线
高校学生 —— 学习深度学习原理与工程实践的首选框架之一

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open-source ML framework and ecosystem
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open-source machine learning platform developed by Google, offering a comprehensive toolchain and library ecosystem from research to production. It enables researchers to push the state-of-the-art in ML while allowing developers to easily build and deploy AI-powered applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ runtime, Python and C++ APIs, the Keras high-level interface, plus cross-platform deployment tools like TensorFlow Lite and TensorFlow.js along with extensive official examples.
en.stack: Built on C++ for a high-performance compute backend with Python as the primary frontend; it supports CUDA GPU acceleration, Bazel builds, Docker deployment, and multi-language bindings.
en.hot: As one of the most influential foundational deep-learning frameworks, TensorFlow maintains strong momentum with 196,329 stars and 365 new stars this week, reflecting broad academic and industrial adoption for its production-grade stability.
uses: ML researchers —— who need flexible low-level APIs for model innovation and algorithmic experiments
AI application developers —— looking to quickly train and deploy models to mobile, edge, or server via Keras and TF Lite
Engineering teams —— seeking scalable, portable production pipelines from training to inference
Students and educators —— using it as a primary framework to learn deep-learning concepts and engineering practices

zh.tag: 英特尔开源 AI 推理优化与部署工具包
zh.what: OpenVINO 是一个开源工具包，用于优化和部署深度学习模型，提升推理性能。它支持多种主流框架（如 PyTorch、TensorFlow、ONNX）的模型转换与部署，并覆盖从边缘到云的多种硬件平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理引擎、模型优化工具、文档、教程以及 Python/C++/Node.js 等语言的 API 绑定。还提供与 Hugging Face Optimum Intel 的集成，便于直接部署 transformers 和 diffusers 模型。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Python、C++、Node.js 等 API。依赖 CMake、ONNX、TensorFlow 等，并支持 Intel CPU、GPU、NPU 等硬件加速。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 推理需求激增，OpenVINO 作为成熟的优化工具持续获得关注。今日新增 12 星，总星数达 10726，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 4，体现其在开发者社区中的稳定热度。
uses: AI 应用开发者：优化模型推理性能，降低延迟和资源消耗。
边缘计算工程师：在资源受限的设备上高效部署深度学习模型。
研究学者：快速将 PyTorch/TensorFlow 模型转换并部署到多种硬件。
企业团队：利用 OpenVINO 实现从云端到边缘的统一推理方案。

en.tag: Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
en.what: OpenVINO is an open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning models, boosting inference performance. It supports model conversion and deployment from popular frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and ONNX, and runs on a wide range of platforms from edge to cloud.
en.content: The repository contains the core inference engine, model optimization tools, documentation, tutorials, and API bindings for Python, C++, and Node.js. It also integrates with Hugging Face Optimum Intel for direct deployment of transformers and diffusers models.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with APIs for Python, C++, and Node.js. It relies on CMake, ONNX, TensorFlow, and supports acceleration on Intel CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs.
en.hot: With the surge in AI inference demand, OpenVINO remains a mature optimization tool. Gaining 12 stars today, it reached 10,726 total stars and ranked 4th on the C++ trending list, reflecting steady popularity among developers.
uses: AI app developers: optimize model inference performance, reducing latency and resource usage.
Edge computing engineers: efficiently deploy deep learning models on resource-constrained devices.
Researchers: quickly convert and deploy PyTorch/TensorFlow models across various hardware.
Enterprise teams: leverage OpenVINO for unified inference solutions from cloud to edge.

zh.tag: CUDA 高性能线性代数模板库与 Python DSL
zh.what: CUTLASS 是 NVIDIA 开源的 CUDA 抽象集合，用于实现高性能矩阵乘法（GEMM）及相关计算，覆盖从底层硬件到上层应用的所有层级。它提供分层分解和数据移动策略，将复杂内核拆解为可复用的模块化组件，并支持多种数据类型和架构。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 模板库、CuTe DSL（Python 领域特定语言）、示例代码（如 GEMM 分解图）以及针对 Volta 到 Blackwell 架构的优化内核。
zh.stack: 基于 CUDA C++ 模板，支持 FP64/FP32/TF32/FP16/BF16/FP8/块缩放/窄整数/二进制等数据类型，并集成 Python DSL（CuTe DSL）以简化开发。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA 官方高性能计算库，CUTLASS 是 GPU 内核开发的基石，star 数超 1 万，今日新增 7 星，排名 C++ 日榜第五，持续受到性能工程师和 AI 研究者的关注。
uses: GPU 性能工程师：用于优化深度学习推理和训练中的矩阵运算，提升效率。
AI 研究人员：借助 CuTe DSL 快速原型设计新内核，无需深入 C++ 细节。
学生与教育者：学习 CUDA 编程和 GPU 架构的绝佳资源，降低入门门槛。
框架开发者：集成到 PyTorch 等框架中，无需编写胶水代码即可获得高性能内核。

en.tag: CUDA templates & Python DSLs for high-performance linear algebra
en.what: CUTLASS is NVIDIA's open-source collection of CUDA abstractions for high-performance matrix multiplication (GEMM) and related computations across all levels and scales. It decomposes complex kernels into reusable modular components with hierarchical decomposition and data movement strategies, supporting diverse data types and architectures.
en.content: The repo contains C++ template library, CuTe DSL (Python domain-specific language), examples (e.g., GEMM decomposition diagram), and optimized kernels for Volta to Blackwell architectures.
en.stack: Built on CUDA C++ templates, supporting FP64/FP32/TF32/FP16/BF16/FP8/block-scaled/narrow-int/binary data types, with Python DSL (CuTe DSL) for simplified development.
en.hot: As NVIDIA's official high-performance computing library, CUTLASS is a cornerstone for GPU kernel development, with 10k+ stars and 7 new today, ranking #5 on C++ daily trending, consistently attracting performance engineers and AI researchers.
uses: GPU performance engineers: optimize matrix operations in deep learning inference and training for higher efficiency.
AI researchers: leverage CuTe DSL for rapid prototyping of new kernels without deep C++ expertise.
Students and educators: an excellent resource for learning CUDA programming and GPU architecture, lowering the entry barrier.
Framework developers: integrate into frameworks like PyTorch to obtain high-performance kernels without glue code.

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 测试与模拟框架
zh.what: GoogleTest 是 Google 的 C++ 测试框架，用于编写和运行单元测试。它支持自动测试发现、丰富的断言、死亡测试、参数化测试等，并集成了 GoogleMock 用于模拟对象。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GoogleTest 和 GoogleMock 的源码、文档、示例以及构建配置。文档托管在 GitHub Pages 上，提供用户指南和入门教程。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，要求 C++17 或更高版本（1.18.x 分支）。计划依赖 Abseil 库。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方测试框架，拥有近 3.9 万 Star，是 C++ 社区的事实标准，持续维护并发布新版本。
uses: C++ 开发者编写单元测试，确保代码质量
需要模拟对象进行依赖隔离的测试场景
在 CI/CD 流程中集成自动化测试
学习 xUnit 测试框架设计的最佳实践

en.tag: Google's official C++ testing and mocking framework
en.what: GoogleTest is Google's C++ testing framework for writing and running unit tests. It supports automatic test discovery, rich assertions, death tests, parameterized tests, and integrates GoogleMock for mocking.
en.content: The repository contains source code, documentation, examples, and build configuration for GoogleTest and GoogleMock. Docs are hosted on GitHub Pages with user guide and primer.
en.stack: Built on C++, requires C++17 or later (1.18.x branch). Plans to depend on Abseil.
en.hot: As Google's official testing framework, it has nearly 39k stars, is the de facto standard in C++ community, and is actively maintained with new releases.
uses: C++ developers writing unit tests to ensure code quality
Scenarios requiring mocking objects for dependency isolation
Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Learning best practices of xUnit test framework design

zh.tag: 生产级系统追踪与性能分析套件
zh.what: Perfetto 是一套开源的追踪、性能分析和调试工具，帮助开发者理解复杂系统的行为并定位功能与性能问题。它是 Android 操作系统和 Chromium 浏览器的默认追踪系统。
zh.content: 包含高性能追踪守护进程、低开销 C++17 SDK、丰富的 OS 级探针、基于浏览器的可视化 UI 以及 SQL 分析引擎。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SQLite 作为分析引擎，前端为 Web 技术（如 WebAssembly）。
zh.hot: 作为 Android 和 Chrome 的官方追踪工具，Perfetto 在开发者社区中拥有广泛影响力，star 数持续增长，成为性能分析领域的标准选择。
uses: Android 应用开发者：定位启动慢、掉帧、卡顿、内存不足等性能问题。
C/C++ 开发者：使用 Tracing SDK 自定义埋点，分析执行流程和性能瓶颈。
Linux 内核与系统开发者：深入分析调度、系统调用、中断等内核行为。
性能工程师与 SRE：用 SQL 分析多种追踪格式，自动化提取指标。

en.tag: Production-grade system tracing and performance analysis suite
en.what: Perfetto is an open-source suite for tracing, profiling, and debugging, helping developers understand complex system behavior and root-cause functional and performance issues. It is the default tracing system for Android and Chromium.
en.content: Includes high-performance tracing daemons, a low-overhead C++17 SDK, extensive OS-level probes, a browser-based UI, and a SQL-based analysis engine.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, uses SQLite for analysis, and the frontend is web-based (e.g., WebAssembly).
en.hot: As the official tracing tool for Android and Chrome, Perfetto has broad influence in the developer community, with steady star growth, becoming a standard in performance analysis.
uses: Android app developers: diagnose slow startup, jank, memory issues, and ANRs.
C/C++ developers: instrument custom trace points to analyze execution flow and bottlenecks.
Linux kernel and system developers: gain deep insights into scheduling, syscalls, and interrupts.
Performance engineers and SREs: use SQL to analyze various trace formats and automate metric extraction.

zh.tag: Matter 智能家居互联标准的开源参考实现
zh.what: connectedhomeip 是 Matter（原 Project CHIP）标准的开源 SDK，旨在统一智能家居设备的连接协议，让不同品牌的设备能够无缝协作。它由 Connectivity Standards Alliance 指导，为制造商提供开发工具，为消费者提升兼容性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Matter 协议栈实现、跨平台示例应用（如 ESP32、EFR32、Linux 等）、测试套件、构建脚本和文档，以及持续集成配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，并支持多种平台和工具链，包括 Android、Darwin、FreeRTOS、Zephyr 等，依赖 GN 构建系统和 Pigweed 等库。
zh.hot: 作为 Matter 标准的官方参考实现，它吸引了大量智能家居开发者的关注，虽然本周新增 star 不多，但长期保持高热度，是行业标准的关键推动者。
uses: 智能家居设备制造商：基于 Matter SDK 开发兼容设备，确保跨品牌互操作性
嵌入式开发者：参考示例代码，快速在 ESP32、EFR32 等平台上实现 Matter 支持
测试与认证机构：利用测试套件验证设备是否符合 Matter 规范

en.tag: Open-source reference implementation of the Matter smart home standard
en.what: connectedhomeip is the open-source SDK for the Matter standard (formerly Project CHIP), aiming to unify smart home device connectivity protocols for seamless interoperability across brands. Guided by the Connectivity Standards Alliance, it simplifies development for manufacturers and enhances compatibility for consumers.
en.content: The repository contains the full Matter protocol stack implementation, cross-platform example apps (e.g., ESP32, EFR32, Linux), test suites, build scripts, documentation, and CI configurations.
en.stack: Primarily C++, supporting multiple platforms and toolchains including Android, Darwin, FreeRTOS, Zephyr, with dependencies on the GN build system and Pigweed libraries.
en.hot: As the official reference implementation of the Matter standard, it attracts significant attention from smart home developers. Despite modest weekly star growth, it maintains high long-term popularity as a key driver of the industry standard.
uses: Smart home device manufacturers: Develop compatible devices using the Matter SDK to ensure cross-brand interoperability
Embedded developers: Reference example code to quickly implement Matter support on platforms like ESP32, EFR32
Testing and certification bodies: Use test suites to verify device compliance with the Matter specification

zh.tag: 跨平台高性能机器学习推理与训练加速器
zh.what: ONNX Runtime 是一个跨平台的机器学习推理和训练加速器，支持 PyTorch、TensorFlow/Keras 等深度学习框架以及 scikit-learn、LightGBM、XGBoost 等经典机器学习库。它通过硬件加速器、图优化和变换，在不同硬件、驱动和操作系统上提供最佳性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ONNX Runtime 的完整源代码、文档、示例和发布版本，以及用于推理和训练的示例仓库和插件执行提供程序（如 QNN）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种语言绑定（如 Python、C#、Java），并依赖 ONNX 格式和硬件加速库（如 CUDA、TensorRT）。
zh.hot: 作为微软开源的跨平台推理引擎，ONNX Runtime 在 AI 部署领域具有重要地位，本月新增 306 星，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 需要在多种硬件（CPU、GPU、NPU）上部署机器学习模型的开发者
希望加速 PyTorch 或 TensorFlow 模型推理的工程团队
需要跨平台（Windows、Linux、macOS）统一推理解决方案的企业
研究模型优化和硬件加速的 AI 基础设施工程师

en.tag: Cross-platform, high-performance ML inference and training accelerator
en.what: ONNX Runtime is a cross-platform inference and training accelerator for machine learning, supporting models from deep learning frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow/Keras, as well as classical ML libraries such as scikit-learn, LightGBM, and XGBoost. It leverages hardware accelerators, graph optimizations, and transforms to deliver optimal performance across various hardware, drivers, and operating systems.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and releases for ONNX Runtime, along with companion sample repositories for inference and training, and plugin execution providers like QNN.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with bindings for multiple languages (e.g., Python, C#, Java), and relies on the ONNX format and hardware acceleration libraries (e.g., CUDA, TensorRT).
en.hot: As Microsoft's open-source cross-platform inference engine, ONNX Runtime holds a key position in AI deployment, gaining 306 stars this month and continuing to attract developer attention.
uses: Developers deploying ML models on diverse hardware (CPU, GPU, NPU)
Engineering teams looking to accelerate PyTorch or TensorFlow model inference
Enterprises needing a unified cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macOS) inference solution
AI infrastructure engineers researching model optimization and hardware acceleration

zh.tag: Google 开源 C++ 通用库，补充标准库
zh.what: Abseil 是 Google 内部 C++ 代码库的开源版本，提供标准库缺失或替代的组件，如字符串处理、容器、时间、智能指针等。它经过大规模生产环境测试，旨在补充而非竞争标准库。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个模块，如 base、algorithm、cleanup、container、time 等，每个模块对应一个子目录，提供独立的库组件。
zh.stack: C++17 编写，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建系统，依赖 C++ 标准库。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方库，拥有 18.1k stars，是 C++ 开发者的基础依赖，长期稳定增长。
uses: C++ 开发者：需要标准库之外的高质量工具，如字符串、时间、容器等。
项目维护者：希望引入经过大规模测试的库，减少自研代码。
学习 C++ 最佳实践：参考 Google 内部代码风格和设计。

en.tag: Google's open-source C++ common libraries augmenting the standard library
en.what: Abseil is the open-source collection of C++ libraries from Google's internal codebase, providing components missing from or alternative to the standard library, such as string handling, containers, time, and smart pointers. It is extensively tested in production and aims to augment, not compete with, the standard library.
en.content: The repository contains multiple modules such as base, algorithm, cleanup, container, time, each in a subdirectory, providing independent library components.
en.stack: Written in C++17, supports Bazel and CMake build systems, depends on the C++ standard library.
en.hot: As an official Google library with 18.1k stars, it's a fundamental dependency for C++ developers, showing steady long-term growth.
uses: C++ developers needing high-quality utilities beyond the standard library, such as strings, time, and containers.
Project maintainers wanting to adopt battle-tested libraries to reduce custom code.
Learners seeking best practices in C++ design and style from Google's internal codebase.

zh.tag: C++ 即时模式 GUI 库，轻量无依赖
zh.what: Dear ImGui 是一个面向 C++ 的轻量级图形用户界面库，采用即时模式设计，输出优化的顶点缓冲，可在 3D 渲染管线中随时绘制。它旨在快速迭代，为程序员打造内容创作工具和可视化/调试工具，而非面向终端用户的传统 UI。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Dear ImGui 源代码、示例、文档（README、Wiki）、扩展列表、语言绑定和框架后端，以及测试引擎。核心是自包含的，无外部依赖。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，无外部依赖，支持多种渲染后端（如 OpenGL、DirectX、Vulkan）和平台（如 GLFW、SDL）。
zh.hot: 拥有 75,862 星，是 C++ 社区最受欢迎的 GUI 库之一，因其轻量、高效和灵活性被广泛用于游戏开发和工具开发。
uses: 游戏开发中的调试工具和编辑器界面，如场景编辑器、属性面板。
内容创作工具，如关卡编辑器、动画工具、数据可视化面板。
需要快速迭代的原型开发，尤其是图形和交互式应用。
嵌入式系统或性能敏感环境中的轻量 UI 需求。

en.tag: Bloat-free immediate-mode GUI library for C++ with minimal dependencies
en.what: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free graphical user interface library for C++, using an immediate-mode design that outputs optimized vertex buffers for rendering in any 3D-pipeline-enabled application. It enables fast iterations and empowers programmers to create content creation tools and visualization/debug tools, rather than traditional UI for end users.
en.content: The repository contains the full Dear ImGui source code, examples, documentation (README, Wiki), extensions list, language bindings and framework backends, and a test engine. The core is self-contained with no external dependencies.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with no external dependencies, supporting multiple rendering backends (OpenGL, DirectX, Vulkan) and platforms (GLFW, SDL).
en.hot: With 75,862 stars, it's one of the most popular GUI libraries in the C++ community, widely used in game development and tooling for its lightweight, efficient, and flexible nature.
uses: Debug tools and editor interfaces in game development, such as scene editors and property panels.
Content creation tools like level editors, animation tools, and data visualization panels.
Rapid prototyping in graphics and interactive applications.
Lightweight UI needs in embedded systems or performance-sensitive environments.

zh.tag: 微软官方 WinUI 现代 Windows UI 框架
zh.what: WinUI 是微软推出的现代 UI 框架，提供丰富的控件和样式，用于构建高性能的 Windows 应用程序。当前版本 WinUI 3 作为 Windows App SDK 的一部分发布，支持 Fluent Design，并可通过 .NET 或 C++ 开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WinUI 的源代码、文档、示例和 WinUI 3 Gallery 交互式演示，涵盖控件库、样式、工具和迁移指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，基于 Windows App SDK，支持 C#/.NET 和 C++ 开发，面向 x86、x64 和 ARM 架构。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方 UI 框架，WinUI 是 Windows 应用开发的核心，本月新增 140 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 5，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: Windows 桌面应用开发者，希望使用现代 Fluent Design 构建应用
需要跨版本兼容（Windows 10 1809+）的 Win32 或 UWP 开发者
学习微软官方 UI 框架和 Windows App SDK 的学生或爱好者

en.tag: Microsoft's official WinUI framework for modern Windows apps
en.what: WinUI is Microsoft's modern UI framework with a rich set of controls and styles for building high-performance Windows apps. The current version, WinUI 3, ships as part of the Windows App SDK, embracing Fluent Design and supporting development with .NET or C++.
en.content: The repo contains the source code, documentation, samples, and the WinUI 3 Gallery interactive demo, covering control libraries, styles, tools, and migration guides.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, built on the Windows App SDK, supporting C#/.NET and C++ development for x86, x64, and ARM architectures.
en.hot: As Microsoft's official UI framework, WinUI is central to Windows app development, gaining 140 stars this month and ranking 5th in the C++ monthly trending, showing sustained developer interest.
uses: Windows desktop app developers wanting modern Fluent Design
Win32 or UWP developers needing cross-version compatibility (Windows 10 1809+)
Students or enthusiasts learning Microsoft's official UI framework and Windows App SDK

zh.tag: 原生高性能桌面命令面板，支持 Raycast 生态扩展
zh.what: Vicinae 是一个面向桌面的原生命令面板，提供应用搜索、剪贴板历史、文本扩展、文件搜索、浏览器标签切换、表情选择、计算器、窗口切换等功能。它支持通过 React/TypeScript 扩展、脚本命令和 dmenu 风格菜单进行扩展，兼容 Raycast 生态。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心源码、文档（docs 目录）、扩展示例、截图和品牌资源。项目采用模块化设计，支持通过 Vicinae 商店和 Raycast 商店安装扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，扩展支持 React/TypeScript，兼容 Raycast 扩展 API。依赖包括 CMake、Node.js 等构建工具。
zh.hot: 凭借 9130 颗星和今日新增 77 颗，Vicinae 在 C++ 日榜排名第 12。其原生性能与 Raycast 生态兼容性吸引开发者，成为桌面效率工具的热门选择。
uses: 桌面用户寻求快速启动应用、搜索文件和管理剪贴板的一体化工具
开发者希望使用 React/TypeScript 构建自定义扩展，并复用 Raycast 生态
Linux 用户偏好 dmenu 风格的轻量级菜单交互

en.tag: Native high-performance desktop command palette with Raycast-compatible extensions
en.what: Vicinae is a native command palette for the desktop, offering app search, clipboard history, text expansion, file search, browser tab switching, emoji picking, calculator, and window switching. It can be extended via React/TypeScript extensions, script commands, and dmenu-style menus, compatible with the Raycast ecosystem.
en.content: The repository contains C++ core source code, documentation (docs directory), extension examples, screenshots, and branding assets. The project is modular, supporting extensions from both the Vicinae store and the Raycast store.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with extensions in React/TypeScript, compatible with Raycast's extension API. Build dependencies include CMake, Node.js, etc.
en.hot: With 9,130 stars and 77 added today, Vicinae ranks #12 on the C++ daily trending list. Its native performance and Raycast ecosystem compatibility attract developers, making it a popular desktop productivity tool.
uses: Desktop users seeking an all-in-one tool for quick app launching, file search, and clipboard management
Developers who want to build custom extensions with React/TypeScript and reuse the Raycast ecosystem
Linux users who prefer dmenu-style lightweight menu interactions

zh.tag: 在 Windows 上原生运行 Linux 的官方工具
zh.what: WSL 是微软官方推出的 Windows 子系统，允许用户直接在 Windows 上运行未经修改的 Linux 命令行工具、实用程序和应用程序，无需传统虚拟机或双系统。它通过轻量级虚拟化技术提供完整的 Linux 内核兼容层，支持主流发行版。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WSL 的源代码、构建脚本、文档（如贡献指南、开发者文档）以及相关子仓库的链接（如 WSL2-Linux-Kernel 和 WSLg）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Windows 内核接口和 Linux 内核（通过 WSL2-Linux-Kernel 子仓库），支持 PowerShell 命令行安装。
zh.hot: WSL 是开发者必备工具，拥有 3.3 万+ 星标，今日新增 12 星，持续活跃。它消除了 Windows 和 Linux 之间的壁垒，极大提升了开发效率。
uses: Windows 开发者：无需虚拟机即可使用 Linux 命令行工具和脚本，进行开发、测试和部署。
跨平台开发团队：在 Windows 上统一开发环境，同时利用 Linux 生态的包管理器和工具链。
学习 Linux 的用户：通过 WSL 快速体验 Linux 环境，无需安装双系统或虚拟机。

en.tag: Run Linux natively on Windows without a VM
en.what: WSL is Microsoft's official subsystem that lets you run unmodified Linux command-line tools, utilities, and apps directly on Windows without a traditional VM or dual-boot setup. It provides a lightweight virtualization layer with full Linux kernel compatibility, supporting major distributions.
en.content: The repo contains WSL's source code, build scripts, documentation (e.g., contributing guide, developer docs), and links to related sub-repos like WSL2-Linux-Kernel and WSLg.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on Windows kernel interfaces and the Linux kernel (via the WSL2-Linux-Kernel sub-repo), installable via PowerShell command.
en.hot: WSL is a must-have for developers, with 33k+ stars and steady daily additions (12 today). It bridges Windows and Linux, boosting productivity significantly.
uses: Windows developers: Use Linux command-line tools and scripts without a VM for development, testing, and deployment.
Cross-platform teams: Unify dev environments on Windows while leveraging Linux package managers and toolchains.
Linux learners: Quickly experience a Linux environment via WSL without dual-booting or using a VM.

zh.tag: 华为昇腾上的 vLLM 硬件插件
zh.what: vllm-ascend 是 vLLM 官方社区维护的插件，让 vLLM 推理引擎能在华为昇腾（Ascend）AI 加速器上运行。它提供与昇腾硬件适配的算子、图模式和运行时支持，使用户可以无缝使用 vLLM 的高性能推理能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含插件源码、昇腾支持矩阵、官方文档、示例和发布版本。主要目录包括 vllm_ascend 核心实现、docs 文档、examples 示例等。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 和 Python，依赖 vLLM 和华为 CANN（昇腾计算架构）。使用 PyTorch 和自定义算子实现昇腾加速。
zh.hot: 随着昇腾芯片在国产 AI 基础设施中广泛应用，vLLM 用户对昇腾支持的需求激增。该项目作为官方插件，star 数已达 2703，今日新增 11，登上 C++ 趋势榜，反映出社区对国产硬件生态的强烈关注。
uses: 在华为昇腾服务器上部署 vLLM 推理服务的开发者
需要国产化 AI 硬件替代方案的云服务商和企业
研究昇腾性能优化和算子适配的 AI 工程师

en.tag: Hardware plugin for vLLM on Huawei Ascend
en.what: vllm-ascend is a community-maintained plugin that enables vLLM inference engine to run on Huawei Ascend AI accelerators. It provides Ascend-specific operators, graph modes, and runtime support, allowing users to leverage vLLM's high-performance inference capabilities seamlessly.
en.content: The repository contains plugin source code, Ascend support matrix, official documentation, examples, and release versions. Key directories include vllm_ascend core implementation, docs, and examples.
en.stack: Built with C++ and Python, depends on vLLM and Huawei CANN (Ascend Computing Architecture). Uses PyTorch and custom operators for Ascend acceleration.
en.hot: As Ascend chips gain traction in domestic AI infrastructure, vLLM users demand Ascend support. This official plugin has 2.7k stars with 11 new today, trending in C++ list, reflecting strong community interest in domestic hardware ecosystem.
uses: Developers deploying vLLM inference on Huawei Ascend servers
Cloud providers and enterprises seeking domestic AI hardware alternatives
AI engineers researching Ascend performance optimization and operator adaptation

zh.tag: 基于 Citra 的开源 3DS 模拟器，合并两大分支
zh.what: Azahar 是一个开源的 3DS 模拟器项目，基于 Citra 开发，由 PabloMK7 的 Citra 分支和 Lime3DS 项目合并而成。它旨在成为未来 3DS 模拟开发的主要平台，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Android 等多个平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器的完整源代码，包括核心模拟逻辑、图形渲染、音频处理、用户界面以及针对不同平台的构建配置。提供安装程序、压缩包和 APK 等多种发布形式，并支持 Google Play 和 Flathub 分发。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Qt 框架（用于界面）、OpenGL/Vulkan（图形）、FFmpeg（音频/视频）等。支持 CMake 构建系统，并针对 Windows、macOS、Linux 和 Android 进行适配。
zh.hot: 在 Citra 被下架后，社区迅速分裂出多个分支，Azahar 合并两大主流分支，成为社区焦点。Star 数接近 8000，并在 GitHub Trending 上排名靠前，反映出玩家对 3DS 模拟的持续热情。
uses: 3DS 游戏玩家：在 PC 或 Android 上畅玩 3DS 游戏，享受高分辨率渲染和增强功能。
模拟器开发爱好者：研究 3DS 模拟技术，参与开源贡献，改进兼容性和性能。
怀旧游戏收藏者：通过模拟器保存和体验经典 3DS 游戏，避免硬件老化问题。

en.tag: Open-source 3DS emulator based on Citra, merging two major forks
en.what: Azahar is an open-source 3DS emulator project based on Citra, created from the merge of PabloMK7's Citra fork and the Lime3DS project. It aims to be the de-facto platform for future development, supporting Windows, macOS, and Android.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the emulator, including core emulation logic, graphics rendering, audio processing, user interface, and build configurations for different platforms. It provides releases as installers, archives, and APKs, with distribution via Google Play and Flathub.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it relies on Qt framework for UI, OpenGL/Vulkan for graphics, FFmpeg for audio/video, and uses CMake as the build system, with adaptations for Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.
en.hot: After Citra was taken down, the community split into multiple forks, and Azahar merged two major forks, becoming a focal point. With nearly 8k stars and a high rank on GitHub Trending, it reflects the ongoing enthusiasm for 3DS emulation.
uses: 3DS gamers: Play 3DS games on PC or Android with high-resolution rendering and enhancements.
Emulator developers: Study 3DS emulation techniques, contribute to open source, and improve compatibility and performance.
Retro game collectors: Preserve and experience classic 3DS games via emulation, avoiding hardware aging issues.

zh.tag: 回合制末日生存游戏，深度模拟与开放世界
zh.what: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead 是一款设定在末日后的回合制生存游戏。玩家需要在严酷、持久、程序生成的世界中挣扎求生，搜刮资源、对抗各种怪物和其他幸存者。游戏以其极高的复杂度和自由度著称。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的游戏源代码、文档（如编译指南）、数据文件（包括 tileset 截图）以及多平台打包配置。游戏支持 Ncurses 和图形 tiles 版本，并有稳定版和实验版发布。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SDL 等库用于图形界面，支持跨平台（Linux、macOS、Windows、BSD）。构建系统包括 Makefile 和 CMake。
zh.hot: 作为一款长期维护的开源游戏，拥有 13k+ stars，今日新增 11 星，位列 C++ 日榜第 17。其深度模拟和持续更新吸引大量玩家和贡献者。
uses: 喜欢深度模拟和开放世界生存游戏的玩家，可以体验极高的自由度和复杂性。
对游戏开发感兴趣的开发者，可以学习大型 C++ 项目的架构和社区协作模式。
寻找可扩展 mod 平台的玩家，游戏支持丰富的模组和自定义内容。

en.tag: Turn-based post-apocalyptic survival game with deep simulation and open world
en.what: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead is a turn-based survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Players struggle to survive in a harsh, persistent, procedurally generated world, scavenging for resources and fighting various monsters and other survivors. It is known for its extreme complexity and freedom.
en.content: The repository contains the full game source code, documentation (e.g., compiling guides), data files (including tileset screenshots), and packaging configurations for multiple platforms. The game supports Ncurses and graphical tiles versions, with stable and experimental releases.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, using SDL and other libraries for graphics, cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows, BSD). Build systems include Makefile and CMake.
en.hot: As a long-maintained open-source game with 13k+ stars, it gained 11 stars today, ranking 17th on the C++ daily trending. Its deep simulation and continuous updates attract many players and contributors.
uses: Players who enjoy deep simulation and open-world survival games can experience high freedom and complexity.
Developers interested in game development can learn the architecture and community collaboration of a large C++ project.
Players looking for an extensible modding platform, as the game supports rich mods and custom content.

zh.tag: 面向现代 Windows 体验的 7-Zip 衍生压缩工具
zh.what: NanaZip 是一款开源的现代 Windows 文件压缩工具，从知名开源压缩软件 7-Zip 分叉而来。它旨在提供更符合现代 Windows 设计语言和交互习惯的体验，同时保留 7-Zip 的强大压缩功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档（如赞助版说明）、截图和构建配置。项目以 C++ 编写，支持通过 GitHub Actions 构建，并提供 Microsoft Store 和 SourceForge 等发布渠道。
zh.stack: 基于 7-Zip 源码，使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Windows SDK 和 MSVC 工具链。集成 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成，并支持 Microsoft Store 打包。
zh.hot: 凭借对现代 Windows 的优化和活跃的社区贡献，NanaZip 在 GitHub 上获得 15k+ 星标，今日新增 22 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 18 名。其持续更新和赞助版模式也吸引了大量用户。
uses: Windows 用户寻求更美观、更符合现代设计的压缩工具
开发者希望参与开源压缩工具的开发或定制
需要高性能压缩/解压功能的专业人士

en.tag: A 7-Zip derivative for the modern Windows experience
en.what: NanaZip is an open-source file archiver for the modern Windows experience, forked from the well-known 7-Zip. It aims to provide a more modern design and interaction while retaining 7-Zip's powerful compression capabilities.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation (e.g., Sponsor Edition), screenshots, and build configurations. Written in C++, it supports builds via GitHub Actions and is distributed through Microsoft Store and SourceForge.
en.stack: Based on 7-Zip source, developed in C++ with Windows SDK and MSVC toolchain. Integrates GitHub Actions for CI and supports Microsoft Store packaging.
en.hot: With its modern Windows optimization and active community, NanaZip has gained 15k+ stars on GitHub, with 22 new stars today, ranking 18th on the C++ trending list. Its continuous updates and sponsor edition model also attract many users.
uses: Windows users seeking a more beautiful and modern compression tool
Developers interested in contributing to or customizing an open-source archiver
Professionals needing high-performance compression/decompression

zh.tag: 纯C/C++的高性能LLM推理引擎
zh.what: llama.cpp 是一个用纯 C/C++ 编写的高性能大语言模型推理引擎，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。它针对本地部署和资源受限环境进行了优化，无需依赖庞大的深度学习框架。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理库 libllama、命令行工具、REST API 服务器（llama-server）以及 WebUI。支持多种量化格式（如 GGUF）和模型架构（如 LLaMA、GPT-OSS）。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 实现，依赖 ggml 张量库，可选支持 CUDA、Vulkan、Metal 等 GPU 加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的本地 LLM 推理方案之一，llama.cpp 持续获得社区关注，今日新增 159 星，总星数突破 12 万。其高性能、跨平台和易用性使其成为 AI 开发者和爱好者的首选。
uses: AI 开发者：在本地或边缘设备上运行和测试大语言模型
隐私敏感用户：无需联网即可使用 LLM，数据完全本地化
研究人员：探索模型量化、推理优化和自定义模型架构

en.tag: High-performance LLM inference engine in pure C/C++
en.what: llama.cpp is a high-performance LLM inference engine written in pure C/C++, optimized for CPU and GPU execution. It enables efficient local deployment without heavy deep learning frameworks.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference library libllama, CLI tools, a REST API server (llama-server), and a WebUI. It supports various quantization formats (e.g., GGUF) and model architectures (e.g., LLaMA, GPT-OSS).
en.stack: Pure C/C++ implementation, relies on the ggml tensor library, with optional GPU backends like CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal.
en.hot: As one of the most popular local LLM inference solutions, llama.cpp continues to gain community traction with 159 new stars today, surpassing 120K total. Its performance, cross-platform support, and ease of use make it a top choice for AI developers and enthusiasts.
uses: AI developers: run and test LLMs locally or on edge devices
Privacy-conscious users: use LLMs offline with full data locality
Researchers: explore quantization, inference optimization, and custom model architectures

zh.tag: 为 Wayland 打造的一体化可定制桌面外壳
zh.what: Noctalia 是一个原生的 Wayland 桌面外壳，旨在提供精致、可配置的 Linux 桌面体验，无需拼接独立的栏、启动器、通知守护进程、锁屏、壁纸工具和设置界面。它围绕合成器提供外壳层，包括栏、小部件、坞站、启动器、控制中心、通知、壁纸、锁屏、会话操作、剪贴板历史、OSD、托盘集成和桌面小部件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Noctalia 的源代码、文档和安装说明，当前 v5 处于 Beta 阶段。项目直接构建于 Wayland 和 OpenGL ES 之上，无 Qt 或 GTK 依赖，UI、渲染、配置和 IPC 模型设计为一个统一的整体。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Wayland 和 OpenGL ES，无 Qt 或 GTK。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上获得近万星标，日增 38 星，因其解决了 Wayland 桌面碎片化问题，提供一体化解决方案而受到关注。
uses: 希望获得统一、可定制桌面体验的 Wayland 用户，避免拼凑多个工具。
喜欢精细控制桌面外观和行为的 Linux 高级用户。
对 Wayland 生态感兴趣，想探索一体化外壳架构的开发者。

en.tag: A sleek, customizable desktop shell crafted for Wayland
en.what: Noctalia is a native Wayland desktop shell that provides a polished, configurable Linux desktop without stitching together separate bar, launcher, notification daemon, lock screen, wallpaper tool, and settings UI. It offers the shell layer around your compositor: bars, widgets, dock, launcher, control center, notifications, wallpaper, lock screen, session actions, clipboard history, OSDs, tray integration, and desktop widgets.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, and installation instructions for Noctalia, with v5 currently in Beta. It is built directly on Wayland and OpenGL ES with no Qt or GTK dependency, designed as one cohesive shell.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, relying on Wayland and OpenGL ES, with no Qt or GTK dependency.
en.hot: With nearly 10k stars and 38 new stars today, it's gaining attention for solving Wayland desktop fragmentation with an all-in-one shell.
uses: Wayland users who want a unified, customizable desktop experience without assembling multiple tools.
Advanced Linux users who enjoy fine-grained control over desktop appearance and behavior.
Developers interested in the Wayland ecosystem and exploring an integrated shell architecture.

zh.tag: 每秒解析数GB JSON的极致性能库
zh.what: simdjson 是一个利用 SIMD 指令和微并行算法实现超高速 JSON 解析的 C++ 库，比 RapidJSON 快 4 倍以上，比 JSON for Modern C++ 快 25 倍。它提供完整的 JSON 和 UTF-8 验证，支持无损解析，并能在运行时自动选择适配 CPU 的解析器。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的库源码、文档、性能基准测试、以及多种语言的绑定和移植版本。还提供了快速入门指南、API 文档和 Godbolt 在线演示链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SIMD 指令集（如 AVX2、NEON），并支持 CMake 构建系统。
zh.hot: simdjson 已被 Node.js、ClickHouse、Meta Velox 等众多知名项目采用，证明了其生产级可靠性。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但 24k+ 的总 star 和广泛的应用场景使其持续受到关注。
uses: 需要高性能 JSON 解析的 C++ 项目，如数据库、搜索引擎、实时数据处理系统。
对解析速度有极致要求的场景，如日志分析、大数据管道、网络服务。
希望减少 JSON 解析 CPU 开销的开发者，可集成到现有代码库中。
研究 SIMD 优化和微并行算法的学习参考。

en.tag: Ultra-fast JSON parsing at gigabytes per second
en.what: simdjson is a C++ library that leverages SIMD instructions and microparallel algorithms to parse JSON at ultra-high speed, over 4x faster than RapidJSON and 25x faster than JSON for Modern C++. It provides full JSON and UTF-8 validation, lossless parsing, and automatically selects a CPU-tailored parser at runtime.
en.content: The repository contains the full library source code, documentation, performance benchmarks, and bindings/ports for multiple languages. It also includes a quick start guide, API docs, and a Godbolt link for online demos.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it relies on SIMD instruction sets (e.g., AVX2, NEON) and uses CMake as the build system.
en.hot: simdjson is adopted by many well-known projects like Node.js, ClickHouse, and Meta Velox, proving its production-grade reliability. Despite modest daily star gains, its 24k+ total stars and wide adoption keep it in the spotlight.
uses: C++ projects needing high-performance JSON parsing, such as databases, search engines, and real-time data processing systems.
Scenarios demanding extreme parsing speed, like log analysis, big data pipelines, and web services.
Developers looking to reduce CPU overhead of JSON parsing and integrate into existing codebases.
A learning reference for SIMD optimization and microparallel algorithms.

zh.tag: 统一 AI 开发与部署平台，含 MAX 框架与 Mojo 语言
zh.what: Modular Platform 是一个开源平台，旨在统一 AI 开发与部署流程，包含 MAX 框架（用于模型推理和部署）和 Mojo 语言（一种面向 AI 的高性能编程语言）。它提供从模型编译、优化到服务部署的完整工具链，并支持 OpenAI 兼容的端点。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Mojo 编译器、Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库、MAX 推理服务器、MAX 模型流水线以及大量代码示例。目录结构清晰，分为 /KGEN、/mojo、/max 等模块，方便开发者浏览和贡献。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Mojo 语言编写，同时涉及 Python（用于 MAX 的 Python API）和 C++（底层内核）。依赖 LLVM 等编译器基础设施，并遵循 Apache 2.0 许可证（含 LLVM 例外）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 268 星，总星数 27933，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。Mojo 语言和 MAX 框架的独特定位吸引了大量 AI 开发者，其高性能和统一平台理念备受关注。
uses: AI 开发者：使用 Mojo 语言编写高性能 AI 模型，或利用 MAX 框架进行模型部署和推理。
MLOps 工程师：通过 MAX 推理服务器快速搭建 OpenAI 兼容的模型服务。
研究人员：在 MAX 流水线中集成自定义模型架构，并利用加速器库优化性能。
开源贡献者：参与 Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库等模块的开发和改进。

en.tag: Unified AI development & deployment platform, including MAX framework and Mojo language
en.what: The Modular Platform is an open-source platform that unifies AI development and deployment, including the MAX framework for model inference and deployment, and the Mojo language, a high-performance programming language for AI. It provides a complete toolchain from model compilation and optimization to service deployment, with OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
en.content: The repo contains the Mojo compiler, Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, MAX inference server, MAX model pipelines, and numerous code examples. The directory structure is clear, with modules like /KGEN, /mojo, /max, making it easy to navigate and contribute.
en.stack: Primarily written in Mojo, with Python for MAX's Python API and C++ for low-level kernels. It relies on LLVM and other compiler infrastructure, and is licensed under Apache 2.0 with LLVM exceptions.
en.hot: With 268 stars added today and 27,933 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. The unique positioning of Mojo and MAX attracts AI developers, drawing attention to its high performance and unified platform concept.
uses: AI developers: Use Mojo to write high-performance AI models or leverage MAX for deployment and inference.
MLOps engineers: Quickly set up OpenAI-compatible model serving with the MAX inference server.
Researchers: Integrate custom model architectures in MAX pipelines and optimize performance with the accelerator library.
Open-source contributors: Contribute to the Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, and more.

zh.tag: 一键生成高清短视频的AI自动化工具
zh.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一个利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据用户提供的主题或关键词，自动生成视频脚本、匹配素材、生成字幕和背景音乐，并合成高清短视频的一站式工具。用户只需输入一个主题或关键词，即可获得完整的短视频成品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 源代码、WebUI 界面、API 接口、文档和示例，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。提供 WebUI 和 API 两种交互方式，方便用户通过图形界面或程序化调用生成视频。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，依赖 AI 大模型（如 Kimi K3）进行文案生成和素材匹配，使用自动化工作流整合视频合成、字幕和背景音乐生成。
zh.hot: 凭借 10 万+ Star 和今日新增 470 星，它成为 GitHub Python 趋势榜第 13 名，因其极大降低了短视频创作门槛，让任何人都能快速生成专业级视频，满足了内容创作者和营销人员的强烈需求。
uses: 内容创作者：快速生成短视频素材，提升内容产出效率。
营销人员：根据产品关键词自动生成宣传视频，用于社交媒体推广。
教育工作者：将知识点转化为生动的视频讲解，辅助教学。
开发者：通过 API 集成到自己的应用或工作流中，实现自动化视频生成。

en.tag: One-click AI tool to auto-generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword
en.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an all-in-one AI tool that leverages large language models and automated workflows to generate HD short videos from a user-provided topic or keyword. It automatically creates the script, matches stock footage, generates subtitles and background music, and composes the final video.
en.content: The repository contains full Python source code, a WebUI, API endpoints, documentation, and examples, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It offers both a graphical WebUI and an API for programmatic video generation.
en.stack: Built with Python 3.11+, it relies on AI LLMs (e.g., Kimi K3) for script writing and material matching, and uses automated workflows to integrate video composition, subtitles, and background music generation.
en.hot: With over 100k stars and 470 new stars today, it ranks #13 on GitHub Trending (Python). Its popularity stems from dramatically lowering the barrier to short-video creation, enabling anyone to quickly produce professional-looking videos, meeting the strong demand from content creators and marketers.
uses: Content creators: Quickly generate short video material to boost output efficiency.
Marketers: Auto-generate promotional videos from product keywords for social media campaigns.
Educators: Turn knowledge points into engaging video explanations to aid teaching.
Developers: Integrate via API into their own apps or workflows for automated video generation.

zh.tag: AI 代理的自进化上下文数据库，统一记忆、知识与技能
zh.what: OpenViking 是一个为 AI 代理设计的开源上下文数据库，将记忆、资源和技能统一为一个虚拟文件系统（viking:// 协议），代理可以通过 ls、tree、find 等命令浏览自己的上下文，而不是查询黑盒向量存储。内容被处理为三层（L0 摘要、L1 概览、L2 细节），并按需加载，每次检索都会留下可观察和调试的轨迹。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenViking 的核心实现，包括虚拟文件系统、三层内容处理管道、检索轨迹记录，以及 OpenViking Studio 在线演示环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，可能依赖向量数据库、文件系统抽象和 AI 代理框架，具体技术栈未在摘要中详述。
zh.hot: OpenViking 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 28,893 颗星，今日新增 239 颗，位列 Python 趋势榜第 9 名。其创新的上下文管理方式（将记忆、知识和技能统一为文件系统）吸引了大量关注，解决了 AI 代理上下文管理的痛点。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要高效管理代理上下文、记忆和技能的场景。
RAG 应用构建者：希望用文件系统方式替代传统向量检索的团队。
研究与教育：用于探索代理上下文管理的新范式。

en.tag: Self-evolving context database for AI agents, unifying memory, knowledge RAG, and skills
en.what: OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents, unifying memories, resources, and skills into one virtual filesystem under the viking:// protocol, so agents can browse their context with ls, tree, and find instead of querying a black-box vector store. Content is processed into three tiers (L0 abstract, L1 overview, L2 details) and loaded on demand, with every retrieval leaving a traceable trajectory for debugging.
en.content: The repository contains the core implementation of OpenViking, including the virtual filesystem, three-tier content processing pipeline, retrieval trajectory logging, and the OpenViking Studio live demo environment.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, likely leveraging vector databases, filesystem abstractions, and AI agent frameworks, though the exact stack is not detailed in the summary.
en.hot: OpenViking has quickly gained traction on GitHub with 28,893 stars and 239 new stars today, ranking #9 on the Python trending list. Its innovative approach to context management—unifying memory, knowledge, and skills into a filesystem—has attracted significant attention, addressing a key pain point in AI agent context handling.
uses: AI agent developers: scenarios requiring efficient management of agent context, memory, and skills.
RAG application builders: teams looking to replace traditional vector retrieval with a filesystem approach.
Research and education: for exploring new paradigms in agent context management.

zh.tag: 为AI编码代理提供长期记忆，实现跨工具无缝交接
zh.what: ai-memory 是一个为 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex 等）提供长期记忆的解决方案。它允许你在一个代理中开始任务，中途退出后，用另一个代理在相同目录继续，无需重新解释架构、失败尝试或未决问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心二进制、MCP 配置和生命周期钩子，支持多种代理和平台（Linux、macOS、Windows/WSL2）。提供安装脚本、Docker 镜像、原生二进制和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 1.95+，使用 MCP（Model Context Protocol）集成代理，通过生命周期钩子捕获会话。支持 Docker 和原生二进制分发。
zh.hot: 本周新增 2520 星，总星数 4411，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 9。它解决了 AI 编码代理缺乏长期记忆的痛点，让不同代理间切换变得无缝，引发开发者广泛关注。
uses: 使用多个 AI 编码代理的开发者，希望在切换工具时保留上下文
需要跨会话维护项目架构和决策记录的技术团队
对 AI 辅助编程工具链感兴趣，希望提升代理效率的开发者

en.tag: Long-term memory for AI coding agents, enabling seamless handoff across tools
en.what: ai-memory is a solution for long-term memory in AI coding agents (like Claude Code, Codex, etc.). It lets you start a task with one agent, quit mid-task, and continue with another agent in the same directory without re-explaining the architecture, failed approaches, or open questions.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust core binary, MCP configs, and lifecycle hooks, supporting multiple agents and platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows/WSL2). Includes install scripts, Docker images, native binaries, and docs.
en.stack: Built with Rust 1.95+, uses MCP (Model Context Protocol) for agent integration, and lifecycle hooks to capture sessions. Distributed via Docker and native binaries.
en.hot: Gained 2520 stars this week (total 4411), ranking #9 on GitHub Trending weekly. It addresses the pain point of AI coding agents lacking long-term memory, enabling seamless switching between agents, which has attracted wide developer attention.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding agents who want to preserve context when switching tools
Technical teams needing to maintain project architecture and decision records across sessions
Developers interested in AI-assisted programming toolchains and improving agent efficiency

zh.tag: macOS 菜单栏原生 LLM 推理服务器，支持连续批处理与 SSD 缓存
zh.what: oMLX 是一个专为 Apple Silicon 优化的 LLM 推理服务器，提供连续批处理和分层 KV 缓存，将热数据保存在内存、冷数据存储在 SSD，并支持跨请求复用缓存。用户可通过 macOS 菜单栏直接管理模型、切换上下文长度，并监控性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 macOS 应用（.dmg 安装包）、Homebrew 安装支持、CLI 工具（~/.omlx/bin/omlx）以及可选的 MCP 支持。还提供多语言 README（中/英/韩/日）和基准测试页面。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.11-3.13，针对 Apple Silicon 优化，可能包含自定义内核（如 GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3）。支持 Homebrew 安装，可选安装 MCP 依赖。
zh.hot: 针对 Mac 用户痛点：在便利性和控制力之间取得平衡，通过菜单栏管理 LLM 服务器，并利用 SSD 缓存实现长上下文复用，适合本地 AI 开发。Star 数近 1.9 万，今日新增 78，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 8 名。
uses: Mac 用户希望在本地运行 LLM，并通过菜单栏轻松管理模型和上下文
开发者使用 Claude Code 等工具进行真实编码，需要跨请求缓存以提升效率
需要灵活控制内存和 SSD 缓存、自动切换模型的高级用户
通过 Homebrew 或 CLI 集成到自动化工作流（如 Apple Shortcuts）

en.tag: Native macOS menu bar LLM inference server with continuous batching & SSD caching
en.what: oMLX is an LLM inference server optimized for Apple Silicon, featuring continuous batching and tiered KV caching that persists hot data in memory and cold data on SSD, enabling cache reuse across requests. Users can manage models, switch context lengths, and monitor performance directly from the macOS menu bar.
en.content: The repository includes a full macOS app (.dmg installer), Homebrew installation support, a CLI shim (~/.omlx/bin/omlx), and optional MCP support. It also provides multilingual READMEs (EN/ZH/KO/JA) and a benchmarks page.
en.stack: Primarily Python 3.11-3.13, optimized for Apple Silicon, possibly with custom kernels (e.g., GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3). Supports Homebrew installation, with optional MCP dependencies.
en.hot: Addresses Mac users' pain point: balancing convenience and control by managing LLM servers from the menu bar, with SSD caching for long-context reuse, ideal for local AI development. With ~19k stars and +78 today, it ranks #8 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Mac users who want to run LLMs locally and manage models/context from the menu bar
Developers using tools like Claude Code for real coding, needing cross-request caching for efficiency
Power users who need flexible control over memory/SSD caching and auto-swapping models
Those integrating with automation workflows via Homebrew or CLI (e.g., Apple Shortcuts)

zh.tag: 免费公共 API 大全，开发者资源宝库
zh.what: 这是一个由社区维护的免费公共 API 集合，涵盖动物、动漫、反恶意软件、艺术与设计、认证与授权、区块链、书籍、商业、日历、云存储与文件等众多领域。它为开发者提供了丰富的 API 资源，方便他们快速查找和集成到自己的项目中。
zh.content: 仓库以 README 为主，按类别列出所有 API，每个 API 包含名称、描述、认证方式、是否支持 HTTPS 和 CORS 等信息。此外，还包含贡献指南和 API 提交要求。
zh.stack: 仓库本身是纯文档，主要使用 Markdown 编写。主语言标记为 Python，但实际内容不涉及代码。
zh.hot: 该仓库拥有超过 46 万 star，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的资源列表之一。今日新增 2260 star，持续受到开发者关注，因为它提供了免费 API 的集中索引，节省了开发者搜索和筛选的时间。
uses: 开发者寻找免费 API 用于个人项目或原型开发
技术爱好者探索不同领域的 API，学习集成方法
产品经理或创业者调研可用的 API 服务，评估可行性
教育场景中作为教学资源，帮助学生了解 API 生态

en.tag: A curated list of free public APIs for developers
en.what: This is a community-maintained collection of free public APIs, covering a wide range of categories such as Animals, Anime, Anti-Malware, Art & Design, Authentication & Authorization, Blockchain, Books, Business, Calendar, Cloud Storage & File, and more. It provides developers with a rich resource of APIs to quickly find and integrate into their projects.
en.content: The repository is primarily a README that lists all APIs by category, with each API including name, description, auth, HTTPS, and CORS. It also includes contribution guidelines and API submission requirements.
en.stack: The repository is documentation-only, written in Markdown. The primary language is marked as Python, but there is no actual code.
en.hot: With over 460k stars, this is one of the most popular resource lists on GitHub. Today it gained 2260 stars, remaining a go-to for developers as it provides a centralized index of free APIs, saving time on searching and filtering.
uses: Developers looking for free APIs for personal projects or prototyping
Tech enthusiasts exploring APIs across domains to learn integration
Product managers or entrepreneurs researching available API services for feasibility
Educational use as a teaching resource to understand the API ecosystem

zh.tag: 腾讯开源的 AI 红队全栈安全平台
zh.what: A.I.G 是一个由腾讯朱雀实验室开发的全栈 AI 红队平台，用于保护 AI 生态系统。它通过代理扫描、技能扫描、MCP 扫描、AI 基础设施扫描和 LLM 越狱评估，全面检测和缓解 AI 系统中的安全漏洞。
zh.content: 仓库包含平台的核心代码、文档、多语言 README（中英日西德法等），以及 Docker 镜像和 ClawHub 集成（如 EdgeOne ClawScan、Skill Scanner）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，提供 Docker 部署方式，并集成 ClawHub 和 EdgeOne 等云服务。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 安全需求激增，该平台在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获 4957 星，今日新增 50 星，并登上日榜第 16 名。
uses: AI 安全研究员：用于评估和加固 AI 系统的安全性
企业安全团队：扫描 AI 基础设施和代理，防范潜在攻击
开发者：集成 MCP 扫描和 LLM 越狱测试到 CI/CD 流程

en.tag: Tencent's full-stack AI red teaming security platform
en.what: A.I.G is a full-stack AI red teaming platform developed by Tencent Zhuque Lab to secure AI ecosystems. It performs agent scans, skill scans, MCP scans, AI infrastructure scans, and LLM jailbreak evaluations to detect and mitigate security vulnerabilities in AI systems.
en.content: The repository includes the platform's core code, documentation, multi-language READMEs (Chinese, English, Japanese, Spanish, German, etc.), Docker images, and ClawHub integrations such as EdgeOne ClawScan and Skill Scanner.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, offers Docker deployment, and integrates with cloud services like ClawHub and EdgeOne.
en.hot: With surging demand for AI security, the platform has quickly gained popularity on GitHub, amassing 4,957 stars with 50 new stars today, ranking 16th on the daily trending list.
uses: AI security researchers: to assess and harden AI system security
Enterprise security teams: to scan AI infrastructure and agents against potential attacks
Developers: to integrate MCP scanning and LLM jailbreak testing into CI/CD pipelines

zh.tag: 开源一体化产品数据平台：分析、回放、实验、LLM 观测全包
zh.what: 知名开源产品数据平台：产品分析、Web 分析、session 回放、feature flag、A/B 实验、错误追踪、日志、问卷、数据仓库、CDP、LLM 可观测性全部集成在一个系统。最新定位「构建自驱动产品（self-driving products）」：把错误、rage click 等产品信号自动转成分析报告和 PR 供你 review 合并，可从 Slack、Web、桌面端或 MCP 操作，支持 Docker 自托管。
zh.content: 超大型 monorepo：posthog/（Django 后端）、frontend/、products/（各产品线）、rust/、services/、ee/（企业版，单独授权），大量 docker-compose 部署文件与全平台 SDK。
zh.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust 服务，底层 ClickHouse；MIT（ee/ 目录除外）。
zh.hot: 它把完整的产品分析套件与面向 Agent 的自动化能力结合，既有成熟开发者用户，也有清晰的新使用场景。
uses: 产品团队 —— 一个平台替代 GA + 回放 + 实验工具的组合订阅
注重数据合规的公司 —— 自托管部署，用户数据不出机房
AI 产品团队 —— 用 LLM 可观测性追踪自家 agent 的成本与质量

en.tag: The open-source all-in-one product data platform
en.what: The well-known open-source product data platform: product analytics, web analytics, session replay, feature flags, A/B experiments, error tracking, logs, surveys, a data warehouse, CDP pipelines and LLM observability in one system. Its latest positioning is 'self-driving products': product signals like errors and rage clicks are automatically turned into analysis reports and PRs for you to review and merge — operable from Slack, web, desktop or MCP, and self-hostable via Docker.
en.content: A huge monorepo: posthog/ (Django backend), frontend/, products/ (each product line), rust/, services/, ee/ (enterprise code, separately licensed), lots of docker-compose files and SDKs for every platform.
en.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust services over ClickHouse; MIT (except ee/).
en.hot: The project combines a broad product-analytics suite with an agent-facing automation narrative, giving an established developer audience a clear reason to revisit it.
uses: Product teams — replace the GA + replay + experimentation stack with one platform
Compliance-sensitive companies — self-host so user data never leaves your infra
AI product teams — track your agents' cost and quality with LLM observability

zh.tag: 无限画布上的终端与AI代理管理器
zh.what: nodeterm 是一个基于节点的终端管理器，将多个真实终端作为可拖拽节点放在无限画布上，支持平移和缩放。它专为 AI 编码代理设计，每个项目可变成 Trello 风格的看板，展示并行的 Claude Code 会话。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 桌面应用（macOS/Linux）、自托管浏览器版（Server Edition）和 iOS 伴侣应用，共享同一服务层。提供安装包（.dmg、.AppImage、.deb）、文档、架构说明和源码构建指南。
zh.stack: 基于 Electron 和 TypeScript，使用 tmux 作为终端后端。支持 macOS (arm64/x64) 和 Linux (x64)，浏览器版通过服务端部署，iOS 伴侣应用可附加到同一会话。
zh.hot: 今日新增 78 星，总星数 956，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（TypeScript）第 9 名。其独特卖点在于用空间画布替代传统标签页，专为 ADHD 和分散工作流设计，同时深度集成 AI 代理，切中开发者痛点。
uses: AI 编码代理用户：需要并行管理多个 Claude Code 会话，以看板形式跟踪进度。
多任务开发者：在无限画布上组织多个终端，避免标签页混乱，保持上下文。
远程工作场景：通过 Server Edition 在浏览器中访问同一画布，或使用 iOS 伴侣应用随时查看。
ADHD 或偏好视觉化工作流的人群：用空间布局代替隐藏标签，提升专注和效率。

en.tag: Terminal & AI agent manager on an infinite canvas
en.what: nodeterm is a node-based terminal manager that places multiple real terminals as draggable nodes on an infinite pan/zoom canvas. Built for AI coding agents, it turns every project into a Trello-style board of live Claude Code sessions.
en.content: The repo includes an Electron desktop app (macOS/Linux), a self-hosted browser version (Server Edition), and an iOS companion, all sharing a common service seam. It provides installers (.dmg, .AppImage, .deb), docs, architecture notes, and build-from-source instructions.
en.stack: Built with Electron and TypeScript, using tmux for terminal backend. Supports macOS (arm64/x64) and Linux (x64), with a browser Server Edition and an iOS companion that attaches to the same live sessions.
en.hot: Gained 78 stars today, reaching 956 total, ranking #9 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) daily. Its unique selling point is replacing stacked tabs with a spatial canvas, designed for ADHD and scattered workflows, while deeply integrating AI agents—hitting a nerve with developers.
uses: AI coding agent users: need to manage multiple Claude Code sessions in parallel, tracking progress via a kanban board.
Multitasking developers: organize multiple terminals on an infinite canvas to avoid tab clutter and maintain context.
Remote work scenarios: access the same canvas via the browser Server Edition or check in with the iOS companion.
People with ADHD or visual workflow preferences: spatial layout replaces hidden tabs, boosting focus and efficiency.

zh.tag: 在 Apple Silicon 上以多 token 预测加速本地 LLM 推理
zh.what: MTPLX 是一个原生 Mac 应用和命令行工具，利用模型自带的多 token 预测（MTP）头来加速本地大语言模型的推理。它通过批量验证多个草稿 token 并采用精确拒绝采样，在不改变输出分布的前提下实现最高 2.24 倍的加速。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Mac 应用（DMG 下载）和命令行工具，提供模型推荐、下载、安装和性能测量功能。内置多个 Qwen 3.8/3.6 的量化版本，如 Optimized Speed、Bare Speed 和 Optimized Quality，并支持自动选择最适合硬件的配置。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，使用 MLX 框架（Apple 的机器学习库）进行推理，支持 macOS 14+ 和 Apple Silicon（M1 及以上）。通过 PyPI 和 Homebrew 分发，并包含 CI 和许可证等标准项目文件。
zh.hot: 本周新增 370 星，总星数达 1589，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Python）第 17 名。它解决了 MLX 生态中一个痛点：大多数运行时未利用模型内置的 MTP 头，而 MTPLX 提供了显著的加速且不牺牲输出质量。
uses: Mac 用户（Apple Silicon）希望在不购买额外硬件的情况下加速本地 LLM 推理，适合开发者和 AI 爱好者。
需要运行 Qwen 3.8 27B 等大型模型的用户，通过多 token 预测获得接近两倍的解码速度。
对推理速度敏感的应用场景，如代码生成、交互式聊天等，且要求输出分布与标准解码完全一致。

en.tag: Multi-token prediction to speed up local LLM inference on Apple Silicon
en.what: MTPLX is a native Mac app and CLI that accelerates local LLM inference using the model's built-in multi-token prediction (MTP) heads. It verifies multiple drafted tokens in a single batched forward pass and uses exact rejection sampling, achieving up to 2.24x speedup without changing the output distribution.
en.content: The repo includes a full Mac app (DMG download) and CLI, offering model recommendation, download, installation, and performance measurement. It bundles several quantized versions of Qwen 3.8/3.6, such as Optimized Speed, Bare Speed, and Optimized Quality, and automatically selects the best configuration for the hardware.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.11+, uses the MLX framework (Apple's machine learning library) for inference, supports macOS 14+ and Apple Silicon (M1 or newer). Distributed via PyPI and Homebrew, with CI and standard project files.
en.hot: Gained 370 stars this week, reaching 1589 total, and ranked #17 on GitHub Trending (Python) weekly. It addresses a pain point in the MLX ecosystem: most runtimes don't use the built-in MTP heads, and MTPLX provides significant speedup without sacrificing output quality.
uses: Mac users (Apple Silicon) who want to speed up local LLM inference without extra hardware, suitable for developers and AI enthusiasts.
Users running large models like Qwen 3.8 27B, gaining nearly 2x decoding speed via multi-token prediction.
Applications sensitive to inference speed, such as code generation and interactive chat, while requiring output distribution identical to standard decoding.

zh.tag: AI 代理的 817 项结构化网络安全技能库
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 代理（如 Claude Code、GitHub Copilot 等）设计的开源网络安全技能库，包含 817 项生产级技能，覆盖 29 个安全领域。技能映射到 MITRE ATT&CK、NIST CSF 2.0 等 6 个主流框架，并遵循 agentskills.io 标准，支持 26+ 平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含按领域组织的技能定义（如威胁情报、红队、事件响应），每个技能包含描述、示例和框架映射；还提供快速入门指南、贡献指南和平台兼容性列表。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，技能以结构化格式（如 YAML/JSON）定义，遵循 agentskills.io 规范；无特定运行时依赖，可集成到多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 28.4k stars 且单日新增近 200，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5。它填补了 AI 代理在网络安全领域缺乏标准化技能库的空白，并整合了多个权威框架，吸引安全从业者和 AI 开发者。
uses: 安全分析师：利用 AI 代理自动执行威胁检测、漏洞评估等任务
红队/渗透测试人员：在授权测试中快速调用攻击模拟技能
AI 开发者：为代理集成安全能力，或基于此库扩展自定义技能
安全培训：作为教学资源，展示 AI 在网络安全中的应用

en.tag: 817 structured cybersecurity skills for AI agents
en.what: An open-source library of 817 production-grade cybersecurity skills for AI agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot), covering 29 security domains. Skills are mapped to 6 frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, etc.) and follow the agentskills.io standard, compatible with 26+ platforms.
en.content: The repo contains skill definitions organized by domain (e.g., threat intel, red team, incident response), each with descriptions, examples, and framework mappings; also includes quick-start, contributing guides, and platform compatibility lists.
en.stack: Primarily Python; skills are defined in structured formats (e.g., YAML/JSON) following agentskills.io spec; no heavy runtime dependencies, integrates with various AI agent platforms.
en.hot: 28.4k stars with ~200 added today, #5 on GitHub Trending. It fills the gap of a standardized cybersecurity skill library for AI agents, integrating multiple authoritative frameworks, attracting security pros and AI developers.
uses: Security analysts: automate threat detection, vulnerability assessment with AI agents
Red team/pentesters: quickly invoke attack simulation skills in authorized tests
AI developers: integrate security capabilities into agents or extend custom skills
Security training: as educational resource for AI in cybersecurity

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的开源图原生上下文与决策基础设施
zh.what: Semantica 是一个图原生的基础设施，用于构建上下文感知且可问责的 AI 系统。它能够摄取企业数据，提取关键信息，构建上下文图与知识图谱，并支持图分析和因果推理，同时内置完整的决策溯源。该系统强调可解释、可追踪和可信赖，专为高风险和受监管领域设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Python 库、CLI 工具、文档和示例，支持多语言图存储（RDF 和 LPG），遵循 W3C 标准，提供本体管理和知识建模功能。项目采用模块化设计，便于自托管和审计。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python（3.8+），依赖图数据库和知识图谱技术，支持 RDF 和 LPG 存储，遵循 W3C 标准。可能涉及因果推理和决策智能相关库。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1102 星，总星数达 3323，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Python）第 13 名。其定位为“AI 代理的开源 Palantir”，填补了企业级上下文管理和决策溯源的需求，在 AI 信任与合规领域引发关注。
uses: 企业 AI 团队：需要为代理系统构建可解释、可审计的上下文管理平台。
受监管行业（金融、医疗）：要求决策可追溯、符合合规要求。
知识图谱开发者：希望利用图原生基础设施进行知识建模和因果推理。
AI 研究者：探索上下文感知和可问责 AI 系统的实现。

en.tag: Open-source graph-native infrastructure for context and accountable AI systems
en.what: Semantica is a graph-native infrastructure for building context-aware and accountable AI systems. It ingests enterprise data, extracts what matters, builds a Context Graph and knowledge graph, and runs graph analytics and causal reasoning with full decision provenance. It is explainable, traceable, and trustworthy by design, built for high-stakes, regulated domains.

en.stack: Primarily Python (3.8+), leveraging graph database and knowledge graph technologies, supporting RDF and LPG storage, and adhering to W3C standards. It likely incorporates libraries for causal reasoning and decision intelligence.

zh.tag: 14MB 端侧模型，手机/穿戴/家居/机器人皆可跑
zh.what: Needle 2 是一个 45M 参数的开放模型，专为工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取设计。整个模型打包成单个 14MB 的二进制文件，运行完整会话仅需约 28MB 内存。它基于 Simple Attention Network 架构，并采用 Cactus Quants 压缩至 CQ2 位，内置推理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包，提供推理、LoRA 微调和导出功能。模型权重已嵌入引擎，无需额外文件，推理时无网络请求。还包含工具检索、置信度门控和 256-token 滑动窗口等特性。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等，使用 Simple Attention Network 架构，Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram 键值记忆。推理引擎从 Hugging Face 获取并缓存。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 日榜上新增 248 星，总星数 3730，因其极小的体积（14MB）和高效的端侧性能而备受关注，在基准测试中与更大的模型（如 FunctionGemma 270M）互有胜负，但体积小 5 到 70 倍。
uses: 端侧 AI 开发者：在手机、可穿戴设备等资源受限环境中部署工具调用模型。
智能家居与机器人：为设备提供本地智能，无需云端依赖。
LoRA 微调研究者：在小型模型上进行高效微调实验。

en.tag: 14MB on-device model for phones, wearables, smart home, and robots
en.what: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction. The entire model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on the Simple Attention Network architecture, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine.
en.content: The repository contains the Python package for inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and export. Weights are baked into the engine, no separate model files needed, and inference does no network calls. Features include tool retrieval, confidence gating, and a 256-token sliding window.
en.stack: Python-based, with dependencies like PyTorch. Uses Simple Attention Network architecture with Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, and engram key-value memory. The inference engine is fetched from Hugging Face and cached.
en.hot: Gained 248 stars today, total 3730, trending on GitHub. It's hot due to its tiny size (14MB) and efficient on-device performance, trading wins with larger models like FunctionGemma 270M while being 5-70x smaller.
uses: On-device AI developers: deploying tool-calling models in resource-constrained environments like phones and wearables.
Smart home and robotics: providing local intelligence for devices without cloud dependency.
LoRA fine-tuning researchers: experimenting with efficient fine-tuning on small models.

Researchers: AI-driven research and thinking via Chat

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理通过 MCP 调用数千个现成爬虫，抓取任意网站数据

zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 Model Context Protocol SDK，依赖 Apify 平台和 Actor 运行时。支持 OAuth 认证、Streamable HTTP 传输，并兼容多种 MCP 客户端。
zh.hot: 本周新增 817 星，总星数达 4942，位列 GitHub Trending TypeScript 周榜第 9。它解决了 AI 代理获取实时网页数据的痛点，提供即插即用的爬虫生态，与热门 AI 工具无缝集成。
uses: 开发者：为 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程助手添加网页数据抓取能力，实现自动化数据采集。

en.tag: MCP server enabling AI agents to use thousands of ready-made scrapers for any website

uses: Developers: Add web scraping capabilities to AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Cursor for automated data collection.
Data scientists: Quickly obtain structured data from social media, e-commerce, etc., for analysis and model training.
Enterprise users: Automate web data extraction workflows via MCP integration to improve business efficiency.

zh.tag: 现代化全功能下载管理器，支持 HTTP/FTP/BT/磁力链接
zh.what: Motrix 是一款简洁易用的桌面下载管理器，支持 HTTP、FTP、BitTorrent、磁力链接等多种协议。它提供干净直观的界面，并具备 BT 文件选择、内置 tracker 管理、端口映射等高级功能。

高级用户：需要 tracker 管理、端口映射、无头服务器部署的下载发烧友
开发者：希望集成下载功能或开发下载相关工具的技术人员

en.tag: A modern, full-featured download manager supporting HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, and magnet links
en.what: Motrix is a clean and easy-to-use desktop download manager supporting HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, magnet links, and more. It offers a clean intuitive interface with advanced features like per-file selection for BT, built-in tracker management, and port mapping.

en.stack: Tech stack includes Electron, React, and TypeScript. The download core is independent of the UI, communicating with browser extensions and CLI tools via MDXP (Motrix Download eXchange Protocol) built on JSON-RPC 2.0, with plugins running in isolated sandboxes.
en.hot: With over 53K stars and 344 new stars today, Motrix is popular for its full-featured yet clean interface. The v2 beta (Motrix Turbo) with a rebuilt architecture and new features is generating significant buzz.

Developers: those who want to integrate download functionality or build download-related tools

zh.tag: 基于 Web 标准的超快轻量级多运行时 Web 框架
zh.what: Hono 是一个基于 Web 标准构建的小型、简单且超快的 Web 框架，适用于任何 JavaScript 运行时，如 Cloudflare Workers、Deno、Bun、Node.js 等。它提供了简洁的 API 和一流 TypeScript 支持，旨在让开发者用同一套代码在不同平台上运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架核心源码、内置中间件、自定义中间件及第三方中间件，以及文档和迁移指南。核心是一个高效的 RegExpRouter 路由器，并提供了多种预设（如 hono/tiny）以减小包体积。
zh.stack: 使用 TypeScript 编写，零依赖，仅使用 Web 标准 API。支持多种运行时，包括 Cloudflare Workers、Fastly Compute、Deno、Bun、AWS Lambda、Lambda@Edge 和 Node.js。
zh.hot: 凭借其超快的性能、极小的体积（tiny 预设小于 12kB）以及跨运行时兼容性，Hono 在开发者中广受欢迎。本周新增 258 个 star，总 star 数达到 31959，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 11 名。
uses: 构建边缘计算应用，如 Cloudflare Workers 或 Deno Deploy 上的 API 服务。
需要轻量级、高性能 Web 框架的 Node.js 后端开发者。
希望用同一套代码部署到多个 JavaScript 运行时的全栈开发者。

en.tag: Ultrafast, lightweight, multi-runtime web framework built on Web Standards
en.what: Hono is a small, simple, and ultrafast web framework built on Web Standards, running on any JavaScript runtime including Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun, and Node.js. It offers clean APIs and first-class TypeScript support, enabling developers to run the same code across multiple platforms.
en.content: The repository contains the core framework source code, built-in middleware, custom middleware, third-party middleware, documentation, and migration guides. It features a highly efficient RegExpRouter and provides presets like hono/tiny to minimize bundle size.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript with zero dependencies, utilizing only Web Standard APIs. Supports multiple runtimes including Cloudflare Workers, Fastly Compute, Deno, Bun, AWS Lambda, Lambda@Edge, and Node.js.
en.hot: Hono gains popularity for its ultrafast performance, minimal bundle size (tiny preset under 12kB), and cross-runtime compatibility. With 258 new stars this week and a total of 31,959 stars, it ranks 11th on the TypeScript weekly trending list.

Node.js backend developers needing a lightweight, high-performance web framework.
Full-stack developers who want to deploy the same code across multiple JavaScript runtimes.

zh.tag: AI 代理全自动管理 YouTube 频道，免费 Gemini 可用
zh.what: 这是一个利用 AI 代理实现 YouTube 频道全自动管理的工具。它能够自动创建、优化并发布视频，全天候运行，无需人工干预。支持使用免费的 Gemini API 或 OpenAI，且无需编写代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的自动化流程：视频脚本生成、图像生成、语音合成、视频渲染（利用 FFmpeg）、以及 YouTube 发布队列。提供命令行工具（如 npm run setup、npm run walkthrough）进行配置和引导，支持多种 AI 提供商（OpenAI、Gemini、OpenRouter 等）。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Node.js（JavaScript），依赖 FFmpeg（通过 ffmpeg-static 捆绑）、dotenv 管理环境变量，并集成多个 AI 提供商的 API（OpenAI、Gemini、OpenRouter、Kimi、MiMo、GLM）。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 164 星，总星数达 2010，位列 JavaScript 趋势榜第 4。其吸引力在于提供完全免费（使用 Gemini）的自动化 YouTube 频道管理，大幅降低内容创作门槛，且持续更新修复问题，社区反响热烈。
uses: 内容创作者：希望自动化视频生成和发布，节省时间。
营销人员：需要批量生成视频内容以扩大品牌影响力。
开发者：对 AI 代理工作流和自动化管道感兴趣，可二次开发。
初学者：无需编程经验，通过引导式设置即可上手。

en.tag: Fully automated YouTube channel management with AI agents, works with free Gemini or OpenAI
en.what: This is a tool that uses AI agents to fully automate YouTube channel management. It can automatically create, optimize, and publish videos, running 24/7 without manual intervention. It works with the free Gemini API or OpenAI, and requires no coding.
en.content: The repository contains a complete automation pipeline: video script generation, image generation, voice narration, video rendering (using FFmpeg), and a YouTube publishing queue. It provides CLI tools (e.g., npm run setup, npm run walkthrough) for configuration and guided setup, supporting multiple AI providers (OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily built on Node.js (JavaScript), with dependencies on FFmpeg (bundled via ffmpeg-static), dotenv for environment variables, and integrations with multiple AI provider APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Kimi, MiMo, GLM).
en.hot: The project is rapidly gaining traction on GitHub, with 164 stars today and 2010 total, ranking #4 on the JavaScript trending list. Its appeal lies in offering fully automated YouTube channel management for free (using Gemini), significantly lowering the barrier to content creation, and its continuous updates and issue fixes have garnered strong community response.
uses: Content creators: who want to automate video generation and publishing to save time.
Marketers: needing to produce video content at scale for brand reach.
Developers: interested in AI agent workflows and automation pipelines, can customize.
Beginners: no coding experience needed, guided setup makes it easy to start.

zh.tag: 自托管监控工具，界面美观，功能强大
zh.what: Uptime Kuma 是一个易于使用的自托管监控工具，用于监控 HTTP(s)、TCP、Ping、DNS 等服务的在线状态。它提供美观、响应式的界面，并支持多种通知方式，如 Telegram、Discord 等。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的监控工具源代码，包括前端界面（Vue.js）、后端服务（Node.js）、Docker 部署配置，以及多语言翻译文件和通知组件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，前端基于 Vue.js，后端使用 Node.js，支持 Docker 部署，并集成了多种通知服务。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 9 万 star，因其自托管、开源免费且功能丰富而广受欢迎，今日新增 51 星，持续活跃。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队自建监控服务，无需依赖第三方平台
需要监控多个网站或 API 并希望自定义通知方式的用户
对数据隐私敏感，希望数据完全掌握在自己手中的用户

en.tag: A fancy self-hosted monitoring tool with a beautiful UI
en.what: Uptime Kuma is an easy-to-use self-hosted monitoring tool for tracking the uptime of HTTP(s), TCP, Ping, DNS, and other services. It features a fancy, reactive UI and supports notifications via Telegram, Discord, and 90+ other services.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the monitoring tool, including the frontend UI (Vue.js), backend service (Node.js), Docker deployment configs, and translation files and notification components.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with a Vue.js frontend and Node.js backend, Docker deployment support, and integration with numerous notification services.
en.hot: With over 90k stars, it's popular for being self-hosted, open-source, and feature-rich, gaining 51 stars today and remaining highly active.
uses: Individual developers or small teams who want to self-host monitoring without third-party dependencies
Users who need to monitor multiple websites or APIs and want customizable notifications
Users who are privacy-conscious and want full control over their data

zh.tag: 模块化 SenseNova 技能，构建 AI 办公助手与生产力工作流
zh.what: 这个仓库提供了一系列模块化的 SenseNova 技能，用于构建 AI 驱动的办公助手和生产力工作流。每个技能独立成目录，通过 SKILL.md 声明触发条件和执行流程，可单独使用或组合成端到端工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含图像生成与可视化、PPT 生成、Excel 数据分析、深度研究等技能，每个技能目录包含 SKILL.md 及实现代码。还提供了示例画廊和文档，展示近 100 个生成案例。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 JavaScript，遵循 Agent Skills 约定，可接入 OpenClaw 和 hermes-agent 等代理运行时。依赖 SenseNova 模型系列，如 SenseNova 6.7 和 U1。
zh.hot: 该仓库因提供即用型办公技能而受到关注，与 Raccoon 产品集成，提供免费试用，且今日新增 10 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: 开发者：希望为 AI 代理添加办公技能（如 PPT 生成、数据分析）的开发者。
办公自动化：需要自动化处理文档、表格和研究的个人或团队。
产品集成：希望将 SenseNova 技能集成到自有应用中的产品团队。
快速体验：不想配置环境，直接通过 Raccoon 免费试用这些能力的用户。

en.tag: Modular SenseNova skills for building AI-powered office assistants and productivity workflows
en.what: This repository provides a set of modular SenseNova skills for building AI-powered office assistants and productivity workflows. Each skill lives in its own directory and declares triggers, capabilities, and execution flow via SKILL.md, usable standalone or composed into end-to-end workflows.
en.content: The repo includes skills for image generation & visualization, slide-deck generation, Excel data analysis, and deep research, each with SKILL.md and implementation code. It also provides an example gallery and docs showcasing nearly 100 generation cases.
en.stack: Primary language is JavaScript, follows the Agent Skills convention, and plugs into agent runtimes like OpenClaw and hermes-agent. It depends on the SenseNova model family, including SenseNova 6.7 and U1.
en.hot: This repo gains traction for offering ready-to-use office skills, integrated with the Raccoon product with free trial, and gained 10 stars today, landing on GitHub Trending.
uses: Developers: who want to add office skills (e.g., PPT generation, data analysis) to AI agents.
Office automation: individuals or teams needing to automate documents, spreadsheets, and research.
Product integration: product teams looking to integrate SenseNova skills into their own apps.
Quick trial: users who prefer trying these capabilities directly via Raccoon without setup.

zh.tag: 跨平台数据库管理器，支持 SQL 与 NoSQL
zh.what: DbGate 是一个跨平台的数据库管理器，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、MongoDB、SQLite 等多种数据库。它旨在简化多数据库同时操作的流程，同时提供高级功能，如模式比较、可视化查询设计器、图表可视化和批量导入导出。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（Windows/Linux/Mac）、Web 版本（NPM 包和 Docker 镜像）以及 Node.js 脚本接口。提供在线演示和社区版下载。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 开发，基于 Node.js 和 Web 技术。支持多种数据库驱动，并可通过 NPM 或 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: DbGate 因其跨平台、多数据库支持和免费开源的特点而受欢迎。本周新增 54 个 star，总星数达 7277，位列 JavaScript 周榜第 11 名。
uses: 数据库管理员和开发者需要同时管理多个不同类型的数据库。
需要可视化查询设计、模式比较和图表分析的高级用户。
希望使用 Web 版或 Docker 部署的团队，便于远程协作。

en.tag: Cross-platform database manager for SQL and NoSQL databases
en.what: DbGate is a cross-platform database manager supporting MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, SQLite, and more. It is designed for simplicity and efficiency when working with multiple databases simultaneously, while also offering advanced features like schema compare, visual query designer, chart visualization, and batch import/export.
en.content: The repository contains desktop applications for Windows/Linux/Mac, a web version as NPM package and Docker image, and a Node.js scripting interface. It also provides an online demo and community edition downloads.
en.stack: Primarily developed in JavaScript, built on Node.js and web technologies. Supports multiple database drivers and can be deployed via NPM or Docker.
en.hot: DbGate is popular for its cross-platform support, multiple database support, and free open-source nature. It gained 54 stars this week, reaching a total of 7277, ranking 11th on the JavaScript weekly trending list.
uses: Database administrators and developers who need to manage multiple different types of databases simultaneously.
Advanced users who require visual query design, schema comparison, and chart analysis.
Teams that prefer web-based or Docker deployment for remote collaboration.

zh.tag: Claude Code 全家桶：代理、技能、钩子、规则与 MCP 配置

zh.hot: 本周新增 154 颗星，总星数突破 1000，登上 JavaScript 周榜第 9 名。作为黑客松获奖者的实战配置，吸引了大量 Claude Code 用户寻求高效开发工作流。

AI 辅助开发团队：需要标准化代理、技能和钩子配置的团队。

en.tag: Complete Claude Code toolkit: agents, skills, hooks, rules, and MCP configs
en.what: A collection of Claude Code configurations from an Anthropic hackathon winner, including production-ready agents, skills, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configs. Evolved over 10+ months of intensive daily use building real products.

AI-assisted dev teams: teams needing standardized agents, skills, and hooks.
Learners of AI coding practices: those wanting to build efficient AI dev workflows.

zh.tag: 拒绝白板面试的友好公司清单
zh.what: 这是一个收集不使用白板面试的公司的开源清单，旨在推广更贴近实际工作的招聘方式。它列出了那些采用真实问题讨论、结对编程或家庭作业等面试形式的公司，并鼓励社区贡献和反馈。

en.tag: A list of companies that don't do whiteboard interviews
en.what: This is an open-source list of companies that avoid whiteboard interviews, promoting hiring practices that resemble real work. It includes companies that use real-world problem discussions, pair programming, or take-home assignments, and encourages community contributions and feedback.
