Tech community members: Contribute or remove company entries to keep the list accurate.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 编码工具用量监控桌面小组件
zh.what: Token Monitor 是一个桌面小组件，用于实时监控 29+ 款 AI 编码工具（如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 等）的 token 用量、费用和账户限制。它支持多设备同步、历史趋势分析，并按工具、设备、模型、会话或项目维度进行统计。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用源码、安装包（支持 Windows/macOS/Linux）、演示 GIF、以及多语言 README（中/英/日/韩等）。核心功能包括实时用量监控、多设备同步、历史趋势和工具/设备/模型/会话/项目维度统计。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，桌面应用跨平台支持 Windows 10+、macOS 12+ 和 Linux x64。依赖本地数据路径读取（如 ~/.claude、~/.codex）实现无侵入监控，并集成多设备同步机制。
zh.hot: 本月新增 677 星（总星数 1323），登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（JavaScript）第 17 名。随着 AI 编码工具激增，开发者对用量透明化和成本控制的需求强烈，该工具填补了这一空白。
uses: 重度 AI 编码工具用户：实时监控 token 消耗，避免超出账户限制
团队管理者：跨设备同步用量数据，统一管理多成员的成本
成本敏感型开发者：按项目/模型/会话分析历史趋势，优化支出
自托管爱好者：本地优先存储，数据隐私可控

en.tag: Local-first desktop widget for tracking AI coding tool usage
en.what: Token Monitor is a desktop widget that provides real-time monitoring of token usage, costs, and account limits across 29+ AI coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode. It features multi-device sync, historical trends, and breakdowns by tool, device, model, session, or project.
en.content: The repository includes desktop app source code, installers for Windows/macOS/Linux, demo GIF, and multilingual READMEs (EN/CN/JP/KR etc.). Core features include live usage monitoring, multi-device sync, historical trends, and breakdowns by tool/device/model/session/project.
en.stack: Built primarily with JavaScript, the desktop app supports Windows 10+, macOS 12+, and Linux x64. It reads local data paths (e.g., ~/.claude, ~/.codex) for non-intrusive monitoring and integrates multi-device sync.
en.hot: Gained 677 stars this month (total 1323), ranking #17 on GitHub Trending monthly (JavaScript). With the proliferation of AI coding tools, developers strongly need usage transparency and cost control, and this tool fills that gap.
uses: Heavy AI coding tool users: monitor token consumption in real-time to avoid hitting account limits
Team managers: sync usage data across devices to manage costs for multiple members
Cost-conscious developers: analyze historical trends by project/model/session to optimize spending
Self-hosting enthusiasts: local-first storage for data privacy control

zh.tag: 超3400个品牌SVG图标库
zh.what: Simple Icons 是一个收集了超过 3400 个流行品牌 SVG 图标的开源库，所有图标均以简洁的单色风格呈现。用户可以通过官网或 CDN 直接使用这些图标，并支持社区贡献和修改。
zh.content: 仓库包含图标源文件（SVG）、数据文件（simple-icons.json）以及用于生成和验证图标的脚本，同时提供官网和 CDN 接入方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 npm 包管理，支持通过 CDN（如 jsDelivr、unpkg）加载，并集成 GitHub Actions 进行自动化测试。
zh.hot: 拥有 25,660 颗星，因其庞大的品牌图标库和易用性而广受欢迎，是前端开发者和设计师的常用资源。
uses: 前端开发者：在网页或应用中使用品牌图标，提升视觉一致性
设计师：快速获取品牌矢量图标，用于设计稿或原型
内容创作者：为博客、视频或演示文稿添加品牌标识

en.tag: Over 3400 free SVG icons for popular brands
en.what: Simple Icons is an open-source collection of over 3400 SVG icons for popular brands, all in a clean monochrome style. Users can access icons via the website or CDN, and contributions are welcome.
en.content: The repository contains icon source files (SVG), a data file (simple-icons.json), and scripts for generating and verifying icons, along with website and CDN integration methods.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, managed via npm, served via CDNs like jsDelivr and unpkg, with GitHub Actions for automated testing.
en.hot: With 25,660 stars, it's popular for its vast brand icon library and ease of use, making it a go-to resource for frontend developers and designers.
uses: Frontend developers: Use brand icons in web pages or apps for visual consistency
Designers: Quickly obtain brand vector icons for design mockups or prototypes
Content creators: Add brand logos to blogs, videos, or presentations

zh.tag: 基于 TurboQuant 的超快向量索引，内存省 8 倍
zh.what: turbovec 是一个用 Rust 编写的向量索引，提供 Python 绑定，基于 Google Research 的 TurboQuant 算法。它能在不牺牲速度的情况下大幅降低内存占用，支持在线增量添加、SIMD 加速搜索和增量持久化。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心库、Python 绑定、Cargo/PyPI 包配置，以及文档和示例。核心是 TurboQuantIndex 和 IdMapIndex 类，提供 add、search、write、load、sync 等 API。
zh.stack: Rust 编写，使用 SIMD 指令（NEON、AVX-512 等），Python 绑定通过 PyO3 实现，依赖 NumPy 处理数组。
zh.hot: star 数 15k+，今日新增 736，因为它在内存占用和搜索速度上超越 FAISS，且无需训练，直接在线索引，非常适合隐私敏感和资源受限的 RAG 场景。
uses: 构建本地或私有化 RAG 系统，需要低内存占用和高搜索性能
处理大规模向量数据（如千万级文档）但内存有限的环境
需要增量更新索引且要求崩溃安全的场景
对数据隐私要求严格，希望完全离线运行的 AI 应用

en.tag: Ultra-fast vector index on TurboQuant, 8x less memory
en.what: turbovec is a Rust vector index with Python bindings, built on Google Research's TurboQuant algorithm. It dramatically reduces memory footprint without sacrificing speed, supporting online incremental ingestion, SIMD-accelerated search, and incremental persistence.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core library, Python bindings, Cargo/PyPI packaging, plus docs and examples. Core classes are TurboQuantIndex and IdMapIndex with add, search, write, load, sync APIs.
en.stack: Written in Rust, uses SIMD instructions (NEON, AVX-512, etc.), Python bindings via PyO3, depends on NumPy for array handling.
en.hot: 15k+ stars, +736 today, because it beats FAISS in memory and speed, requires no training, and supports online indexing, ideal for privacy-sensitive and resource-constrained RAG.
uses: Building local or private RAG systems needing low memory and high search performance
Handling large-scale vector data (e.g., 10M docs) with limited memory
Scenarios requiring incremental index updates with crash safety
AI apps with strict privacy needs, wanting fully offline operation

zh.tag: Rust 原生高性能量化交易平台

zh.content: 仓库包含核心交易引擎、回测模块、市场数据适配器、策略框架以及多种交易所连接器。代码主要用 Rust 编写，同时提供 Python 绑定，包含完整的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，支持 Python 3.12-3.14，兼容 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。依赖包括 PyO3 用于 Python 绑定，以及 Arrow 等用于数据处理。
zh.hot: 凭借 25.9k 星标和今日新增 120 星，NautilusTrader 因其生产级 Rust 性能、确定性架构和活跃社区而备受关注，成为量化交易领域的热门选择。
uses: 量化交易员和算法工程师：用于构建低延迟交易策略和执行系统。
金融科技公司：作为交易基础设施的核心组件，支持回测和实盘交易。
研究人员：利用其高性能回测引擎进行策略研究和数据分析。
开发者：通过 Python API 快速原型设计，或使用 Rust 进行深度定制。

en.tag: Production-grade Rust-native algorithmic trading platform
en.what: NautilusTrader is a high-performance algorithmic trading platform built in Rust with a deterministic event-driven architecture, designed for production use. It offers low-latency, high-throughput execution and backtesting capabilities, with a Python API for strategy development and integration.
en.content: The repository contains the core trading engine, backtesting module, market data adapters, strategy framework, and various exchange connectors. The code is primarily in Rust with Python bindings, including comprehensive documentation and examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Python bindings for 3.12-3.14, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows. Dependencies include PyO3 for Python bindings and Arrow for data handling.
en.hot: With 25.9k stars and 120 new stars today, NautilusTrader gains attention for its production-grade Rust performance, deterministic architecture, and active community, making it a popular choice in algorithmic trading.
uses: Quant traders and algo engineers: for building low-latency trading strategies and execution systems.
Fintech companies: as a core component of trading infrastructure for backtesting and live trading.
Researchers: leveraging its high-performance backtesting engine for strategy research and data analysis.
Developers: rapid prototyping via Python API or deep customization with Rust.

zh.tag: LLM 流量代理与协议翻译，让代理用上开源模型
zh.what: Switchyard 是一个 Rust 编写的 LLM 流量代理和库，用于在提供商之间路由请求，并在 OpenAI Chat、Anthropic Messages 和 OpenAI Responses 格式之间进行翻译。它支持将 Claude Code 或 Codex 等编码代理指向开源模型，同时保持代理使用其原生 API。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的代理服务器（switchyard-server）、命令行启动器（switchyard launch）以及可嵌入的库。提供协议翻译、多后端路由（随机、LLM 分类器、信号驱动等）和 Prometheus 指标。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Rust，使用 Cargo 构建。CLI 通过 uv 安装，支持 Python 3.10 环境。依赖 OpenRouter API 密钥进行启动，可配置 TOML 路由文件。
zh.hot: 今日新增 421 星，总星数 819，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 11 名。它解决了将编码代理连接到开源模型的痛点，提供协议翻译和灵活路由，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 开发者希望用 Claude Code 或 Codex 等代理连接开源模型（如 vLLM、NVIDIA NIM、Ollama）
需要跨多个模型进行 A/B 测试或基准测试的团队
希望实现自定义路由算法或信号驱动路由的 AI 应用开发者
需要统一监控 LLM 流量指标（如延迟、令牌数）的运维人员

en.tag: Rust proxy for LLM traffic: translate APIs, route across backends, and run coding agents on open models
en.what: Switchyard is a Rust proxy and library for LLM traffic that routes requests across providers and translates between OpenAI Chat, Anthropic Messages, and OpenAI Responses formats. It enables coding agents like Claude Code or Codex to point at open-source models while keeping the agent speaking its native API.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust proxy server (switchyard-server), a CLI launcher (switchyard launch), and an embeddable library. It offers protocol translation, multi-backend routing (random, LLM-as-classifier, signal-driven), and Prometheus metrics.
en.stack: Primarily Rust with Cargo. The CLI is installed via uv with Python 3.10. It uses OpenRouter API keys for launching and supports TOML route configuration.
en.hot: Gained 421 stars today (total 819), ranking #11 on GitHub Trending. It addresses the pain point of connecting coding agents to open-source models with protocol translation and flexible routing, drawing significant attention.
uses: Developers who want to use coding agents like Claude Code or Codex with open-source models (vLLM, NVIDIA NIM, Ollama)
Teams needing A/B testing or benchmarking across multiple models
AI app developers wanting custom routing algorithms or signal-driven stage routing
Operators needing unified metrics (latency, tokens) for LLM traffic

zh.tag: 开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，支持多智能体协作
zh.what: OpenPencil 是全球首个开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，支持并发智能体团队。用户可以用自然语言描述界面，实时生成到无限画布上，并通过对话修改设计。它采用 Design-as-Code 理念，是 Pencil 的现代替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心引擎、桌面应用（op-host-desktop）、内置 MCP 服务器、多模型支持，以及多语言 README 和演示视频。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 构建，可能涉及 Tauri 或类似框架用于桌面应用，集成 MCP 服务器和多模型 AI 能力。
zh.hot: 作为首个开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，概念新颖，结合 AI 代理团队和实时生成，吸引了大量关注。今日新增 32 星，总星数达 4772，位列 Rust 趋势榜第三。
uses: 设计师和开发者：快速将想法转化为 UI 原型，提升设计效率。
产品经理：用自然语言描述需求，即时生成界面方案。
AI 爱好者：探索多智能体协作在创意工具中的应用。
开源社区：参与开发，扩展 MCP 服务器和模型集成。

en.tag: Open-source AI-native vector design tool with concurrent agent teams
en.what: OpenPencil is the world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool featuring concurrent agent teams. Users can describe UI in natural language and watch it appear on an infinite canvas in real-time, then modify designs through chat. It embraces Design-as-Code and serves as a modern alternative to Pencil.
en.content: The repository includes a Rust-based core engine, desktop app (op-host-desktop), built-in MCP server, multi-model intelligence, along with multilingual READMEs and demo videos.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, likely using Tauri or similar for the desktop app, integrating MCP server and multi-model AI capabilities.
en.hot: As the first open-source AI-native vector design tool, its novel concept combining AI agent teams and real-time generation attracts attention. With 32 stars today and 4772 total, it ranks #3 on the Rust trending list.
uses: Designers and developers: quickly turn ideas into UI prototypes, boosting design efficiency.
Product managers: describe requirements in natural language and get instant interface proposals.
AI enthusiasts: explore multi-agent collaboration in creative tools.
Open-source community: contribute to development, extend MCP server and model integrations.

zh.tag: 零配置终端 IDE，兼具 VS Code 体验与极速性能
zh.what: Fresh 是一款现代、功能齐全的终端文本编辑器，无需任何配置即可使用。它提供熟悉的快捷键、鼠标支持和 IDE 级功能，如命令面板、多光标编辑和 LSP 支持，旨在让用户无需学习曲线即可高效编辑。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、官方文档、演示 GIF 和安装脚本。核心功能包括文件管理、编辑、搜索替换、导航、分屏、主题定制、LSP 集成以及多任务编排器（基于 git worktree）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和 LSP 客户端。支持多平台，通过脚本安装。
zh.hot: 凭借零配置、类 VS Code 的体验和高效处理超大文件的能力，Fresh 在开发者中迅速走红，本周新增 117 星，总星数达 8372，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Rust）第 16 名。
uses: 终端爱好者：希望在终端中获得现代 IDE 体验，无需离开命令行。
服务器/远程开发：通过 SSH 在远程机器上编辑代码，享受本地 IDE 的便利。
性能敏感场景：需要打开超大文件或追求低延迟输入的用户。
极简主义者：厌倦了繁琐配置，想要开箱即用的编辑器。

en.tag: Zero-config terminal IDE with VS Code-like UX and blazing performance
en.what: Fresh is a modern, full-featured terminal text editor that works with zero configuration. It offers familiar keybindings, mouse support, and IDE-level features like command palette, multi-cursor editing, and LSP support, aiming to provide a seamless editing experience without a learning curve.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, official documentation, demo GIFs, and installation scripts. Key features include file management, editing, search & replace, navigation, split views, theming, LSP integration, and an orchestrator for multitasking with git worktrees.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and LSP client. Cross-platform with script-based installation.
en.hot: Fresh has gained rapid popularity among developers due to its zero-config, VS Code-like experience and ability to handle multi-gigabyte files efficiently, adding 117 stars this week to reach 8372 total, ranking #16 on GitHub Trending (Rust) weekly.
uses: Terminal enthusiasts: want a modern IDE experience in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Remote development: edit code on remote machines via SSH with local IDE conveniences.
Performance-sensitive tasks: need to open huge files or desire low-latency input.
Minimalists: tired of complex configuration, want an out-of-the-box editor.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 打造的高性能 JS/TS 工具链集合
zh.what: Oxc（氧化编译器）是用 Rust 编写的高性能 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 工具集合，旨在为 JS 生态提供统一、极速的开发工具链。它驱动了 Rolldown（Vite 的打包器），并支持下一代超快开发工具的无缝协作。
zh.content: 仓库包含解析器（Parser）、转换器（Transformer）、压缩器（Minifier）、模块解析器（Resolver）以及 linter（Oxlint）和格式化器（Oxfmt）等组件，并提供 CLI 工具和库供集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，利用其内存安全和零成本抽象实现高性能；同时提供 npm 包（如 oxlint、oxfmt）以便在 JS 生态中使用。
zh.hot: Oxc 因成为 Vite 下一代打包器 Rolldown 的核心而备受关注，其 Rust 实现带来显著的性能提升，吸引了大量 star（22k+），并在 GitHub Trending 上持续上榜。
uses: 前端工具链开发者：希望构建或集成高性能 JS 解析、转换、压缩功能的开发者。
使用 Vite/Rolldown 的团队：需要极速打包和开发体验的现代前端项目。
需要快速 lint 和格式化的项目：用 oxlint 和 oxfmt 替代传统工具以提升 CI 速度。
对 Rust 与 JS 互操作感兴趣的工程师：学习如何用 Rust 构建高性能 JS 工具。

en.tag: A collection of high-performance JavaScript/TypeScript tools written in Rust
en.what: Oxc (The Oxidation Compiler) is a collection of high-performance tools for JavaScript and TypeScript written in Rust, aiming to provide a unified, ultra-fast toolchain for the JS ecosystem. It powers Rolldown (Vite's bundler) and enables the next generation of seamlessly integrated, ultra-fast development tools.
en.content: The repository contains components such as a parser, transformer, minifier, module resolver, as well as linter (Oxlint) and formatter (Oxfmt), offering CLI tools and libraries for integration.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging its memory safety and zero-cost abstractions for high performance; also provides npm packages (e.g., oxlint, oxfmt) for use in the JS ecosystem.
en.hot: Oxc gains attention as the core of Rolldown, Vite's next-generation bundler, with its Rust implementation delivering significant performance improvements, attracting over 22k stars and consistently trending on GitHub.
uses: Developers building or integrating high-performance JS parsing, transformation, or minification features.
Teams using Vite/Rolldown: modern frontend projects needing blazing-fast bundling and dev experience.
Projects needing fast linting and formatting: replace traditional tools with oxlint and oxfmt to speed up CI.
Engineers interested in Rust-JS interop: learn how to build high-performance JS tools in Rust.

zh.tag: 光速开发的多人在线游戏与实时应用后端数据库
zh.what: SpacetimeDB 是一个将数据库与服务器逻辑合二为一的实时平台，允许开发者用 Rust 或 C# 编写存储过程，直接在数据库中运行游戏或应用的后端逻辑。它消除了传统客户端-服务器架构中的网络延迟和服务器管理开销，使开发速度大幅提升。
zh.content: 仓库包含 SpacetimeDB 的完整源码，包括数据库引擎、模块 SDK（Rust/C#）、CLI 工具、文档和示例，以及用于部署的 Docker 镜像和云服务配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Wasmtime 运行 WebAssembly 模块，支持 Rust 和 C# 作为模块语言，并提供了多种语言的客户端 SDK（如 TypeScript、Python、C#）。
zh.hot: 凭借 2.5 万+ Stars 和活跃的社区，SpacetimeDB 重新定义了实时应用后端，让开发者无需管理服务器即可构建可扩展的多人游戏和实时应用，契合了开发者对简化后端开发流程的强烈需求。
uses: 游戏开发者：快速构建多人游戏后端，无需自建服务器，专注游戏逻辑。
实时应用团队：需要低延迟数据同步的协作工具、直播互动等场景。
全栈开发者：希望用 Rust/C# 编写后端逻辑，减少前后端沟通成本。
初创公司：快速验证产品原型，降低基础设施运维负担。

en.tag: A database for real-time apps and games, backend at the speed of light
en.what: SpacetimeDB is a real-time platform that combines database and server logic, letting developers write stored procedures in Rust or C# to run backend logic directly inside the database. It eliminates network latency and server management overhead of traditional client-server architectures, accelerating development.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of SpacetimeDB, including the database engine, module SDKs (Rust/C#), CLI tools, documentation, examples, and Docker images for deployment.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging Wasmtime to run WebAssembly modules, supporting Rust and C# as module languages, with client SDKs for TypeScript, Python, C#, etc.
en.hot: With 25k+ stars and an active community, SpacetimeDB redefines real-time backends, allowing developers to build scalable multiplayer games and real-time apps without managing servers, meeting a strong demand for simplified backend development.
uses: Game developers: quickly build multiplayer game backends without managing servers, focusing on game logic.
Real-time app teams: scenarios requiring low-latency data sync like collaboration tools or live interactions.
Full-stack developers: write backend logic in Rust/C# to reduce frontend-backend communication overhead.
Startups: rapidly prototype products while reducing infrastructure maintenance burden.

zh.tag: 高性能多人协作代码编辑器，Atom 与 Tree-sitter 作者打造
zh.what: Zed 是一款由 Rust 编写的高性能多人协作代码编辑器，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。它强调极快的响应速度和流畅的多人实时协作体验，旨在让开发者“以思维的速度编码”。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Zed 编辑器源代码，涵盖编辑器核心、协作功能、UI 组件、以及针对各平台的构建脚本和文档。还包含贡献指南、许可证信息以及第三方依赖的许可证管理工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Tree-sitter 进行语法解析，使用 cargo-about 管理开源许可证，并利用 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 凭借其卓越的性能和多人协作特性，Zed 在开发者中广受好评，目前拥有 88k+ 星标，今日新增 81，持续位列 Rust 趋势榜前列。
uses: 追求极致响应速度和流畅编辑体验的开发者
需要实时多人协作编码的团队
对 Rust 或编辑器开发感兴趣的开源贡献者
希望使用现代、高性能编辑器的程序员

en.tag: High-performance multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter
en.what: Zed is a high-performance multiplayer code editor written in Rust, available on macOS, Linux, and Windows. It emphasizes lightning-fast responsiveness and seamless real-time collaboration, aiming to let developers 'code at the speed of thought'.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of the Zed editor, including the editor core, collaboration features, UI components, and build scripts and documentation for each platform. It also includes contribution guidelines, license information, and tools for managing third-party dependency licenses.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging Tree-sitter for syntax parsing, using cargo-about for open-source license compliance, and GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: With its outstanding performance and multiplayer collaboration features, Zed has gained wide acclaim among developers, currently holding 88k+ stars, with 81 added today, consistently ranking high on the Rust trending list.
uses: Developers seeking ultimate responsiveness and smooth editing experience
Teams needing real-time collaborative coding
Open-source contributors interested in Rust or editor development
Programmers wanting a modern, high-performance editor

zh.tag: Rust 桌面 UI 组件库，基于 GPUI 构建跨平台应用
zh.what: 这是一个基于 GPUI 的 Rust 桌面 UI 组件库，提供 60+ 跨平台组件，包括表格、列表、图表、代码编辑器等。它分为两层：gpui-component 提供开箱即用的样式组件，gpui-base 提供无样式的基础行为与基础设施，让开发者可以自由定制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的组件库源码、文档、示例和测试。核心是 gpui-component 和 gpui-base 两个 crate，以及用于展示的 website 目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 GPUI 框架，以及 Tree Sitter 用于语法高亮，支持 Markdown 渲染和虚拟化列表/表格。
zh.hot: 凭借丰富的组件、高性能和双层架构设计，在 Rust 社区迅速走红，今日新增 123 星，总星数达 12809，位列 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 7。
uses: Rust 开发者：希望用 Rust 构建跨平台桌面应用，需要现成 UI 组件。
桌面应用团队：需要高性能表格、编辑器等复杂组件，同时希望保持设计一致性。
设计系统开发者：希望基于 gpui-base 构建自己的设计系统，同时复用交互逻辑。

en.tag: Rust desktop UI component library for building cross-platform apps with GPUI
en.what: This is a Rust desktop UI component library built on GPUI, offering 60+ cross-platform components including tables, lists, charts, and a code editor. It is structured in two layers: gpui-component provides styled, ready-to-use components, while gpui-base offers unstyled behavior and infrastructure for full customization.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code for the component library, documentation, examples, and tests. The core is two crates: gpui-component and gpui-base, along with a website directory for showcasing.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the GPUI framework, with Tree Sitter for syntax highlighting, Markdown rendering, and virtualized lists/tables.
en.hot: With its rich components, high performance, and two-layer architecture, it has quickly gained popularity in the Rust community, adding 123 stars today and reaching 12,809 total, ranking #7 on GitHub Trending for Rust today.
uses: Rust developers: Want to build cross-platform desktop apps with Rust and need ready-made UI components.
Desktop app teams: Need high-performance complex components like tables and editors while maintaining design consistency.
Design system developers: Want to build their own design system on gpui-base while reusing interaction logic.

zh.tag: 极速 DataFrame 查询引擎，Rust 编写，支持多语言
zh.what: Polars 是一个用 Rust 编写的极速 DataFrame 分析查询引擎，提供惰性/急切执行、查询优化和流式处理，支持超出内存的数据集。它提供 Python、Rust、Node.js、R 和 SQL 绑定，并可选 GPU 加速。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 库、多语言绑定（Python、Node.js、R）、用户指南、文档和插件接口，以及用于扩展的 I/O 和表达式插件。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 实现，利用多线程和 SIMD 向量化执行，采用 Apache Arrow 列式格式进行零拷贝数据共享，支持 GPU 加速（NVIDIA）。
zh.hot: Polars 凭借其卓越的性能和易用性在数据科学社区广受欢迎，star 数接近 4 万，今日新增 13 个，持续活跃。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师：处理大型数据集，进行快速数据清洗和转换。
数据工程师：构建高效的数据管道，处理超出内存的数据。
Python/R/Node.js 开发者：在各自语言环境中利用高性能 DataFrame 操作。
需要 GPU 加速查询的用户：利用 NVIDIA GPU 加速数据处理。

en.tag: Ultra-fast DataFrame query engine in Rust with multi-language bindings
en.what: Polars is an extremely fast DataFrame analytical query engine written in Rust, featuring lazy/eager execution, query optimization, and streaming for larger-than-RAM datasets. It offers bindings for Python, Rust, Node.js, R, and SQL, with optional GPU acceleration.
en.content: The repository contains the core Rust library, multi-language bindings (Python, Node.js, R), user guide, documentation, and plugin interfaces for I/O and expression extensions.
en.stack: Built on Rust with multi-threaded, vectorized (SIMD) execution, uses Apache Arrow columnar format for zero-copy data sharing, and supports optional NVIDIA GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Polars is highly popular in the data science community for its outstanding performance and ease of use, with nearly 40k stars and 13 new stars today, showing sustained activity.
uses: Data scientists and analysts: for fast data cleaning and transformation on large datasets.
Data engineers: building efficient data pipelines handling larger-than-RAM data.
Python/R/Node.js developers: leveraging high-performance DataFrame operations in their preferred language.
Users needing GPU acceleration: accelerating data processing with NVIDIA GPUs.

zh.tag: 快速、省磁盘的 Node.js 包管理器
zh.what: pnpm 是一个快速且节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器，通过内容寻址存储来链接文件，避免重复下载。它支持 monorepo，提供严格的依赖隔离和确定性锁文件，并可作为 Node.js 版本管理器使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 pnpm 的核心代码、CLI 工具、文档（支持多语言）以及一个实验性的 Rust 移植版本（pacquet）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，但包含 Rust 实验性移植。依赖 Node.js 生态，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。
zh.hot: pnpm 以其速度和磁盘效率著称，比 npm/yarn 快 2 倍，被微软等大型团队用于 monorepo，star 数达 36k，持续活跃。
uses: Node.js 开发者，希望加速依赖安装并节省磁盘空间
维护 monorepo 的团队，需要高效管理多包依赖
对严格依赖隔离和确定性构建有要求的项目

en.tag: Fast, disk space efficient package manager for Node.js
en.what: pnpm is a fast and disk space efficient package manager for Node.js. It links files from a single content-addressable storage to avoid duplication. It supports monorepos, strict dependency isolation, deterministic lockfiles, and can act as a Node.js version manager.
en.content: The repository contains the core code of pnpm, CLI tools, documentation (multi-language), and an experimental Rust port called pacquet.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, with an experimental Rust port. It relies on the Node.js ecosystem and supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: pnpm is known for its speed and disk efficiency, up to 2x faster than alternatives, used by large teams like Microsoft for monorepos. With 36k stars, it remains highly active.
uses: Node.js developers who want faster installs and less disk usage
Teams maintaining monorepos needing efficient multi-package dependency management
Projects requiring strict dependency isolation and deterministic builds

zh.tag: 一条命令为你的硬件找到最合适的 LLM 模型
zh.what: llmfit 是一个终端工具，能根据你的系统 RAM、CPU 和 GPU 自动检测硬件，并为数百个模型和提供商评分，告诉你哪些模型能在你的机器上流畅运行。它提供交互式 TUI 和经典 CLI 两种模式，支持多 GPU、MoE 架构、动态量化选择、速度估算以及本地运行时提供商（如 Ollama、llama.cpp 等）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、TUI 和 CLI 实现、基准测试指南（docs/benchmarking.md）、TUI 指南（docs/tui.md），以及用于演示的 demo.gif 和图标资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和模型推理后端（Ollama、llama.cpp、MLX 等），通过 crates.io 分发。
zh.hot: 星标数达 32k，今日新增近 200，因其解决了本地 LLM 选型的痛点，且新版本支持基准测试并贡献结果，让用户获得真实硬件上的实测数据，迅速走红。
uses: 本地 LLM 爱好者：快速找到适合自己电脑配置的模型，避免下载后跑不动的尴尬。
开发者：在开发环境中评估不同模型的性能，优化推理速度和资源占用。
硬件评测者：通过基准测试功能，分享自己机器上的实测数据，帮助社区完善模型适配信息。

en.tag: One command to find the right LLM for your hardware
en.what: llmfit is a terminal tool that detects your hardware and scores hundreds of models across quality, speed, fit, and context dimensions, telling you which ones will run well on your machine. It features an interactive TUI and classic CLI mode, supporting multi-GPU setups, MoE architectures, dynamic quantization, speed estimation, and local runtime providers like Ollama and llama.cpp.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, TUI and CLI implementations, benchmarking guide (docs/benchmarking.md), TUI guide (docs/tui.md), plus demo.gif and icon assets.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and model inference backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, etc.), distributed via crates.io.
en.hot: With 32k stars and ~200 new today, it solves the pain point of choosing the right local LLM, and the new benchmarking feature lets users contribute real measured data, driving its popularity.
uses: Local LLM enthusiasts: quickly find models that fit your hardware, avoiding downloads that won't run.
Developers: evaluate model performance in dev environments to optimize inference speed and resource usage.
Hardware reviewers: use benchmarking to share real measured data and improve community model-fit information.

zh.tag: 本地优先的轻量级 microVM 运行时，秒级启动，嵌入即用
zh.what: Microsandbox 是一个用 Rust 编写的轻量级 microVM 运行时，能在本地快速启动隔离环境，用于运行不受信任的代码，如 AI 代理、用户代码、插件、CI 任务等。它提供硬件级隔离，同时保持 Docker 类似的工作流，启动时间平均低于 100 毫秒。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心运行时、CLI 工具、可嵌入的库，以及用于 Agent 的 Skills 和 MCP 服务器集成。支持跨平台（Linux、macOS、Windows），兼容 OCI 镜像，并提供 Docker 风格的命令、镜像和卷管理。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 microVM 技术（如 Firecracker 或类似）实现硬件隔离，支持 OCI 容器镜像标准，并提供 MCP 服务器和 Agent Skills 集成。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理的兴起，对安全隔离运行不受信任代码的需求激增，Microsandbox 提供了快速、本地优先的解决方案，启动速度极快，且易于嵌入，因此迅速获得关注，本周新增 300 星，总星数接近 8000。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理提供安全的沙箱环境，执行用户代码或工具调用。
SaaS 平台：运行多租户插件或用户提交的代码，确保隔离与安全。
CI/CD 流水线：在隔离环境中运行构建和测试任务，避免污染宿主机。
本地开发：快速启动干净的开发环境或测试环境，无需完整虚拟机。

en.tag: Easy, fast, local-first microVM runtime for untrusted workloads
en.what: Microsandbox is a lightweight microVM runtime written in Rust that quickly launches isolated environments locally for untrusted workloads like AI agents, user code, plugins, CI jobs, and more. It provides hardware-level isolation while maintaining Docker-like workflows, with average boot times under 100 milliseconds.
en.content: The repository includes the core runtime, CLI tools, an embeddable library, and integrations for Agent Skills and MCP server. It supports cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows), OCI image compatibility, and Docker-like commands, images, and volume management.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, leveraging microVM technology (like Firecracker or similar) for hardware isolation, supporting OCI container image standards, and providing MCP server and Agent Skills integrations.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents, the need for securely isolating untrusted code has surged. Microsandbox offers a fast, local-first solution with instant startup and easy embeddability, quickly gaining traction with 300 new stars this week, totaling nearly 8,000.
uses: AI agent developers: provide secure sandbox environments for agents to execute user code or tool calls.
SaaS platforms: run multi-tenant plugins or user-submitted code with strong isolation and security.
CI/CD pipelines: run build and test tasks in isolated environments to avoid host contamination.
Local development: quickly spin up clean development or test environments without full VMs.

zh.tag: 多模态 AI 数据湖仓，开发者友好的嵌入式向量检索库
zh.what: LanceDB 是一个开源的多模态 AI 数据湖仓，专为 AI/ML 应用设计，提供快速、可扩展、生产级的向量搜索。它基于 Lance 列式格式，支持存储、索引和搜索 PB 级的多模态数据与向量，并支持向量相似性搜索、全文搜索和 SQL。
zh.content: 仓库包含 LanceDB 的核心实现（Rust 编写），提供 Python、JavaScript 等客户端库，以及文档、教程和示例。还包括与云服务（LanceDB Cloud）的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，基于 Lance 列式格式，支持 GPU 加速索引构建，提供多语言客户端（Python、JS 等）。
zh.hot: 随着多模态 AI 应用爆发，开发者需要高效管理向量数据，LanceDB 提供嵌入式、零拷贝、自动版本管理等特性，且完全开源，因此迅速获得关注。本周新增 92 星，总星数达 11263，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: AI 应用开发者：需要为聊天机器人、推荐系统等构建向量搜索功能。
数据科学家：希望快速存储和查询大规模多模态数据集，用于模型训练和评估。
机器学习工程师：需要生产级向量数据库，支持高并发和低延迟检索。
开源爱好者：关注嵌入式数据库和列式存储技术，希望参与贡献。

en.tag: Developer-friendly embedded retrieval library for multimodal AI, built on Lance columnar format
en.what: LanceDB is an open-source multimodal AI data lakehouse designed for AI/ML applications, offering fast, scalable, and production-ready vector search. Built on the Lance columnar format, it enables storing, indexing, and searching petabytes of multimodal data and vectors, with support for vector similarity search, full-text search, and SQL.
en.content: The repository contains the core implementation of LanceDB (written in Rust), client libraries for Python, JavaScript, and more, along with documentation, tutorials, and examples. It also includes integration with LanceDB Cloud.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the Lance columnar format, supports GPU-accelerated index building, and provides multi-language clients (Python, JS, etc.).
en.hot: With the explosion of multimodal AI applications, developers need efficient vector data management. LanceDB offers embedded, zero-copy, automatic versioning, and is fully open-source, quickly gaining attention. It gained 92 stars this week, reaching 11,263 total, and appeared on GitHub Trending.
uses: AI app developers: need to build vector search for chatbots, recommendation systems, etc.
Data scientists: want to quickly store and query large-scale multimodal datasets for model training and evaluation.
ML engineers: need a production-grade vector database with high concurrency and low latency retrieval.
Open-source enthusiasts: interested in embedded databases and columnar storage, want to contribute.

zh.tag: Rust 原生 AI 代理持久化记忆数据库
zh.what: RuVector 是一个用 Rust 构建的高性能实时自学习 AI 记忆数据库，专为 AI 代理设计，支持跨会话记忆。它结合了本地语义嵌入、持久向量检索、图关系、显式反馈学习和记忆生命周期控制，无需数据库服务器或 API 密钥即可运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心库（ruvector-core）、Node.js 绑定（npm 包 ruvector）、命令行工具（npx ruvector）以及示例代码，支持语义嵌入（ONNX 模型）和向量存储。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，提供 npm 包和 npx CLI，依赖 ONNX Runtime 进行本地嵌入，支持多种距离度量（如余弦相似度）。
zh.hot: 凭借 4447 颗星和今日新增 3 星，RuVector 在 Rust 趋势榜上排名第 14，其独特卖点是无需外部服务即可为 AI 代理提供持久化记忆，吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要跨会话记忆的聊天机器人或自主代理，可快速集成持久化记忆。
隐私敏感应用：要求数据本地处理，避免云端 API 的合规场景。
Rust 与 Node.js 开发者：希望用 Rust 高性能内核，同时用 JavaScript 快速构建原型。

en.tag: Rust-native persistent memory DB for AI agents
en.what: RuVector is a high-performance, real-time, self-learning AI memory database built in Rust, designed for AI agents to remember across sessions. It combines local semantic embeddings, persistent vector retrieval, graph relationships, explicit feedback learning, and memory lifecycle controls, and runs without a database server or API key.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust core library (ruvector-core), Node.js bindings (npm package ruvector), a CLI tool (npx ruvector), and examples, supporting semantic embeddings (ONNX model) and vector storage.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with npm package and npx CLI, leveraging ONNX Runtime for local embeddings, supporting various distance metrics like cosine similarity.
en.hot: With 4,447 stars and 3 new stars today, RuVector ranks #14 on the Rust trending list, attracting developers with its unique value proposition of persistent memory for AI agents without external services.
uses: AI agent developers: chatbots or autonomous agents needing cross-session memory can quickly integrate persistent memory.
Privacy-sensitive applications: compliance scenarios requiring local data processing, avoiding cloud APIs.
Rust and Node.js developers: want high-performance Rust core with rapid JavaScript prototyping.

zh.tag: AI 账号管理与协议转换的本地调度网关
zh.what: Antigravity Tools 是一款专为开发者和 AI 爱好者设计的桌面应用，提供多账号管理、协议转换和智能请求调度功能。它可以将 Web 端 Session（如 Google/Anthropic）转化为标准化的 API 接口，充当本地 AI 中转站，打破不同厂商间的协议壁垒。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Tauri v2 桌面应用源码，前端使用 React，后端为 Rust，提供账号管理界面、协议转换模块和请求调度引擎。同时附带详细的文档、安装指南和赞助商信息。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Tauri v2 + React + Rust，依赖现代 Web 前端生态和 Rust 系统级性能，支持跨平台桌面部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 30.7k Stars 和本周新增 287 星，登上 GitHub Trending（Rust 周榜第 22），因其解决了 AI 用户多账号切换和 API 协议不兼容的痛点，且提供一键无缝切换的便捷体验。
uses: AI 开发者和爱好者，需要管理多个 AI 服务账号并统一调用 API 接口。
频繁切换 Google/Anthropic 等 Web 端 Session 的用户，希望简化工作流程。
需要低成本、稳定且高效的本地 AI 中转方案的企业或个人开发者。

en.tag: Local AI gateway for multi-account management and protocol conversion
en.what: Antigravity Tools is a desktop app for developers and AI enthusiasts, offering multi-account management, protocol conversion, and intelligent request scheduling. It converts web sessions (e.g., Google/Anthropic) into standardized API endpoints, acting as a local AI relay to bridge protocol gaps between vendors.
en.content: The repo contains the full source code of a Tauri v2 desktop app with a React frontend and Rust backend, featuring account management UI, protocol conversion modules, and a request scheduling engine. It also includes detailed docs, installation guides, and sponsor info.
en.stack: Built with Tauri v2, React, and Rust, leveraging modern web frontend and Rust's system-level performance for cross-platform desktop deployment.
en.hot: With 30.7k stars and +287 this week, it hit #22 on GitHub Trending (Rust weekly), solving the pain of multi-account switching and API protocol incompatibility for AI users with one-click seamless switching.
uses: AI developers and enthusiasts managing multiple AI service accounts and unifying API calls.
Users who frequently switch web sessions (Google/Anthropic) and want a streamlined workflow.
Enterprises or individual developers needing a low-cost, stable, and efficient local AI relay solution.

zh.tag: 高密度多路复用、亚秒级挂起/恢复的 Agent 运行时基础设施
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个为大规模 Agent 部署提供高性能、高密度运行时环境的系统。它通过控制平面管理 Agent 沙箱的完整生命周期，支持亚秒级的挂起/恢复操作，并允许将大量 Agent 多路复用到底层计算基础设施上。该系统并非用于构建 Agent 的 SDK，而是用于大规模运行 Agent 的底层系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心控制平面实现，支持多种沙箱技术（如 microVM 和 gVisor），并基于 Kubernetes 进行基础设施供给和 Worker 生命周期管理。提供演示视频和详细文档，展示如何将约 250 个有状态 Actor 多路复用到 8 个物理 Pod 上。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes（Pod 和自动扩缩容）进行基础设施管理，并集成 microVM 和 gVisor 等沙箱技术。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）排名第 3，今日新增 26 颗星，总星数达 1270。其核心卖点——亚秒级挂起/恢复和高密度多路复用——解决了 Agent 部署中的关键痛点，因此受到广泛关注。
uses: 需要大规模运行 AI Agent 的团队，希望降低基础设施成本并提高资源利用率
构建 Agent 编排平台的开发者，需要底层生命周期管理和流量路由
从事强化学习（RL）场景的工程师，需要统一管理 Agent、推理和训练基础设施

en.tag: High-density, sub-second suspend/resume runtime infrastructure for large-scale agent deployments
en.what: Agent Substrate is a system that provides a performant, high-density runtime environment for large-scale agent deployments. Its control plane manages the full lifecycle of agent sandboxes, enabling sub-second suspend/resume operations and heavy multiplexing of agents onto shared compute infrastructure. It is not an SDK for building agents but a system for running them at scale.
en.content: The repository contains the core control plane implementation, supporting multiple sandbox technologies (e.g., microVMs and gVisor), and leverages Kubernetes for infrastructure provisioning and worker lifecycle management. It includes a demo video and detailed documentation showing how to multiplex ~250 stateful actors across just 8 physical pods.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it leverages Kubernetes (Pods and autoscaling) for infrastructure management and integrates sandbox technologies like microVMs and gVisor.
en.hot: Ranked #3 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily, gaining 26 stars today to reach 1270 total. Its key selling points—sub-second suspend/resume and high-density multiplexing—address critical pain points in agent deployment, driving significant interest.
uses: Teams deploying AI agents at scale, aiming to reduce infrastructure costs and improve resource utilization
Developers building agent orchestration platforms that require underlying lifecycle management and traffic routing
Engineers working on reinforcement learning (RL) scenarios needing unified management of agentic, inference, and training infrastructure

zh.tag: 订阅转 API 网关，拼车共享 AI 额度
zh.what: Sub2API 是一个开源 AI API 网关平台，用于将 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Grok 等订阅统一转换为 API 接口，支持拼车共享，降低使用成本。它允许用户将订阅额度分配给多个成员，并通过标准 API 无缝使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Vue 3 前端面板、Docker 部署配置，以及多语言 README（英文、中文、日文）。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Go 1.26.5、Vue 3.4+、PostgreSQL 15+、Redis 7+，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 37.8k 星标和日增 153 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜，因其解决 AI 订阅成本高昂的痛点，提供拼车共享方案，受到开发者追捧。
uses: 个人开发者：将多个 AI 订阅统一为 API，便于集成到自己的工具。
小团队：拼车共享订阅额度，降低 AI 使用成本。
AI 应用开发者：需要稳定 API 网关，支持多模型路由。

en.tag: Subscription-to-API gateway for sharing AI quotas
en.what: Sub2API is an open-source AI API gateway platform that converts subscriptions from Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, etc., into unified API endpoints, supporting carpooling to share quotas and reduce costs. It allows users to distribute subscription quotas among members and use them seamlessly via standard APIs.
en.content: The repository contains a Go backend, Vue 3 frontend panel, Docker deployment configs, and multilingual READMEs (English, Chinese, Japanese).
en.stack: Tech stack: Go 1.26.5, Vue 3.4+, PostgreSQL 15+, Redis 7+, Docker-ready.
en.hot: With 37.8k stars and +153 today, it hit the GitHub trending chart, addressing the pain point of high AI subscription costs via carpooling, gaining popularity among developers.
uses: Individual developers: unify multiple AI subscriptions into APIs for integration into own tools.
Small teams: share subscription quotas to reduce AI costs.
AI app developers: need a stable API gateway with multi-model routing.

zh.tag: AI代理的操作系统，让多个代理协作自动化
zh.what: CompozyOS是一个为AI代理设计的操作系统，它将你已有的代理CLI（如Claude Code、Codex等）整合成一个团队，让它们分工协作、自动运行任务并共享项目记忆。你可以在浏览器中全面掌控所有代理活动。
zh.content: 仓库包含Go编写的核心守护进程、Web界面（位于packages/site）、CLI工具和文档，支持通过ACP兼容的代理CLI（如Claude Code、OpenClaw、Hermes）进行交互。
zh.stack: 主要使用Go语言，采用SQLite存储状态，支持HTTP/SSE、UDS、MCP等多种接口，本地优先设计。
zh.hot: 本周新增107星，总星数达2626，登上GitHub Go语言周榜第21名。它解决了多代理协作和自动化运维的痛点，将复杂的代理工程化封装成简单产品，受到开发者关注。
uses: 开发者：希望将多个AI代理（如Claude Code、Codex）整合成团队，自动化日常编码任务。
技术运维：需要持续运行的自动化任务（如定时任务、webhook触发）并希望集中监控和审批。
团队协作：共享项目记忆和代理工作状态，便于团队协作和知识沉淀。

en.tag: An OS for AI agents, turning CLIs into a collaborative team
en.what: CompozyOS is an operating system for AI agents, integrating your existing agent CLIs (like Claude Code, Codex) into a team that splits work, automates tasks, and shares memory. You control everything from a browser.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based daemon, a web shell (packages/site), CLI tools, and docs, interacting with ACP-compatible agent CLIs like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes.
en.stack: Primarily Go, with SQLite-backed storage, supporting HTTP/SSE, UDS, MCP interfaces, and a local-first design.
en.hot: Gained 107 stars this week, totaling 2626, ranking #21 on GitHub Go weekly trending. It addresses the pain point of multi-agent collaboration and automation, packaging complex agent engineering into a simple product, attracting developers.
uses: Developers: Want to integrate multiple AI agents (like Claude Code, Codex) into a team to automate coding tasks.
Technical operators: Need continuously running automations (cron, webhooks) with centralized monitoring and approvals.
Team collaboration: Share project memory and agent activity for better teamwork and knowledge retention.

zh.tag: Go 语言高性能并行 Lint 工具
zh.what: golangci-lint 是一个快速运行的 Go 语言 linter 聚合工具，它并行执行多个 linter，利用缓存加速，支持 YAML 配置，并集成主流 IDE。它内置超过一百种 linter，帮助开发者发现代码中的错误、风格问题和潜在缺陷。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 源码、文档（位于 golangci-lint.run）、安装脚本、CI 配置、Docker 镜像以及贡献者列表。核心是一个命令行工具，通过配置文件选择并运行多个 linter。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 生态中的各种 linter 库，支持 YAML 配置，并提供 Docker 镜像和 CI 集成。
zh.hot: 作为 Go 社区的标准 lint 工具，拥有 19k+ star，今日新增 9 星并登上 Go 日榜，因其高效并行和丰富 linter 集成而广受欢迎。
uses: Go 开发者：在本地开发或 CI 中运行 lint 检查，提升代码质量
团队协作：统一代码风格和规范，减少 review 时间
开源项目维护者：集成到 CI 流程，自动检查 PR 代码

en.tag: Fast parallel linter runner for Go with caching and 100+ linters
en.what: golangci-lint is a fast linter runner for Go that executes linters in parallel, uses caching, supports YAML configuration, and integrates with major IDEs. It includes over a hundred linters to help developers catch errors, style issues, and potential bugs.
en.content: The repository contains Go source code, documentation (hosted at golangci-lint.run), installation scripts, CI configs, Docker images, and a contributors list. The core is a CLI tool that runs multiple linters via configuration.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging various linter libraries from the Go ecosystem, supports YAML config, and provides Docker images and CI integration.
en.hot: As the standard lint tool for Go, it has 19k+ stars, gained 9 stars today, and ranked #4 on the Go daily trending list, popular for its parallel efficiency and extensive linter integration.
uses: Go developers: run lint checks locally or in CI to improve code quality
Teams: unify code style and standards, reduce review time
Open-source maintainers: integrate into CI to automatically check PRs

zh.tag: JavaScript 的超集，为大型应用提供类型系统
zh.what: TypeScript 是一种开源的编程语言，是 JavaScript 的超集，通过添加可选的静态类型来提升代码的可维护性和可扩展性。它编译为干净的、基于标准的 JavaScript，可在任何浏览器、主机或操作系统上运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编译器的完整源代码，包括解析器、类型检查器、转换器和命令行工具。还包含测试套件、文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写（自举），构建工具使用 Gulp，测试框架使用 Mocha 等。
zh.hot: TypeScript 已成为现代 JavaScript 开发的标准，拥有超过 11 万 star，今日新增 168，在 GitHub Trending 上持续热门。
uses: 前端开发者：在 React、Vue 等框架中使用 TypeScript 提升代码质量和开发效率。
后端开发者：使用 Node.js 和 TypeScript 构建可维护的服务器端应用。
大型团队：通过类型系统减少协作中的错误，提高代码可读性。

en.tag: A superset of JavaScript that adds static types for large-scale applications
en.what: TypeScript is an open-source programming language that is a superset of JavaScript, adding optional static types to improve code maintainability and scalability. It compiles to clean, standards-based JavaScript that runs on any browser, host, or OS.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the TypeScript compiler, including the parser, type checker, emitter, and command-line tools. It also includes test suites, documentation, and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript (self-hosted), built with Gulp, and tested with Mocha and other tools.
en.hot: TypeScript has become the standard for modern JavaScript development, with over 110k stars and 168 new stars today, keeping it trending on GitHub.
uses: Frontend developers: Use TypeScript with frameworks like React and Vue to improve code quality and productivity.
Backend developers: Build maintainable server-side applications with Node.js and TypeScript.
Large teams: Reduce errors and improve code readability through the type system.

zh.tag: 现代跨平台任务运行器，Make 的替代品
zh.what: Task 是一个受 Make 启发但面向现代工作流的快速跨平台构建工具。它使用简单的 YAML 文件定义任务，支持依赖、并行执行和 shell 命令，旨在替代 Make 提供更直观、可维护的自动化体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 Go 编写的命令行工具源码、完整的文档网站（位于 website/ 目录）、示例任务文件以及用于测试的集成测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 YAML 解析库（如 goccy/go-yaml）和 mvdan/sh 用于 shell 解释，支持跨平台编译。
zh.hot: 拥有 16k+ 星标，本周新增 53 星，位列 Go 周榜第 10。作为 Make 的现代替代品，它解决了 Make 的跨平台和语法问题，受到开发者社区的持续关注。
uses: 开发者日常自动化任务，如构建、测试、部署等，替代 Makefile 提供更清晰的语法。
跨平台项目（Windows/macOS/Linux）需要统一任务命令的场景，避免 shell 差异。
CI/CD 流水线中定义和执行步骤，利用并行执行和依赖管理提升效率。

en.tag: A modern cross-platform task runner, a faster and simpler alternative to Make
en.what: Task is a fast, cross-platform build tool inspired by Make, designed for modern workflows. It uses a simple YAML file to define tasks, supports dependencies, parallel execution, and shell commands, aiming to replace Make with a more intuitive and maintainable automation experience.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of the CLI tool written in Go, a full documentation website (in the website/ directory), example task files, and integration tests.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it relies on YAML parsing libraries (e.g., goccy/go-yaml) and mvdan/sh for shell interpretation, with cross-platform compilation support.
en.hot: With 16k+ stars and 53 new stars this week, ranking 10th on the Go weekly trending list. As a modern alternative to Make, it solves Make's cross-platform and syntax issues, gaining sustained attention from the developer community.
uses: Developers automating daily tasks like build, test, and deploy, replacing Makefiles with cleaner syntax.
Cross-platform projects (Windows/macOS/Linux) needing unified task commands, avoiding shell differences.
Defining and executing steps in CI/CD pipelines, leveraging parallel execution and dependency management for efficiency.

zh.tag: 分布式存储系统，支持对象存储、文件系统与 Iceberg 表
zh.what: SeaweedFS 是一个分布式存储系统，支持对象存储（S3 兼容）、文件系统和 Iceberg 表，能够处理数十亿文件，具有 O(1) 磁盘访问和轻松水平扩展的能力。它旨在提供高效、可扩展的存储解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含 SeaweedFS 的完整源代码，包括 master、volume、filer 等核心组件，以及客户端库、命令行工具、Docker 镜像和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 gRPC、S3 协议、FUSE 等，支持多种存储后端和平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 34k+ 星标和稳定增长，SeaweedFS 因其高性能、易扩展和多功能性在开发者中广受欢迎，本周新增 154 星，位列 Go 周榜第 10。
uses: 适合需要大规模对象存储的云原生应用，如备份、归档和媒体存储。
适用于构建分布式文件系统，支持 POSIX 兼容的挂载和访问。
适合数据湖场景，支持 Iceberg 表格式，用于大数据分析。
适合需要 S3 兼容存储的开发者，可无缝迁移现有应用。

en.tag: Distributed storage for object storage, file systems, and Iceberg tables
en.what: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system that supports object storage (S3-compatible), file systems, and Iceberg tables, designed to handle billions of files with O(1) disk access and effortless horizontal scaling. It aims to provide efficient and scalable storage solutions.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of SeaweedFS, including core components like master, volume, and filer, along with client libraries, command-line tools, Docker images, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging gRPC, S3 protocol, FUSE, and supporting multiple storage backends and platforms.
en.hot: With 34k+ stars and steady growth, SeaweedFS is popular among developers for its high performance, easy scalability, and versatility, gaining 154 stars this week and ranking #10 on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Ideal for cloud-native applications requiring large-scale object storage, such as backups, archives, and media storage.
Suitable for building distributed file systems with POSIX-compatible mounting and access.
Great for data lake scenarios, supporting Iceberg table format for big data analytics.
Perfect for developers needing S3-compatible storage to seamlessly migrate existing applications.

zh.tag: 为 Web 应用提供单点登录与多因素认证的开源门户
zh.what: Authelia 是一个开源的身份认证和授权服务器，为 Web 应用提供单点登录（SSO）和多因素认证（MFA）。它作为反向代理的认证门户，保护应用并集中管理用户身份。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Authelia 的完整源代码、文档、示例配置、Docker 镜像构建文件以及用于测试的自动化脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Redis 或 SQLite 作为存储后端，支持 LDAP 和 OAuth2/OIDC 集成。
zh.hot: 因其开源、自托管且通过 OpenID 认证的 SSO/MFA 方案而广受好评，本周新增 89 星，总星数达 28661，位列 Go 周榜第 11。
uses: 希望为家庭或自建服务添加统一登录和双因素认证的开发者
需要为企业内部应用提供集中身份认证和访问控制的管理员
对数据隐私敏感、希望避免使用商业 SSO 服务的组织

en.tag: Open-source SSO and MFA portal for web apps, OpenID Certified
en.what: Authelia is an open-source authentication and authorization server providing Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for web applications. It acts as an authentication portal behind a reverse proxy, securing apps and centralizing user identity.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, example configurations, Docker image build files, and automated test scripts for Authelia.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with Redis or SQLite as storage backends, and supports LDAP and OAuth2/OIDC integration.
en.hot: Praised for its open-source, self-hosted, OpenID Certified SSO/MFA solution, it gained 89 stars this week, reaching 28,661 total, ranking #11 on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Developers looking to add unified login and 2FA to home-lab or self-hosted services
Administrators needing centralized authentication and access control for internal enterprise apps
Organizations with data privacy concerns that prefer avoiding commercial SSO services

zh.tag: 将 AI 代理会话与 Git 提交绑定的可搜索开发记录工具
zh.what: Entire CLI 是一个 Git 原生工具，可自动捕获 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex 等）的会话记录，并将其与 Git 提交关联索引。它提供完整的提示词/响应记录、文件变更、token 使用等，帮助开发者理解代码变更原因、从检查点恢复，并保持 Git 历史整洁。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 二进制，提供安装脚本（Homebrew、Scoop）、命令参考、插件系统、配置文档，以及支持多种代理的钩子集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Git 钩子机制，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows，兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等代理。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程代理的普及，开发者需要追溯代码变更原因和恢复会话，Entire 填补了这一需求，上线后迅速获得 5000+ star，并登上 GitHub 周榜。
uses: 开发者希望理解 AI 生成的代码变更原因，查看完整提示词和响应记录。
团队需要审计和合规追踪，记录 AI 交互历史以满足要求。
在代理出错时，需要从已知良好检查点快速恢复工作流。
新成员通过查看从提示到提交的路径，加速项目上手。

en.tag: Git-native tool that captures and indexes AI agent sessions alongside commits
en.what: Entire CLI is a Git-native tool that automatically captures AI coding agent sessions (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) and indexes them alongside Git commits. It provides full prompt/response transcripts, file changes, token usage, and more, helping developers understand why code changed, resume from checkpoints, and keep Git history clean.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI binary, installation scripts (Homebrew, Scoop), command reference, plugin system, configuration docs, and hook integrations for multiple agents.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging Git hooks, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows, compatible with agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, developers need to trace why code changed and resume sessions; Entire fills this gap, quickly gaining 5000+ stars and trending on GitHub.
uses: Developers who want to understand why AI-generated code changed, viewing full prompt and response transcripts.
Teams needing audit and compliance tracking, recording AI interaction history to meet requirements.
Users who need to quickly resume from a known-good checkpoint when an agent goes sideways.
New members who can onboard faster by seeing the path from prompt to change to commit.

zh.tag: 开源电动车充电控制器与家庭能源管理系统
zh.what: evcc 是一个可扩展的电动车充电控制器和家庭能源管理系统，旨在提供本地能源管理，不依赖云服务。它支持多种充电桩、智能开关和热泵，并具有简洁的用户界面。

家庭能源管理者需要集成多种设备，实现智能用电。
开源爱好者对自托管能源管理系统感兴趣。

en.tag: Open-source EV charge controller and home energy management system
en.what: evcc is an extensible EV charge controller and home energy management system that provides local energy management without relying on cloud services. It supports a wide range of chargers, smart switches, and heat pumps, and features a clean user interface.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation, screenshots, and build configuration, with Docker deployment support and integration of various device drivers.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging various open-source libraries, supporting Docker containerization, and integrating protocols like EEBus and OCPP.

Home energy managers needing to integrate multiple devices for smart power usage.
Open-source enthusiasts interested in self-hosted energy management systems.

zh.tag: 跨平台开源备份工具，支持加密、压缩与去重

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source backup tool with encryption, compression, and deduplication
en.what: Kopia is a fast and secure open-source backup/restore tool for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It allows users to create encrypted snapshots of their data and save them to local, network, or cloud storage, with both CLI and GUI interfaces.

System administrators automating backup and recovery for servers and cloud environments.

Privacy-conscious users requiring end-to-end encryption and user-controlled keys.

zh.tag: 隐私优先的 Chromium 浏览器，无广告无臃肿

Developers interested in its patch set and build tooling for reference or reuse.

zh.tag: 多平台世嘉 Dreamcast/Naomi 模拟器

en.what: Flycast is a multi-platform emulator for Sega Dreamcast, Naomi, Naomi 2, and Atomiswave arcade systems. Derived from reicast, it offers high compatibility and performance across various devices.

Developers: study emulator implementation or contribute code to improve compatibility.
Arcade enthusiasts: experience Naomi and Atomiswave arcade games.

zh.tag: Google 跨语言结构化数据序列化协议
zh.what: Protocol Buffers 是 Google 开发的跨语言、跨平台的数据交换格式，用于高效序列化结构化数据。它通过定义 .proto 文件，自动生成多种语言的代码，实现数据的快速编码与解码。

zh.stack: 核心使用 C++ 编写，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建，并集成 OpenSSF Scorecard 安全评估。
zh.hot: 作为数据序列化的行业标准，被无数项目和系统依赖，star 数高达 7 万+，持续稳定更新。
uses: 后端服务间通信协议定义（如 gRPC）
大数据与分布式系统的数据存储与交换
跨语言 API 开发，需要高效序列化的场景
学习高性能序列化设计与实现

en.tag: Google's language-neutral data serialization protocol
en.what: Protocol Buffers is Google's language-neutral, platform-neutral, extensible mechanism for serializing structured data. It uses .proto files to generate code in multiple languages for efficient encoding and decoding.
en.content: The repository contains the C++ implementation of the protocol compiler (protoc), runtime libraries for various languages, and extensive documentation and build configurations (e.g., Bazel and CMake).
en.stack: Core written in C++, built with Bazel and CMake, and integrated with OpenSSF Scorecard for security assessment.
en.hot: As an industry standard for data serialization, it is relied upon by countless projects and systems, with over 70k stars and continuous stable updates.

Data storage and exchange in big data and distributed systems
Cross-language API development requiring efficient serialization
Learning high-performance serialization design and implementation

zh.tag: 面向移动端与穿戴设备的混合边缘-云 AI 推理引擎
zh.what: Cactus 是一个专为移动设备、穿戴设备、智能家居和机器人设计的 AI 推理引擎，支持文本、语音和视觉任务。它采用混合边缘-云架构，在设备端运行量化模型，必要时可无缝切换至云端模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含四个核心组件：Cactus Engine（提供 OpenAI 兼容 API）、Cactus Graph（零拷贝计算图）、Cactus Kernels（针对 Apple、Samsung、Pixel 等设备的 CPU/GPU 内核）、Cactus Quants（基于旋转的量化技术）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建，支持跨平台（包括 Mac、移动设备等）。集成了量化、内核优化和推理运行时，并提供 Python 绑定（可能）。
zh.hot: 凭借 5738 颗星和今日新增 22 颗星，Cactus 因填补了移动端高效 AI 推理的空白而受到关注，其混合边缘-云架构和独特的旋转量化技术吸引了开发者。
uses: 移动应用开发者：在 iOS/Android 应用中集成本地 AI 能力，如聊天、语音识别。
硬件厂商：为智能家居、机器人等设备提供低延迟、低功耗的 AI 推理方案。
边缘计算研究者：探索混合边缘-云推理和新型量化技术的实践。

en.tag: Hybrid edge-cloud AI engine for mobile, wearables, and robots
en.what: Cactus is an AI inference engine designed for mobile devices, wearables, smart home, and robots, supporting text, speech, and vision tasks. It uses a hybrid edge-cloud architecture, running quantized models on-device with seamless cloud handoff when needed.
en.content: The repo contains four core components: Cactus Engine (OpenAI-compatible APIs), Cactus Graph (zero-copy computation graph), Cactus Kernels (CPU/GPU kernels for Apple, Samsung, Pixel, etc.), and Cactus Quants (custom rotation-based quantization).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, built with CMake, cross-platform (including Mac and mobile). Integrates quantization, kernel optimization, and inference runtime, with possible Python bindings.
en.hot: With 5,738 stars and 22 new stars today, Cactus gains attention for filling the gap in efficient on-device AI inference, attracting developers with its hybrid edge-cloud architecture and unique rotation-based quantization.
uses: Mobile app developers: integrate on-device AI capabilities like chat and speech recognition into iOS/Android apps.
Hardware vendors: provide low-latency, low-power AI inference for smart home and robotics devices.
Edge computing researchers: explore hybrid edge-cloud inference and novel quantization techniques in practice.
