zh.tag: Rust 编写的下一代 Coding Agent Harness，极致性能与多会话支持
zh.what: jcode 是一款基于 Rust 的下一代 Coding Agent Harness，旨在提升 AI 编程助手的技能上限。它专为多会话工作流、无限可定制性与极致性能而设计，能够在本地以极低资源消耗运行复杂编程任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心运行时、跨平台 CLI 安装脚本（Linux/macOS/Windows），以及展示内存与启动速度优势的基准测试数据。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 为主语言，强调零成本抽象与资源效率；支持可选本地嵌入模型，通过 Bash/PowerShell 脚本实现一键跨平台安装。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程工具同质化严重的背景下，jcode 凭借 8421 Star 和 Rust 日榜第 11 名的热度，以单会话 27.8 MB 的超低内存占用和多会话架构，精准击中开发者对高性能本地 Agent 的需求。
uses: 追求本地低内存、高性能 AI 编程体验的核心开发者
需要长期运行多会话复杂工作流的高级用户
希望深度定制 Coding Agent 行为与工具链的极客与团队

en.tag: Next-gen coding agent harness in Rust for multi-session, low-RAM workflows
en.what: jcode is a next-generation coding agent harness built in Rust to raise the skill ceiling of AI coding assistants. It is designed for multi-session workflows, infinite customizability, and extreme performance, allowing complex coding tasks to run locally with minimal resource usage.
en.content: The repo includes a Rust core runtime, cross-platform CLI installers for Linux/macOS/Windows, and benchmark data highlighting its memory and boot-up speed advantages.
en.stack: Primarily Rust with zero-cost abstraction and resource efficiency in mind; supports optional local embeddings and one-click cross-platform installation via Bash/PowerShell scripts.
en.hot: With 8,421 stars and a spot at #11 on GitHub's Rust daily trending list, jcode stands out in the crowded AI coding space by delivering an ultra-low 27.8 MB RAM footprint per session and a multi-session architecture that meets developers' demand for high-performance local agents.
uses: Core developers seeking local, low-memory, high-performance AI coding experiences
Power users running long-term, complex multi-session workflows
Hackers and teams wanting infinite customizability of their coding agent behavior and toolchain

zh.tag: 面向真实工程师的 AI 代理技能集
zh.what: 这是一套由资深工程师设计的 AI 代理技能（skills），旨在帮助开发者进行真正的工程开发，而非简单的“氛围编码”。它提供可组合、易定制的小型技能模块，适用于任何模型，并支持通过 skills.sh 或 Claude Code 插件安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个可选的技能模块（如 /triage、/setup-matt-pocock-skills 等），以及一个快速安装脚本和 Claude Code 插件配置。用户通过 npx 命令选择安装，并运行设置向导完成配置。
zh.stack: 基于 Shell 脚本和 Node.js（npx），可选集成 Claude Code 插件。依赖 skills.sh 生态。
zh.hot: 凭借 18.6 万+ Star 和每日 2251 新增，该项目因解决 AI 编程中“真实工程”痛点而爆火，提供比 GSD、BMAD 等更可控、可定制的方案。
uses: 专业开发者 —— 希望用 AI 辅助真实工程开发，而非简单代码生成
AI 代理用户 —— 使用 Claude Code、Codex 等工具的工程师，需要结构化技能集
技术团队 —— 统一团队 AI 工作流，提升代码质量和可维护性

en.tag: AI agent skills for real engineers
en.what: A set of AI agent skills designed by a senior engineer for real engineering work, not vibe coding. It offers small, composable, and customizable skill modules that work with any model, installable via skills.sh or as a Claude Code plugin.
en.content: The repo contains multiple optional skill modules (e.g., /triage, /setup-matt-pocock-skills), a quick install script, and a Claude Code plugin configuration. Users select skills via npx and run a setup wizard to configure.
en.stack: Built on Shell scripts and Node.js (npx), with optional Claude Code plugin integration. Depends on the skills.sh ecosystem.
en.hot: With 186k+ stars and 2251 daily additions, this project exploded by addressing the pain point of 'real engineering' in AI coding, offering a more controllable and customizable alternative to GSD, BMAD, etc.
uses: Professional developers — who want AI to assist real engineering, not just code generation
AI agent users — engineers using Claude Code, Codex, etc., needing structured skill sets
Tech teams — to standardize AI workflows and improve code quality and maintainability

zh.tag: 港大出品的 AI 私人家教：个性化终身学习工作区
zh.what: 香港大学 HKUDS 实验室的「agent 原生」学习平台：聊天辅导、刷题测验、深度研究、可视化、解题、Mastery Path 掌握度练习跑在同一套 agent 循环上。支持多引擎 RAG 知识库（LlamaIndex、PageIndex、GraphRAG、LightRAG，可挂 Obsidian 库），可从任意对话呼叫 Claude Code / Codex 等子 agent；带三层可检查记忆（L1 trace / L2 摘要 / L3 综合）和 Memory Graph 溯源。
zh.content: 完整 Web 应用（Python 后端 + Next.js 16 前端），附 11 种语言 README、Docker 部署、CLI/agent-native 接口、EduHub 社区 skills 生态；发版极勤。
zh.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16，RAG 多引擎 + MCP 工具 + FAISS 向量库，Apache-2.0；2025 年 12 月底创建，有 arXiv 论文背书。
zh.hot: 它把 AI 教育与 Agent 原生工作流结合，并由高校实验室持续维护，概念清晰、可体验性强。
uses: 学生 / 自学者 —— 把教材和论文喂进去，得到 24 小时私人家教
考研 / 考证党 —— 用刷题测验 + 掌握度路径系统备考
知识管理玩家 —— 直接挂 Obsidian 库做 RAG 问答

en.tag: An AI personal tutor from HKU: a lifelong, personalized learning workspace
en.what: An 'agent-native' learning platform from HKU's HKUDS lab: chat tutoring, quizzes, deep research, visualization, problem solving and Mastery-Path practice all run on one agent loop. It supports multi-engine RAG knowledge bases (LlamaIndex, PageIndex, GraphRAG, LightRAG — even your Obsidian vault), lets you call Claude Code / Codex sub-agents from any conversation, and ships three-layer inspectable memory (L1 trace / L2 summary / L3 synthesis) with a Memory Graph for provenance.
en.content: A full web app (Python backend + Next.js 16 frontend) with READMEs in 11 languages, Docker deployment, CLI/agent-native interfaces and the EduHub community skills ecosystem; releases ship very frequently.
en.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16, multi-engine RAG + MCP tools + FAISS; Apache-2.0; created late December 2025 with an arXiv paper behind it.
en.hot: It combines AI education with an agent-native workflow and carries the credibility of a university research lab, making the concept easy to evaluate and share.
uses: Students & self-learners — feed in textbooks and papers, get a 24/7 personal tutor
Exam candidates — prepare systematically with quizzes and the mastery path
PKM enthusiasts — plug your Obsidian vault straight in for RAG Q&A

zh.tag: 开源AI自动化渗透测试工具，自主发现并修复应用漏洞
zh.what: Strix 是一个开源的 AI 渗透测试平台，通过自主 AI 代理动态运行代码，像真实黑客一样侦察、利用并验证应用漏洞。它通过生成实际的可利用 Proof-of-Concept 来确认漏洞，而非仅依赖静态分析的误报，并支持多代理协作规模化执行安全测试。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的渗透测试工具包，支持侦察、漏洞利用与验证开箱即用；同时提供 GitHub Actions 集成与 CI/CD 流水线插件，可自动扫描 Pull Request 并在代码合并前阻断不安全提交。
zh.stack: 项目以 Python 为主要语言构建，支持通过 PyPI 分发安装（strix-agent），并依赖现代 AI 代理编排框架实现多智能体协作；可与现有 DevOps 工具链深度集成。
zh.hot: 该项目月增 16,488 Star 跃至 GitHub 月榜第 5 名，总星数突破 42,318；其“AI + 动态 PoC 验证”模式精准击中了传统静态扫描误报率高、人工渗透测试成本高的痛点，成为安全左移趋势下的热门方案。
uses: 开发团队 —— 在 CI/CD 中自动化安全扫描，在代码合并前拦截漏洞
安全工程师 —— 利用多 AI 代理协作执行大规模渗透测试与漏洞验证
DevOps/平台团队 —— 将安全左移，无需额外基础设施即可接入现有流水线

en.tag: Open-source autonomous AI pentesting agents that find and fix app vulnerabilities
en.what: Strix is an open-source AI-powered penetration testing platform where autonomous agents dynamically run code to discover and validate vulnerabilities like real hackers. It generates working proofs-of-concept rather than static-analysis false positives, and scales through multi-agent orchestration for collaborative security testing.
en.content: The repository ships with a full pentesting toolkit covering reconnaissance, exploitation, and validation out of the box. It also provides GitHub Actions integration and CI/CD pipeline plugins to auto-scan pull requests and block insecure code before it reaches production.
en.stack: Built primarily in Python and distributed via PyPI as strix-agent, it relies on modern AI agent orchestration frameworks for multi-agent collaboration and deep integration with existing DevOps toolchains.
en.hot: With 16,488 new stars this month and a #5 spot on GitHub Trending, it has climbed to 42,318 total stars. Its “AI + dynamic PoC validation” model directly addresses the high false-positive rates of legacy scanners and the cost of manual pentesting, making it a standout in the shift-left security movement.
uses: Development teams — Automate security scanning in CI/CD to intercept vulnerabilities before code merges.
Security engineers — Leverage multi-agent AI collaboration for large-scale pentesting and real exploit validation.
DevOps/platform teams — Shift security left by plugging into existing pipelines with zero additional infrastructure.

zh.tag: 开源身份认证与单点登录平台
zh.what: authentik 是一个开源的身份提供商（IdP），为现代应用提供单点登录（SSO）功能。它支持 SAML、OAuth2/OIDC、LDAP、RADIUS 等多种协议，适用于从个人实验室到大型生产集群的自托管场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 authentik 的核心服务、Outpost（用于代理和认证的组件）以及 Web 前端。提供 Docker Compose、Kubernetes Helm Chart、AWS CloudFormation 和 DigitalOcean Marketplace 等多种部署方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，后端基于 Django，前端使用 Web 技术（如 JavaScript/TypeScript）。依赖 PostgreSQL、Redis 等常见基础设施组件。
zh.hot: 作为开源替代 Okta、Auth0 等商业 IdP 的方案，authentik 在自托管社区中广受欢迎。今日新增 138 星，总星数达 23168，位列 GitHub 趋势榜第五。
uses: 自托管爱好者：希望完全掌控身份认证基础设施的个人或团队。
中小企业：需要替代昂贵商业 IdP 的可靠身份管理方案。
开发者：需要为应用集成 SSO 或统一认证流程的开发者。
DevOps 工程师：在 Kubernetes 或云环境中部署和管理身份服务。

en.tag: Open-source identity provider and SSO solution
en.what: authentik is an open-source Identity Provider (IdP) that provides single sign-on (SSO) for modern applications. It supports protocols like SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, RADIUS, and more, designed for self-hosting from small labs to large production clusters.
en.content: The repository contains the core server, outposts (for proxy and authentication), and web frontend. Deployment options include Docker Compose, Kubernetes Helm, AWS CloudFormation, and DigitalOcean Marketplace.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, with backend based on Django and frontend using web technologies (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript). It relies on common infrastructure components like PostgreSQL and Redis.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to commercial IdPs like Okta and Auth0, authentik is popular in the self-hosting community. With 138 stars today and 23,168 total, it ranks #5 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts: individuals or teams wanting full control over their identity infrastructure.
SMBs: seeking a reliable identity management solution to replace costly commercial IdPs.
Developers: needing to integrate SSO or unify authentication flows in their applications.
DevOps engineers: deploying and managing identity services in Kubernetes or cloud environments.

zh.tag: AI 文本去味剂，让机器写作更自然
zh.what: 一个便携的代理技能，用于去除文本中 AI 写作的痕迹，使其听起来更自然、更像人类。它基于维基百科的“AI 写作迹象”指南，并包含二次润色和防幻觉机制。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 SKILL.md 文件，可通过 skills CLI 或手动安装到任何支持技能指令的代理框架中。支持全局或项目级安装，并可作为 Claude Code 插件使用。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 技能文件，无外部依赖，可在任何支持技能指令的代理框架中运行。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1504 星，总星数 31573，排名 Python 周榜第 16。因其解决了 AI 写作“一眼假”的痛点，且安装使用极其简单，受到开发者社区追捧。
uses: 内容创作者 —— 将 AI 草稿润色为自然的人类风格，避免被检测
开发者 —— 集成到代理工作流中，自动优化 AI 生成的文本输出
学术写作者 —— 确保论文或报告中的 AI 辅助内容更符合人类写作习惯

en.tag: Remove AI-generated writing signs, make text sound human
en.what: A portable agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text, making it sound more natural and human. It is based on Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing' guide and includes a second rewrite pass with hallucination prevention.
en.content: The repo contains a single SKILL.md file that can be installed via skills CLI or manually into any agent harness supporting skill-style instructions. Supports global or project-local install and can be used as a Claude Code plugin.
en.stack: Plain Markdown skill file with no external dependencies, runs in any harness that supports skill-style instructions.
en.hot: Gained 1504 stars this week, total 31573, ranked #16 on Python weekly trending. It addresses the pain point of AI-generated text being easily detectable, and is extremely easy to install and use.
uses: Content creators — polish AI drafts into natural human style to avoid detection
Developers — integrate into agent workflows to automatically optimize AI-generated text output
Academic writers — ensure AI-assisted content in papers or reports reads more naturally

zh.tag: 系统设计面试与大规模系统学习一站式指南
zh.what: 这是一个系统设计入门与面试准备的综合性资源库，涵盖大规模系统设计的原则、案例和面试题。它提供结构化的学习路径，帮助工程师掌握构建可扩展系统的能力，并配有 Anki 闪卡辅助记忆。
zh.content: 仓库包含系统设计基础、可扩展性、可用性、一致性等主题的详细笔记，以及常见面试题和解决方案，配有图表和代码示例。还提供多语言翻译和 Anki 闪卡。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，但内容以 Markdown 文档为主，辅以图表（如 PNG 图片）和代码片段。依赖 Anki 用于闪卡学习。
zh.hot: 作为系统设计面试的经典资源，star 数高达 36 万，今日新增 733，长期占据 GitHub 趋势榜。其全面性和实用性使其成为工程师的必备参考。
uses: 准备系统设计面试的求职者 — 提供常见问题和解决方案，助你高效备考。
希望提升系统架构能力的工程师 — 系统学习大规模系统设计原则。
技术面试官 — 参考其中问题与答案，设计面试题目。
计算机科学学生 — 作为系统设计课程的补充教材。

en.tag: One-stop guide for system design interviews and large-scale system learning
en.what: A comprehensive resource for learning system design and preparing for interviews, covering principles, case studies, and interview questions. It offers a structured learning path to help engineers master building scalable systems, with Anki flashcards for memorization.
en.content: The repo contains detailed notes on system design fundamentals, scalability, availability, consistency, etc., along with common interview questions and solutions with diagrams and code examples. It also offers multi-language translations and Anki flashcards.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, but content is mostly Markdown documents, supplemented with diagrams (e.g., PNG images) and code snippets. Uses Anki for flashcards.
en.hot: As a classic resource for system design interviews, it has 362k stars, with 733 new today, consistently trending on GitHub. Its comprehensiveness and practicality make it a must-have reference for engineers.
uses: Job seekers preparing for system design interviews — provides common questions and solutions for efficient preparation.
Engineers looking to improve system architecture skills — systematically learn large-scale system design principles.
Technical interviewers — reference questions and answers to design interview problems.
Computer science students — as supplementary material for system design courses.

zh.tag: 把书、视频、播客蒸馏成可调用的 AI 技能包
zh.what: 这是一个将书籍、长视频、播客等高价值内容中的方法论，通过 RIA-TV++ 流水线蒸馏成结构化、可调用的 AI Skills 的工具。它解决了知识停留在“看过/听过”层面、无法在真实场景中被 AI 调用的问题，让知识真正变成可执行的工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 RIA-TV++ 方法论实现、Python 脚本、模板（如 BOOK_OVERVIEW.md、INDEX.md、DIGEST.md），以及示例输出。它生成一个多 skill 仓库，包含整体概览、提取的框架/原则/案例/反例/术语、三重验证、RIA++ 结构化、Zettelkasten 链接、压力测试和最终交付物。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 OpenAI/Claude API 进行 LLM 调用，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等平台，可搭配 video-downloader 等技能使用。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4632 星，总星数达 6991，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 12 名。它切中了知识管理痛点，将内容蒸馏成 AI 可调用的技能，与 nuwa-skill 等热门项目形成生态，引发广泛关注。
uses: 知识工作者：希望将阅读的书籍、观看的视频转化为可复用的 AI 技能，提升工作效率。
AI 应用开发者：需要从大量文本中提取结构化方法论，构建 agent 工具链。
终身学习者：解决“看过但用不上”的问题，让知识在真实场景中被调用。
内容创作者：将自己的课程、演讲等系统性内容蒸馏成可交互的 AI 技能包。

en.tag: Distill books, videos, podcasts into executable AI skill packs
en.what: This tool distills methodologies from high-value content like books, long videos, and podcasts into structured, callable AI Skills using the RIA-TV++ pipeline. It addresses the problem of knowledge remaining at the 'watched/listened' level and not being usable by AI in real scenarios, turning knowledge into executable tools.
en.content: The repo contains the full RIA-TV++ methodology implementation, Python scripts, templates (e.g., BOOK_OVERVIEW.md, INDEX.md, DIGEST.md), and example outputs. It generates a multi-skill repository including overview, extracted frameworks/principles/cases/counterexamples/terms, triple verification, RIA++ structuring, Zettelkasten linking, stress tests, and final deliverables.
en.stack: Primarily Python, relies on OpenAI/Claude APIs for LLM calls, supports platforms like Claude Code and Cursor, and can be used with skills like video-downloader.
en.hot: Gained 4,632 stars this month, reaching 6,991 total, ranking 12th on GitHub Trending monthly. It addresses the pain point of knowledge management by distilling content into AI-callable skills, forming an ecosystem with popular projects like nuwa-skill, sparking widespread interest.
uses: Knowledge workers: Want to turn books and videos into reusable AI skills to boost productivity.
AI app developers: Need to extract structured methodologies from large texts to build agent toolchains.
Lifelong learners: Solve the 'consumed but not applied' problem, making knowledge callable in real scenarios.
Content creators: Distill their courses, talks, etc., into interactive AI skill packs.

zh.tag: 数学视频动画引擎，3Blue1Brown 出品
zh.what: Manim 是一个用于创建精确编程动画的引擎，专为制作解释性数学视频而设计。它由 3Blue1Brown 的作者开发，用于制作其 YouTube 视频中的动画。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ManimGL 的源代码，包括核心动画模块、场景类、图形对象和渲染器。还提供了示例场景和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+，依赖 FFmpeg、OpenGL 和可选的 LaTeX。Linux 系统需要 Pango。
zh.hot: 作为 3Blue1Brown 官方工具，拥有近 9 万星标，今日新增 381 星，持续受到数学教育者和视频创作者的关注。
uses: 数学教育者：制作教学视频中的动画演示
视频创作者：为科普内容添加精确的数学动画
开发者：学习或扩展动画引擎，定制自己的数学可视化

en.tag: Animation engine for explanatory math videos by 3Blue1Brown
en.what: Manim is an engine for precise programmatic animations, designed for creating explanatory math videos. It was developed by the author of 3Blue1Brown for animating those videos.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for ManimGL, including core animation modules, scene classes, mobjects, and renderers. It also includes example scenes and documentation.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+, with dependencies on FFmpeg, OpenGL, and optional LaTeX. Pango is required on Linux.
en.hot: As the official tool of 3Blue1Brown, it has nearly 90k stars, with 381 stars added today, continuing to attract math educators and video creators.
uses: Math educators: create animated demonstrations for teaching videos
Video creators: add precise math animations to science content
Developers: learn or extend the animation engine for custom math visualizations

zh.tag: Google 产品与技术的 Agent Skills 集合
zh.what: 这是一个包含 Google 产品和技术的 Agent Skills 仓库，提供可复用的技能模块，帮助 AI 代理执行云平台操作、解决方案架构等任务。通过 npx 命令即可安装和选择所需技能。
zh.content: 仓库内包含多个技能目录，涵盖 Google Cloud 入门、多产品解决方案、AI/ML 平台管理等，每个技能以 Markdown 文件形式提供详细指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 npx 进行安装，技能内容基于 Markdown 编写。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理的兴起，开发者需要标准化的技能库来增强代理能力，Google 官方出品使其备受关注，star 数迅速增长。
uses: 开发者：为 AI 代理添加 Google Cloud 操作技能，快速集成云服务。
解决方案架构师：利用预置的技能模板设计云架构和数据分析流程。
AI 平台管理员：管理模型部署、调优和监控，提升运维效率。

en.tag: Agent Skills for Google products and technologies
en.what: This repository contains Agent Skills for Google products and technologies, offering reusable skill modules that enable AI agents to perform cloud platform operations, solution architecture, and more. Skills can be installed via npx command with selective installation.
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill directories covering Google Cloud onboarding, multi-product solutions, AI/ML platform management, etc., with each skill provided as detailed Markdown files.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, installed via npx, with skills written in Markdown.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents, developers need standardized skill libraries to enhance agent capabilities, and Google's official offering has gained significant attention, leading to rapid star growth.
uses: Developers: Add Google Cloud operational skills to AI agents for quick cloud integration.
Solution architects: Use pre-built skill templates to design cloud architectures and data analytics workflows.
AI platform admins: Manage model deployment, tuning, and monitoring to improve operational efficiency.

zh.tag: 2027暑期科技实习岗位汇总，每日更新
zh.what: 这是一个由Pitt CSC和Simplify维护的GitHub仓库，汇总了2027年夏季的科技实习岗位，涵盖软件工程、数据科学、AI/ML、量化金融、产品管理和硬件工程等领域。列表每日更新，并提供分类浏览和贡献指南。
zh.content: 仓库包含632个实习岗位，按类别分类（如软件工程206个、数据科学/AI/ML 224个等），并附有图例说明（如是否提供sponsorship、是否要求公民身份等）。还包含非活跃列表、淡季列表和新毕业生职位链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用Python进行数据处理和自动化更新，依赖GitHub Issues和Actions来维护列表。
zh.hot: 该仓库因提供及时、全面的实习信息而广受欢迎，star数已达46.8k，本月新增1438，在Python趋势榜排名第18。
uses: 计算机及相关专业学生寻找2027年暑期实习，快速筛选合适岗位。
求职者利用分类和筛选条件，高效定位软件工程、AI等方向的实习机会。
社区贡献者通过提交issue或PR，帮助维护和更新实习列表。

en.tag: Curated list of Summer 2027 tech internships, updated daily
en.what: This repo, maintained by Pitt CSC and Simplify, aggregates Summer 2027 tech internship postings across software engineering, data science, AI/ML, quant finance, product management, and hardware. It's updated daily and offers categorized browsing and contribution guidelines.
en.content: The repo contains 632 internship roles categorized by type (e.g., 206 software engineering, 224 data science/AI/ML), with a legend for sponsorship, citizenship, and other flags. It also links to inactive listings, off-season roles, and new-grad positions.
en.stack: Primarily uses Python for data processing and automated updates, relying on GitHub Issues and Actions to maintain the list.
en.hot: The repo is popular for providing timely and comprehensive internship info, with 46.8k stars and +1,438 this month, ranking #18 on the Python trending list.
uses: CS and related majors seeking Summer 2027 internships to quickly filter suitable roles.
Job seekers using categories and filters to efficiently locate internships in software engineering, AI, etc.
Community contributors helping maintain and update the list by submitting issues or PRs.

zh.tag: AI 工作流共享与跨代理协作的开源桌面应用
zh.what: OpenWork 是一款免费开源的桌面应用，旨在共享 AI 工作流。它是 Claude Cowork 和 Codex 的开源替代品，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。用户可以通过 MCP 集成到 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 等代理中，复用技能、MCP 和连接服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用源码、MCP 集成指南、OpenWork Den 组织管理后台文档，以及安装脚本和配置文件。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 MCP 协议与远程 API，支持与多种 AI 代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor）集成。
zh.hot: 作为 Claude Cowork 的开源替代，填补了 AI 工作流共享的空白，17k+ Stars 表明社区对跨代理协作工具的强烈需求。
uses: AI 开发者 —— 在不同代理间复用技能和 MCP，提升效率
团队协作 —— 通过 OpenWork Den 管理组织内的工作流和权限
个人用户 —— 创建并分享 AI 工作流，或本地使用桌面应用

en.tag: Open-source desktop app for sharing AI workflows and cross-agent collaboration
en.what: OpenWork is a free, open-source desktop app for sharing AI workflows. It serves as an open-source alternative to Claude Cowork and Codex for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Users can integrate it via MCP into agents like Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, etc., reusing skills, MCPs, and connected services.
en.content: The repo includes the desktop app source code, MCP integration guides, OpenWork Den organization admin documentation, and installation scripts/config files.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, relies on MCP protocol and remote API, integrates with various AI agents like Claude Code and Cursor.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Claude Cowork, it fills the gap in AI workflow sharing. 17k+ Stars indicate strong community demand for cross-agent collaboration tools.
uses: AI developers — reuse skills and MCPs across different agents for efficiency
Team collaboration — manage workflows and permissions via OpenWork Den
Individual users — create and share AI workflows, or use the desktop app locally

zh.tag: 轻量云原生 GIS 平台，跨端运行且数据本地化
zh.what: GeoLibre 是一个免费开源的轻量级云原生 GIS 平台，用于可视化、探索和分析地理空间数据。它可在浏览器、桌面、移动端和 Jupyter 笔记本中运行，同时保持数据本地和私密。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档、示例和插件系统，提供 Web 应用、桌面应用、移动应用以及 Python/R 包。内置 1000+ 地理处理工具，基于 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行。
zh.stack: 基于 Tauri v2、React、TypeScript、MapLibre GL JS、DuckDB-WASM Spatial 和 deck.gl 构建。支持多平台分发，包括 Microsoft Store、Mac App Store、App Store、Google Play 等。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4325 星，总星数达 6035，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜第 20 名。其跨平台能力、数据隐私保护和丰富的内置工具吸引了大量关注。
uses: GIS 专业人士和地理数据科学家，用于快速可视化和分析空间数据。
开发人员，希望集成地理空间功能到 Web、桌面或移动应用。
教育工作者和学生，在 Jupyter 笔记本中教学和学习 GIS。
需要本地化、隐私保护的地理数据处理场景。

en.tag: Lightweight cloud-native GIS platform, cross-platform with local-first data
en.what: GeoLibre is a free and open-source, lightweight, cloud-native GIS platform for visualizing, exploring, and analyzing geospatial data. It runs in the web browser, on the desktop, on mobile, and inside Jupyter notebooks, all while keeping your data local and private.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation, examples, and a plugin system, offering web, desktop, mobile apps, and Python/R packages. It ships 1,000+ geoprocessing tools that run entirely in the browser via WebAssembly.
en.stack: Built with Tauri v2, React, TypeScript, MapLibre GL JS, DuckDB-WASM Spatial, and deck.gl. Distributed across multiple platforms including Microsoft Store, Mac App Store, App Store, Google Play, and more.
en.hot: Gained 4,325 stars this month, reaching 6,035 total, ranking #20 on GitHub Trending monthly. Its cross-platform capability, data privacy, and rich built-in tools have attracted significant attention.
uses: GIS professionals and geospatial data scientists for quick visualization and analysis.
Developers integrating geospatial capabilities into web, desktop, or mobile apps.
Educators and students teaching/learning GIS in Jupyter notebooks.
Scenarios requiring local, privacy-preserving geospatial data processing.

zh.tag: 开源智能体操作系统，让 AI 代理自主运行
zh.what: elizaOS 是一个开源的 TypeScript 框架和产品栈，用于构建和运行自主 AI 代理。它提供核心运行时、Eliza 应用、CLI、云服务和原生桥接，支持从聊天、语音到设备控制等多种能力。
zh.content: 该仓库是一个 monorepo，包含核心运行时、Eliza 应用、CLI、云服务、原生桥接和第一方插件。可引导的 Linux 和 Android 发行版在单独的 elizaOS/os 仓库中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖 Bun 和 Node.js，使用 Turbo 进行构建，支持子模块和补丁。
zh.hot: 本周新增 115 颗星，总星数达 19064，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 19 名。其“智能体操作系统”的定位和全栈能力吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者：使用 CLI 和文档构建自定义 AI 代理或插件
企业：通过 Eliza Cloud 部署和管理 AI 代理
个人用户：下载 Eliza 应用用于个人助理、自动化等场景
研究者：探索自主代理和操作系统级集成的可能性

en.tag: Open-source agentic operating system for autonomous AI agents
en.what: elizaOS is an open-source TypeScript framework and product stack for building and running autonomous AI agents. It provides a core runtime, the Eliza app, CLI, cloud services, and native bridges, enabling capabilities from chat and voice to device control.
en.content: This repository is a monorepo containing the core runtime, the Eliza app, the CLI, cloud services, native bridges, and first-party plugins. Bootable Linux and Android distributions live in a separate elizaOS/os repository.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Bun and Node.js dependencies, built using Turbo, supporting submodules and patches.
en.hot: Gained 115 stars this week, reaching 19,064 total, ranking #19 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) weekly. Its positioning as an 'agentic operating system' with full-stack capabilities attracts many developers.
uses: Developers: build custom AI agents or plugins using the CLI and docs
Enterprises: deploy and manage AI agents via Eliza Cloud
Individuals: download the Eliza app for personal assistant, automation, etc.
Researchers: explore autonomous agents and OS-level integration

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
zh.hot: 在 SEO 工具普遍昂贵且功能臃肿的背景下，它以开源、按量付费、可自托管的定位迅速获得关注；4,405 Stars 中本月新增 2,187 颗，登上 GitHub TypeScript 月榜第 17 名，其对 MCP 与 AI Agent 的原生集成进一步放大了开发者与增长团队的兴趣。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: AI 生产力工作室：智能对话、自主代理与 300+ 助手
zh.what: Cherry Studio 是一个 AI 生产力套件，提供智能聊天、自主代理和超过 300 个预设助手，统一访问前沿大语言模型。它旨在为用户提供一个集成的 AI 工作环境，支持多种任务和场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，包括构建图标、文档、开发指南等。主要使用 TypeScript 开发，并提供多语言支持。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，可能使用 Electron 等桌面框架，集成多种大语言模型 API。
zh.hot: 凭借 5 万+ 星标和月增 2100+ 的势头，Cherry Studio 凭借丰富的助手生态和自主代理功能，成为 AI 生产力工具的热门选择。
uses: 日常用户：需要统一入口使用多种 AI 模型进行聊天和问答
专业人士：利用 300+ 助手提升写作、编程、设计等效率
开发者：通过自主代理实现自动化任务和复杂工作流

en.tag: AI productivity studio with smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants
en.what: Cherry Studio is an AI productivity suite offering smart chat, autonomous agents, and over 300 preset assistants, with unified access to frontier LLMs. It aims to provide an integrated AI workspace for various tasks and scenarios.
en.content: The repository contains the full desktop app source code, including build icons, documentation, and development guides. It is primarily developed in TypeScript and supports multiple languages.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, likely using Electron for desktop, integrating multiple LLM APIs.
en.hot: With 50k+ stars and 2,100+ monthly additions, Cherry Studio's rich assistant ecosystem and autonomous agents make it a popular AI productivity tool.
uses: Everyday users: need a unified entry to chat and Q&A with multiple AI models
Professionals: leverage 300+ assistants to boost writing, coding, design efficiency
Developers: use autonomous agents for automated tasks and complex workflows

zh.tag: 隐私优先的开源简历生成器
zh.what: Reactive Resume 是一款免费开源的简历生成器，简化了创建、更新和分享简历的流程。它提供多种模板，用户填写信息后即可导出为 PDF，无需注册账户即可使用基本功能。该应用以隐私为核心，用户完全拥有自己的数据，且支持自托管。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端应用（apps/web）、后端服务（apps/server）以及相关文档，采用 monorepo 结构。支持 Docker 部署，提供多语言界面，并集成了赞助商展示。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，前端基于 React（Next.js），后端使用 NestJS，数据库支持 PostgreSQL 和 MongoDB，使用 Docker 进行容器化部署。
zh.hot: 该项目拥有超过 4 万星标，今日新增 255 星，位列 GitHub 趋势榜（TypeScript）第 5 名。其隐私保护、开源免费和自托管特性吸引了大量用户，且持续更新维护。
uses: 求职者：快速制作专业简历并导出 PDF，无需注册。
注重隐私的用户：希望完全掌控个人数据，可自托管部署。
开发者：可定制和扩展简历生成器，或贡献代码。

en.tag: Privacy-first open-source resume builder
en.what: Reactive Resume is a free and open-source resume builder that simplifies creating, updating, and sharing resumes. It offers templates, lets you fill in details and export to PDF, no account required for basic use. Built with privacy as a core principle, it gives users complete ownership of their data and can be self-hosted.
en.content: The repository contains a frontend app (apps/web), backend server (apps/server), and documentation, structured as a monorepo. It supports Docker deployment, offers multi-language UI, and includes sponsor showcases.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, frontend built with React (Next.js), backend with NestJS, databases support PostgreSQL and MongoDB, and Docker for containerized deployment.
en.hot: With over 40k stars and 255 new stars today, it ranks #5 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript). Its privacy-first, open-source, free, and self-hostable features attract many users, and it is actively maintained.
uses: Job seekers: quickly create professional resumes and export to PDF without registration.
Privacy-conscious users: want full control over personal data and can self-host.
Developers: can customize and extend the resume builder or contribute code.

zh.tag: 终端里的开源 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Qwen Code 是一个开源的 AI 编程代理，直接在终端中运行，提供交互式 UI 和代理功能。它支持自动记忆、自动技能、子代理、代理团队和 MCP，无需配置即可动态工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的核心框架，提供 CLI 工具、交互式终端 UI、IDE 插件、桌面应用、守护进程模式、SDK 以及 IM 机器人（Telegram/DingTalk/WeChat/Feishu）。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js（>=22），支持多种 API 协议（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Qwen），可接入第三方或本地模型（Ollama/vLLM）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 389 星，总星数达 26.9k，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 8 名。其开箱即用的代理特性和多协议支持吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中直接使用 AI 编程代理，无需离开命令行。
团队需要支持多种模型提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Qwen）的灵活工具。
希望利用 MCP 和子代理构建复杂自动化工作流的用户。
对开源、可定制、无供应商锁定的 AI 工具感兴趣的人。

en.tag: Open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal
en.what: Qwen Code is an open-source AI coding agent that runs in your terminal, offering an interactive UI and agentic capabilities. It features auto-memory, auto-skills, subagents, agent teams, and MCP, enabling dynamic workflows with zero setup.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based core framework, providing a CLI tool, interactive terminal UI, IDE plugins, desktop app, daemon mode, SDKs, and IM bots (Telegram/DingTalk/WeChat/Feishu).
en.stack: Built on Node.js (>=22), supports multiple API protocols (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen), and can integrate third-party or local models (Ollama/vLLM).
en.hot: Gained 389 stars this week, reaching 26.9k total, ranking #8 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) this week. Its out-of-the-box agentic features and multi-protocol support attract many developers.
uses: Developers who want an AI coding agent directly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Teams needing a flexible tool that supports multiple model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen).
Users who want to build complex automated workflows with MCP and subagents.
Those interested in open-source, customizable, vendor-lock-in-free AI tools.

zh.tag: 开源可观测性平台，替代 Datadog/Splunk，成本降低 140 倍
zh.what: OpenObserve 是一个云原生的可观测性平台，统一处理日志、指标、追踪、前端监控和 LLM 可观测性。它旨在以极低的存储成本和简单的部署方式，替代 Datadog、Splunk 和 Elasticsearch 等传统工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台源码，包括前端界面、后端服务、文档、架构说明和快速入门指南。支持单二进制部署，并集成了 OpenTelemetry 原生支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，后端基于 Rust 构建，利用 Parquet 列式存储和 S3 原生架构实现高性能和低成本。
zh.hot: 凭借 140 倍存储成本降低和单二进制部署的卖点，吸引了大量关注，本月新增 1100 星，总星数突破 2.1 万，成为可观测性领域的热门开源项目。
uses: 寻求替代昂贵商业可观测性工具的中小团队，希望降低成本而不牺牲功能。
需要统一管理日志、指标、追踪和前端监控的 DevOps 或 SRE 团队。
对 LLM 应用进行可观测性监控的 AI 工程师，需要追踪模型调用和性能。
希望快速部署自托管可观测性平台，且要求简单运维的开发者。

en.tag: Open-source observability platform, a cost-effective alternative to Datadog/Splunk with 140x lower storage cost
en.what: OpenObserve is a cloud-native observability platform that unifies logs, metrics, traces, frontend monitoring, and LLM observability. It aims to replace traditional tools like Datadog, Splunk, and Elasticsearch with dramatically lower storage costs and simple deployment.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform source code, including frontend UI, backend services, documentation, architecture overview, and quickstart guides. It supports single-binary deployment and has native OpenTelemetry integration.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, with a Rust-based backend. It leverages Parquet columnar storage and an S3-native architecture for high performance and low cost.
en.hot: With its 140x storage cost reduction and single-binary deployment, it has gained significant traction, adding 1,100 stars this month and surpassing 21,000 total stars, making it a hot open-source project in the observability space.
uses: Small to medium teams looking for a cost-effective alternative to expensive commercial observability tools without sacrificing features.
DevOps or SRE teams needing to unify logs, metrics, traces, and frontend monitoring in one platform.
AI engineers monitoring LLM applications, requiring tracing of model calls and performance.
Developers who want a self-hosted observability platform with simple deployment and low operational overhead.

zh.tag: 基于 WebGPU 的 3D 建筑编辑器
zh.what: Pascal Editor 是一个基于 Web 的 3D 建筑项目编辑器，允许用户创建和分享三维建筑项目。它利用 React Three Fiber 和 WebGPU 提供高性能的 3D 渲染，并支持通过 CLI 或 npm 包集成。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 Turborepo monorepo，包含多个包：核心（core）负责场景状态和注册表，viewer 负责 3D 渲染，editor 提供编辑工具，nodes 定义内置节点，cli 用于本地安装，mcp 提供模型上下文协议服务器，ui 包含共享 UI 组件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 React Three Fiber 和 WebGPU，使用 Next.js 构建应用，Zustand 管理状态，Turborepo 管理 monorepo。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4130 星，总星数达 21541，因其创新的 3D 建筑编辑体验和 WebGPU 技术而受到关注。
uses: 建筑师和设计师：快速创建和分享 3D 建筑概念。
开发者：集成到自己的应用中，或使用 CLI 本地运行编辑器。
教育者：用于教学 3D 建模和建筑可视化。

en.tag: A 3D building editor built with React Three Fiber and WebGPU
en.what: Pascal Editor is a web-based 3D building editor that allows users to create and share 3D architectural projects. It leverages React Three Fiber and WebGPU for high-performance 3D rendering and supports integration via CLI or npm packages.
en.content: The repository is a Turborepo monorepo with packages: core for scene state and registry, viewer for 3D rendering, editor for editing tools, nodes for built-in node definitions, cli for local installation, mcp for Model Context Protocol server, and ui for shared UI components.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on React Three Fiber and WebGPU, uses Next.js for the app, Zustand for state management, and Turborepo for monorepo management.
en.hot: Gained 4130 stars this month, reaching 21541 total, popular for its innovative 3D building editing experience and WebGPU technology.
uses: Architects and designers: quickly create and share 3D architectural concepts.
Developers: integrate into their own apps or run the editor locally via CLI.
Educators: for teaching 3D modeling and architectural visualization.

zh.tag: MCP 官方 TypeScript SDK，构建 AI 上下文互操作标准
zh.what: 这是 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的官方 TypeScript SDK，用于构建 MCP 服务器和客户端。它让应用能够以标准化方式为 LLM 提供上下文，将上下文提供与 LLM 交互分离。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器库（工具/资源/提示、Streamable HTTP、stdio、认证辅助）、客户端库（传输、高级辅助、OAuth 辅助）、可选中间件包（Express、Fastify、Hono、Node.js HTTP）以及可运行示例。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，支持 Node.js、Bun 和 Deno 运行时。工具和提示模式使用 Standard Schema，并发布为独立的 npm 包（@modelcontextprotocol/server 和 @modelcontextprotocol/client）。
zh.hot: 作为 MCP 官方 SDK，v2 稳定版与 2026-07-28 规范同步发布，成为 AI 工具互操作的关键基础设施。本月新增 328 星，总星数达 13247，稳居 TypeScript 趋势榜。
uses: 开发者构建 MCP 服务器，为 AI 助手提供工具、资源和提示
开发者构建 MCP 客户端，连接并调用多个 MCP 服务器
框架集成者使用中间件包（Express、Fastify 等）快速接入 MCP
学习 MCP 规范与 TypeScript 实现的参考示例

en.tag: Official TypeScript SDK for Model Context Protocol, enabling standardized AI context exchange
en.what: This is the official TypeScript SDK for the Model Context Protocol (MCP), used to build MCP servers and clients. It allows applications to provide context to LLMs in a standardized way, separating context provision from LLM interaction.
en.content: The repo includes MCP server libraries (tools/resources/prompts, Streamable HTTP, stdio, auth helpers), client libraries (transports, high-level helpers, OAuth helpers), optional middleware packages for Express, Fastify, Hono, Node.js HTTP, and runnable examples.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, supporting Node.js, Bun, and Deno runtimes. Tool and prompt schemas use Standard Schema, and it publishes split npm packages (@modelcontextprotocol/server and @modelcontextprotocol/client).
en.hot: As the official MCP SDK, the v2 stable release aligns with the 2026-07-28 spec, making it key infrastructure for AI tool interoperability. With 328 stars added this month and 13,247 total, it ranks #20 on the TypeScript trending list.
uses: Developers building MCP servers to provide tools, resources, and prompts to AI assistants
Developers building MCP clients to connect and call multiple MCP servers
Framework integrators using middleware packages (Express, Fastify, etc.) for quick MCP adoption
Learners referencing examples to understand MCP spec and TypeScript implementation

zh.tag: 开源低代码平台，构建内部工具与AI代理
zh.what: ToolJet 是一个开源的低代码平台，用于快速构建内部工具、仪表盘、业务应用和工作流。它提供可视化拖拽界面，支持连接数据库、API 和 SaaS 应用，并集成了 AI 能力，可生成应用和智能代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含社区版（CE）的完整源代码，提供可视化应用构建器、内置数据库、80+ 数据源连接器、多页面应用和多人协作编辑等功能。还包含文档、CLI 工具和插件系统。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 React 和 Node.js 构建。支持 Docker、Kubernetes 等部署方式，并集成多种数据库和 API。
zh.hot: 凭借强大的低代码能力和 AI 集成，在开发者中广受欢迎。今日新增 241 星，总星数达 38.5k，位列 JavaScript 趋势榜第五。
uses: 开发内部工具和后台管理面板的团队
需要快速搭建业务应用的非技术用户
希望利用 AI 生成应用和自动化工作流的开发者
寻求自托管低代码解决方案的企业

en.tag: Open-source low-code platform for building internal tools and AI agents
en.what: ToolJet is an open-source low-code platform for rapidly building internal tools, dashboards, business applications, and workflows. It offers a visual drag-and-drop interface, connects to databases, APIs, and SaaS apps, and integrates AI capabilities for app generation and intelligent agents.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the Community Edition (CE), featuring a visual app builder, built-in database, 80+ data source connectors, multi-page apps, and multiplayer editing. It also includes documentation, CLI tools, and a plugin system.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built with React and Node.js. Supports deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, and integrates with various databases and APIs.
en.hot: Popular among developers for its powerful low-code capabilities and AI integration. Gained 241 stars today, reaching 38.5k total, ranking 5th on the JavaScript trending list.
uses: Teams building internal tools and admin panels
Non-technical users needing to quickly create business apps
Developers looking to leverage AI for app generation and workflow automation
Enterprises seeking self-hosted low-code solutions

zh.tag: React 组件库，实现 Google Material Design
zh.what: Material UI 是一个全面的 React 组件库，实现了 Google 的 Material Design 系统。它被全球顶级产品团队广泛使用，经过十年以上的开发和数千名开源贡献者的严格测试。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Material UI 的核心组件、样式解决方案、主题定制工具，以及文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 React 和 TypeScript，使用 Emotion 进行样式处理，支持自定义主题。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的 React UI 库之一，拥有近 10 万 star，持续活跃，本周新增 71 星，稳居趋势榜。
uses: React 开发者快速构建符合 Material Design 的界面
企业级应用开发，需要成熟稳定的组件库
需要高度定制主题的团队

en.tag: React component library implementing Google's Material Design
en.what: Material UI is a comprehensive React component library that implements Google's Material Design system. It is trusted by top product teams worldwide and has been rigorously tested over a decade by thousands of open-source contributors.
en.content: The repository contains the core components, styling solutions, theme customization tools, along with documentation and examples.
en.stack: Built on React and TypeScript, uses Emotion for styling, supports custom theming.
en.hot: As one of the most popular React UI libraries, it has nearly 100k stars, remains highly active, and gained 71 stars this week, staying on the trending list.
uses: React developers building Material Design interfaces quickly
Enterprise application development requiring a mature, stable component library
Teams needing highly customizable theming

zh.tag: 免费在线数据库 ER 图编辑器与 SQL 生成器
zh.what: drawDB 是一个在浏览器中运行的免费数据库实体关系图（ERD）编辑器，用户无需注册即可快速绘制数据库图表、导入导出 SQL 脚本、生成迁移脚本并自定义编辑器。它旨在简化数据库设计流程，让开发者可以直观地可视化和操作数据库结构。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 drawDB 前端应用源码，包括 React 组件、状态管理、样式和构建配置。还提供了本地开发、生产构建和 Docker 部署的脚本，以及可选的分享功能（需要配套的 drawdb-server）。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 和 React 构建，使用 npm 进行依赖管理和构建，支持 Docker 容器化部署。主要依赖包括 React 生态、状态管理库（如 Redux 或 MobX）以及代码编辑器组件（如 Monaco）。
zh.hot: drawDB 因其免费、无需注册、直接在浏览器中使用的便捷性而广受欢迎，star 数已达 38k+，今日新增 48 个，在 GitHub 趋势榜 JavaScript 类别中排名第 10。它解决了数据库设计中的常见痛点，提供了简洁直观的界面和强大的 SQL 生成功能。
uses: 数据库开发者：快速可视化数据库结构，生成 SQL 脚本和迁移文件。
软件架构师：在项目初期设计 ER 图，便于团队协作和沟通。
教育场景：用于教学演示数据库设计概念，无需安装复杂软件。
全栈开发者：在开发过程中快速原型化数据库模型，并导出为 SQL 语句。

en.tag: Free, simple, intuitive online database ER diagram editor and SQL generator
en.what: drawDB is a free, browser-based database entity relationship diagram (ERD) editor that lets users quickly build diagrams, import/export SQL scripts, generate migrations, and customize the editor without creating an account. It simplifies database design by providing an intuitive visual interface for structuring and manipulating database schemas.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the drawDB frontend application, including React components, state management, styles, and build configuration. It provides scripts for local development, production build, and Docker deployment, along with optional sharing features that require a companion drawdb-server.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript and React, using npm for dependency management and build, with Docker support for containerized deployment. Key dependencies include React ecosystem, state management libraries (e.g., Redux or MobX), and code editor components (e.g., Monaco).
en.hot: drawDB has gained popularity for being free, requiring no sign-up, and working directly in the browser, amassing 38k+ stars with 48 new stars today, ranking #10 on GitHub Trending for JavaScript. It addresses common pain points in database design with a clean, intuitive interface and powerful SQL generation capabilities.
uses: Database developers: quickly visualize database schemas and generate SQL scripts and migrations.
Software architects: design ER diagrams in early project phases for team collaboration and communication.
Educational settings: demonstrate database design concepts without installing complex software.
Full-stack developers: prototype database models quickly during development and export to SQL statements.

zh.what: 这是一个插件市场，为 Claude Code 和 GitHub Copilot 提供 Power Platform 开发插件。包含可复用的技能、代理和命令，帮助开发者构建和部署 Power Platform 解决方案。

zh.hot: 本周新增 49 颗星，位列 JavaScript 周榜第 3。作为微软官方项目，它填补了 AI 编码助手与 Power Platform 之间的空白，吸引大量低代码开发者。

企业 IT 团队 —— 标准化 Power Platform 开发流程

en.tag: Official Microsoft plugin marketplace for Power Platform development
en.what: This is a plugin marketplace providing Power Platform development plugins for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot. It includes reusable skills, agents, and commands to help developers build and deploy Power Platform solutions.
en.content: The repository contains multiple plugins such as Power Pages, Model Apps, MCP Apps, Code Apps, Mobile Apps, Canvas Apps, and Power Automate. Each plugin has its own README and installation scripts.

en.hot: Gained 49 stars this week, ranking 3rd in JavaScript weekly trending. As an official Microsoft project, it bridges AI coding assistants and Power Platform, attracting many low-code developers.
uses: Power Platform developers — quickly build and deploy apps using AI assistants
Low-code/no-code enthusiasts — boost development efficiency with Claude Code or Copilot
Enterprise IT teams — standardize Power Platform development workflows

zh.tag: 开源看板项目管理工具，实时协作
zh.what: PLANKA 是一款看板风格的项目管理工具，提供直观的拖拽界面来管理项目、看板、列表和卡片。它支持实时同步、Markdown 编辑和灵活的通知，适合团队协作。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的看板应用代码，包括前端界面、后端 API、数据库模型，以及 Docker 部署配置。还提供了文档、演示和 API 文档链接。

zh.hot: 拥有 12k+ 星标，本周新增 102，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜。其自托管、实时协作和丰富功能吸引了大量用户。
uses: 团队项目管理，使用看板视图跟踪任务进度
个人任务管理，自托管部署保护数据隐私
需要实时协作和 Markdown 支持的项目团队
希望替代商业看板工具的开源用户

en.tag: Open-source Kanban project management with real-time collaboration
en.what: PLANKA is a Kanban-style project management tool with an intuitive drag-and-drop interface for managing projects, boards, lists, and cards. It features real-time sync, Markdown editing, and flexible notifications for team collaboration.
en.content: The repository contains the full Kanban app code, including frontend UI, backend API, database models, and Docker deployment configs. Links to docs, demo, and API docs are also provided.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built on Node.js and React, uses PostgreSQL for database, supports Docker deployment.
en.hot: With 12k+ stars and 102 added this week, it's on GitHub Trending weekly. Its self-hosted, real-time collaboration and rich features attract many users.
uses: Team project management with Kanban view for tracking tasks
Personal task management with self-hosted deployment for data privacy
Teams needing real-time collaboration and Markdown support
Open-source users looking to replace commercial Kanban tools

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理变身韩国人的技能包
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 代理（如 Claude Code、Codex 等）准备的技能集合，让代理能处理韩国特有的生活事务，如预订 SRT/KTX 火车票、查询地铁和天气、搜索失物等。用户无需额外 API 层，只需通过 npx 安装技能即可。

zh.stack: 主要基于 JavaScript 和 Node.js（≥18），使用 npx 进行安装管理。部分技能依赖外部 API（如 Kakao、ODsay、기상청），但无需用户额外配置 API 密钥（除非需要更丰富功能）。
zh.hot: 7 千多星且本周新增 513，登上 JavaScript 周榜第二。它精准解决了韩国用户的日常痛点，将繁琐的本地服务操作交给 AI 代理，引发共鸣和传播。
uses: 韩国开发者或居民：用 AI 代理自动预订火车票、查询地铁等
AI 代理爱好者：探索如何为代理构建实用的本地化技能
希望将 AI 应用于生活场景的普通用户：无需编程即可安装使用

en.tag: Skill collection turning AI agents into a Korean local
en.what: A collection of skills for AI agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) to handle Korea-specific tasks like booking SRT/KTX tickets, checking subway and weather, and searching lost items. No extra API layer needed; install via npx.
en.content: The repo contains skill directories, each for a specific function (e.g., srt-booking, korea-weather), with detailed docs. Install via npx or Claude Code marketplace; optional k-skill-proxy server available.

uses: Korean developers/residents: automate train booking, subway info, etc.
AI agent enthusiasts: explore building practical localized skills
Non-programmers: install and use skills without coding

zh.tag: 自托管有声书与播客服务器
zh.what: Audiobookshelf 是一个自托管的有声书和播客服务器，支持流式播放所有音频格式，自动下载播客，多用户权限管理，跨设备同步播放进度。它提供 Web 应用、Android 和 iOS 应用（测试版），并支持 Chromecast。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器端代码、Vue 前端（正在迁移到 React）、REST API、数据库迁移、Docker 部署文件，以及文档和示例配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 Node.js，前端使用 Vue（迁移至 React），数据库使用 SQLite，支持 Docker 部署，集成 Audnexus API 用于章节查找。
zh.hot: 随着自托管和数字隐私意识的增强，Audiobookshelf 提供了开源、功能丰富的替代方案，本月新增 460 星，总星数达 14006，在 JavaScript 趋势榜排名第 18。
uses: 自托管爱好者：希望完全掌控自己的有声书和播客库，避免依赖商业服务。
播客重度用户：需要自动下载和管理播客订阅，并支持多设备同步。
家庭或小团体：多用户权限和独立进度，适合共享媒体库。
开发者：可定制和扩展，前端正在迁移到 React，适合贡献代码。

en.tag: Self-hosted audiobook and podcast server
en.what: Audiobookshelf is a self-hosted audiobook and podcast server that streams all audio formats, auto-downloads podcasts, supports multi-user permissions, and syncs progress across devices. It offers a web app, Android and iOS apps (beta), and Chromecast support.
en.content: The repository contains the full server-side code, a Vue frontend (being migrated to React), REST API, database migrations, Docker deployment files, and documentation with sample configurations.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built on Node.js, frontend in Vue (migrating to React), SQLite database, Docker deployment, integrates Audnexus API for chapter lookup.
en.hot: With rising self-hosting and digital privacy awareness, Audiobookshelf offers an open-source, feature-rich alternative, gaining 460 stars this month and reaching 14,006 total, ranking #18 on the JavaScript trending list.
uses: Self-hosters: Want full control over their audiobook and podcast library without relying on commercial services.
Podcast power users: Need automatic downloads and management of subscriptions with multi-device sync.
Families or small groups: Multi-user permissions and per-user progress for shared media libraries.
Developers: Customizable and extensible, frontend migrating to React, suitable for contributing code.

zh.tag: 高效开源广告拦截器，专注隐私与性能
zh.what: uBlock Origin 是一款轻量级、高效的浏览器扩展，用于拦截广告、跟踪器和恶意域名。它通过 CPU 和内存占用极低的方式，为用户提供更干净、更快的网页浏览体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含扩展的完整源代码，包括核心拦截引擎、过滤列表管理、用户界面（如弹出面板和设置页）、以及针对不同浏览器的构建配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，结合 HTML/CSS 构建界面，并利用浏览器扩展 API（如 webRequest 和 declarativeNetRequest）实现网络请求拦截。
zh.hot: 随着主流浏览器逐步淘汰 Manifest V2，uBlock Origin 成为用户对抗广告和跟踪的重要工具，其高效性和可靠性使其在 GitHub 上持续受到关注，本月新增 890 星。
uses: 注重隐私的普通用户，希望拦截广告和跟踪器以加快浏览速度并保护隐私。
技术爱好者，希望自定义过滤规则或研究广告拦截技术。
开发者和维护者，需要参考或贡献于开源广告拦截解决方案。

en.tag: Efficient open-source ad blocker focused on privacy and performance
en.what: uBlock Origin is a lightweight and efficient browser extension that blocks ads, trackers, and malicious domains. It provides a cleaner and faster browsing experience with minimal CPU and memory usage.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the extension, including the core blocking engine, filter list management, user interface (popup panel and settings pages), and build configurations for various browsers.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with HTML/CSS for the UI, and leverages browser extension APIs like webRequest and declarativeNetRequest for network request blocking.
en.hot: As major browsers phase out Manifest V2, uBlock Origin remains a crucial tool for users to fight ads and tracking. Its efficiency and reliability keep it popular on GitHub, gaining 890 stars this month.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to block ads and trackers for faster browsing and privacy protection.
Tech enthusiasts who want to customize filter rules or study ad-blocking techniques.
Developers and maintainers looking to reference or contribute to an open-source ad-blocking solution.

zh.tag: 跨平台终端与远程连接客户端，支持多协议
zh.what: electerm 是一个开源的终端/SSH/SFTP/FTP/Telnet/Serialport/RDP/VNC/Spice 客户端，支持 Linux、Mac、Windows、Android 和 HarmonyOS。它提供图形化界面，方便用户管理远程连接和文件传输。

zh.hot: 因其跨平台支持和多协议集成而广受欢迎，本月新增 383 星，总星数达 14918，反映了用户对统一远程连接工具的需求。
uses: 系统管理员和运维人员，需要管理多台服务器的 SSH 和文件传输。
开发者，希望在统一界面中处理远程开发、调试和文件同步。
需要支持旧系统或国产 Linux 发行版的用户，如 UOS、麒麟等。
移动办公用户，可通过 Android 或 HarmonyOS 应用进行远程连接。

en.tag: Cross-platform terminal & remote connection client supporting multiple protocols
en.what: electerm is an open-source terminal/SSH/SFTP/FTP/Telnet/Serialport/RDP/VNC/Spice client supporting Linux, Mac, Windows, Android, and HarmonyOS. It provides a graphical interface for managing remote connections and file transfers.
en.content: The repository includes code for desktop (Electron), mobile (Android/HarmonyOS), and web (electerm-web) versions, along with themes, Docker images, and online demos.
en.stack: Built with Electron, developed in JavaScript, supporting multiple OSes and architectures, including legacy systems and Chinese Linux distributions.
en.hot: Popular for its cross-platform support and multi-protocol integration, gaining 383 stars this month to reach 14918 total, reflecting demand for a unified remote connection tool.
uses: System administrators and DevOps needing SSH and file transfer for multiple servers.
Developers who want a unified interface for remote development, debugging, and file sync.
Users requiring support for legacy systems or Chinese Linux distributions like UOS and Kylin.
Mobile workers who need remote connections via Android or HarmonyOS apps.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理打造的设计语言与技能集，终结千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风
zh.what: Impeccable 是一套面向 AI 编码代理（如 Claude、Cursor 等）的设计指导语言与 CLI 工具。它通过 23 条标准化命令和 46 条确定性检测规则，帮助 AI 在生成前端界面时摆脱千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风格，产出更具品牌感与专业度的设计。开发者只需在项目中运行初始化命令，即可建立包含品牌语境、视觉规范与组件库的设计上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含可安装在 AI 工具中的核心技能包、用于本地检测的 CLI 与浏览器扩展，以及一套由 PRODUCT.md 和 DESIGN.md 驱动的设计上下文系统。整体以命令式交互为主，支持实时浏览器迭代与无需 LLM 的离线规则检测。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 构建，通过 npm 分发并以 npx 方式安装，同时提供浏览器扩展用于实时迭代检测。设计规则以确定性逻辑实现，可独立于 LLM 运行。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上已获得 47.7K Star，本周新增 2,331 星并跻身 Trending 周榜第 14 名，反映出开发者对「AI 生成前端同质化」的强烈痛点共鸣。它精准击中了当前 AI 编码工具产出界面千篇一律的普遍问题，提供了可落地的设计工程化方案。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 希望让 AI 助手生成更专业、不千篇一律的界面代码
独立创始人/产品经理 —— 需要快速建立品牌感强、视觉一致的产品界面
设计工程师 —— 想将设计规范转化为 AI 可执行的确定性规则与检测流程

en.tag: A design language and skillset for AI coding agents to escape generic SaaS templates
en.what: Impeccable is a design guidance language and CLI tool for AI coding agents like Claude and Cursor. It provides 23 standardized commands and 46 deterministic detection rules to help AI-generated frontend designs break away from generic SaaS templates and achieve stronger brand identity. Developers can set up a comprehensive design context—including brand voice, visual guidelines, and component libraries—through a single initialization command.
en.content: The repository includes a core skill package for AI tools, a CLI and browser extension for local auditing, and a design context system driven by PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md. It focuses on command-based interactions, supporting live browser iteration and offline deterministic rule checks without requiring an LLM or API key.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, distributed via npm and installed through npx, with a browser extension for real-time iteration and auditing. The design rules are implemented as deterministic logic that can run independently of any LLM or API key.
en.hot: With 47.7K stars and 2,331 new stars this week landing it at #14 on GitHub Trending, the project resonates strongly with developers frustrated by homogenized AI-generated frontend designs. It directly addresses the pain point of repetitive SaaS templates by offering a practical, engineering-grade design system for AI agents.
uses: Frontend developers who want their AI assistants to generate professional, non-generic UI code
Indie founders and product managers looking to quickly build brand-conscious, visually consistent interfaces
Design engineers seeking to convert design specifications into deterministic, AI-executable rules and audit workflows

zh.tag: 轻量跨浏览器 JavaScript 3D 库，WebGL/WebGPU 渲染
zh.what: three.js 是一个易于使用、轻量级的跨浏览器通用 3D 库，用于在网页上创建和展示 3D 图形。它提供了场景、相机、几何体、材质、渲染器等核心组件，支持 WebGL 和 WebGPU 渲染，并可通过附加组件扩展 SVG 和 CSS3D 渲染。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 JavaScript 源码、示例（examples）、文档（docs）、手册（manual）和 Wiki，以及构建配置和测试。核心模块包括渲染器、场景图、相机、几何体、材质、动画和加载器等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 WebGL 和 WebGPU API，通过 npm 分发，支持 ES6 模块导入。构建工具包括 Rollup 等，测试使用 Puppeteer 和 playwright。
zh.hot: three.js 是 Web 3D 的事实标准，拥有超过 11 万 star，本月新增近千 star，持续活跃。其易用性和强大的功能使其成为开发者创建 3D 网页的首选。
uses: Web 开发者：在网页中快速实现 3D 可视化、产品展示或交互式动画。
游戏开发者：使用 three.js 构建浏览器游戏或原型，无需安装插件。
数据可视化工程师：将复杂数据以 3D 形式呈现，增强理解与交互。
教育领域：用于教学演示、虚拟实验室或在线课程中的 3D 内容。

en.tag: Lightweight, cross-browser JavaScript 3D library with WebGL and WebGPU renderers
en.what: three.js is an easy-to-use, lightweight, cross-browser, general-purpose 3D library for creating and displaying 3D graphics on the web. It provides core components like scenes, cameras, geometries, materials, and renderers, supporting WebGL and WebGPU rendering, with SVG and CSS3D renderers available as addons.
en.content: The repository contains complete JavaScript source code, examples, docs, manual, and Wiki, along with build configurations and tests. Core modules include renderers, scene graph, cameras, geometries, materials, animation, and loaders.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, relying on WebGL and WebGPU APIs, distributed via npm, supporting ES6 module imports. Build tools include Rollup, and tests use Puppeteer and Playwright.
en.hot: three.js is the de facto standard for Web 3D, with over 110k stars and nearly 1k new stars this month, remaining highly active. Its ease of use and powerful features make it the go-to choice for developers creating 3D web experiences.
uses: Web developers: quickly implement 3D visualizations, product showcases, or interactive animations in web pages.
Game developers: build browser games or prototypes with three.js without needing plugins.
Data visualization engineers: present complex data in 3D to enhance understanding and interaction.
Education: use for teaching demonstrations, virtual labs, or 3D content in online courses.

zh.tag: 洛雪音乐自定义音源合集，一键导入即听全网音乐
zh.what: 这是一个为洛雪音乐（LX Music）播放器提供自定义音源（API 接口）的仓库，用户通过导入这些音源链接，即可在播放器中搜索和播放来自多个网络来源的音乐。它聚合了多个第三方音源，并提供了原始链接和加速链接两种导入方式。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含多个音源文件夹（如 SixYin、Huibq、Flower、LX、ikun、Grass、JuheApi、QDY），每个文件夹内有一个 latest.js 文件，即音源脚本。README 中列出了所有音源的原始链接和加速链接，并提供了数据来源和项目地址。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 JavaScript，音源脚本以 JS 文件形式提供。依赖洛雪音乐播放器（lx-music-desktop/mobile）来加载这些音源。
zh.hot: 该仓库因提供免费、便捷的音乐源聚合而受到欢迎，本月新增 735 星，总星数达 7956，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜。用户无需自建服务即可扩展播放器功能，满足听歌需求。
uses: 洛雪音乐播放器用户：一键导入音源，免费听全网音乐
喜欢折腾的音乐爱好者：通过自定义音源探索不同曲库
开发者：参考音源实现，学习如何为 LX Music 编写音源插件

en.tag: A collection of custom music sources for LX Music, one-click import to listen to music across the web
en.what: This repository provides custom music sources (API endpoints) for the LX Music player. By importing these source links, users can search and play music from various online sources within the player. It aggregates multiple third-party sources and offers both raw and accelerated import links.
en.content: The repository mainly contains multiple source folders (e.g., SixYin, Huibq, Flower, LX, ikun, Grass, JuheApi, QDY), each with a latest.js file as the source script. The README lists raw and accelerated links for all sources, along with data origins and related project links.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with source scripts provided as JS files. It depends on the LX Music player (lx-music-desktop/mobile) to load these sources.
en.hot: The repo is popular for providing free and convenient aggregated music sources. With 735 stars added this month and 7,956 total, it made the GitHub Trending monthly list. Users can extend their player's capabilities without self-hosting, satisfying music listening needs.
uses: LX Music player users: import sources with one click to listen to music for free
Music enthusiasts who like tinkering: explore different music libraries via custom sources
Developers: reference source implementations to learn how to write LX Music source plugins

zh.tag: 个人情报终端：27 个数据源，一条命令，零云端
zh.what: Crucix 是一个自托管的个人情报代理，从 27 个开源情报源并行抓取数据（每 15 分钟），并在一个类似 Jarvis 的仪表盘上可视化。它还能接入 LLM，成为双向情报助手，通过 Telegram 和 Discord 推送多级警报，并响应手机上的命令。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档、截图和 Docker 配置。核心是一个 Node.js 服务器（server.mjs），依赖仅 express，提供实时仪表盘、3D 地球视图、世界地图和启动序列等界面。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript（Node.js 22+），主要依赖是 express。支持 Docker 部署，可接入 LLM（如 OpenAI）以启用智能助手功能。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1073 星，总星数达 11558，登上 JavaScript 月榜第 20 名。其‘零云、零遥测、零订阅’的本地优先理念和强大的 OSINT 聚合能力吸引了大量关注。
uses: 情报爱好者：希望自建一个实时监控全球动态的仪表盘，无需依赖云服务。
交易员/投资者：利用跨领域数据生成可操作的交易想法，并接收重要变化提醒。
开发者：对 OSINT 数据聚合、LLM 集成和自托管应用感兴趣的开发者。

en.tag: Personal intelligence terminal: 27 sources, one command, zero cloud
en.what: Crucix is a self-hosted personal intelligence agent that pulls data from 27 open-source intelligence feeds in parallel every 15 minutes and renders it on a single Jarvis-style dashboard. It can also hook into an LLM to become a two-way intelligence assistant, pushing multi-tier alerts to Telegram and Discord and responding to commands from your phone.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation, screenshots, and Docker configuration. The core is a Node.js server (server.mjs) with only one dependency (express), providing a live dashboard, 3D globe view, world map, and boot sequence UI.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript (Node.js 22+), with express as the only dependency. Docker-ready and can integrate with an LLM (e.g., OpenAI) to enable assistant features.
en.hot: Gained 1,073 stars this month, reaching 11,558 total and ranking #20 on the JavaScript monthly trending list. Its local-first philosophy ('zero cloud, zero telemetry, zero subscriptions') and powerful OSINT aggregation appeal to many.
uses: Intelligence enthusiasts: want a self-hosted dashboard to monitor global events in real-time without cloud dependency.
Traders/investors: leverage cross-domain data to generate actionable trade ideas and receive alerts on meaningful changes.
Developers: interested in OSINT data aggregation, LLM integration, and self-hosted applications.

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的编程语言，让代理少犯错
zh.what: BAML 是一种专为 AI 代理设计的编程语言，它看起来像 TypeScript，但内置了类型安全、运行时类型、静态错误分析等特性，帮助开发者构建更可靠的代理应用。它提供了代理专用的标准库和测试框架，并支持从多种主流语言调用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 BAML 编译器的 Rust 实现、命令行工具（baml）、IDE 插件、Python 包（baml-py）以及文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，提供 Python 绑定（baml-py），并支持从 TypeScript、Python、Go、C#、Java 等语言调用。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理开发热潮，BAML 提供了更严谨的编程范式，解决了代理开发中常见的错误问题，因此迅速获得关注，近 9000 星且持续增长。
uses: AI 代理开发者，希望用类型安全的方式构建复杂代理逻辑
需要从多种语言调用代理功能的团队，BAML 支持多语言互操作
对代理可靠性要求高的场景，如自动化工作流、智能客服等

en.tag: A programming language for AI agents, designed to reduce agent mistakes
en.what: BAML is a programming language designed specifically for AI agents. It looks like TypeScript but includes type safety, runtime types, static error analysis, and other features to help developers build more reliable agent applications. It provides an agent-specific standard library and testing framework, and can be called from multiple mainstream languages.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust implementation of the BAML compiler, command-line tools (baml), IDE plugins, Python package (baml-py), and documentation/examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Python bindings (baml-py), and callable from TypeScript, Python, Go, C#, Java, etc.
en.hot: With the surge in AI agent development, BAML offers a more rigorous programming paradigm that addresses common errors in agent development, quickly gaining attention with nearly 9k stars and growing.
uses: AI agent developers who want to build complex agent logic with type safety
Teams needing to call agent functions from multiple languages, as BAML supports interop
Scenarios requiring high reliability, such as automated workflows and intelligent customer service

zh.tag: 数据中心级分布式推理服务编排层
zh.what: Dynamo 是一个开源的数据中心级推理服务框架，作为推理引擎（如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM、vLLM）之上的编排层，将它们整合为协调的多节点推理系统。它通过分离式服务、智能路由、多级 KV 缓存和自动扩展，最大化吞吐量并最小化延迟，适用于 LLM、推理、多模态和视频生成等负载。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心、Python 扩展、文档、示例、recipes 和容器镜像，并提供设计提案和社区贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 实现高性能，Python 提供可扩展性；依赖推理引擎如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM 和 vLLM。
zh.hot: 本月新增 285 星，总星数 7813，登上 GitHub Trending（Rust）月榜第 20 名。作为 NVIDIA 支持的开源项目，它填补了推理引擎之上的编排层空白，吸引大量关注。
uses: AI 基础设施团队：构建大规模多节点推理服务，优化 GPU 利用率和成本。
模型部署工程师：需要为 LLM、多模态或视频生成模型设计高吞吐、低延迟的服务架构。
平台开发者：希望扩展或定制推理编排逻辑，利用 Rust 和 Python 的混合开发。
研究与实验：在数据中心规模下测试分离式推理、KV 缓存等先进技术。

en.tag: Datacenter-scale distributed inference serving orchestration layer
en.what: Dynamo is an open-source, datacenter-scale inference serving framework that acts as an orchestration layer above inference engines like SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM, turning them into a coordinated multi-node inference system. It uses disaggregated serving, intelligent routing, multi-tier KV caching, and automatic scaling to maximize throughput and minimize latency for LLM, reasoning, multimodal, and video generation workloads.
en.content: The repository includes a Rust core, Python extensions, documentation, examples, recipes, and container images, along with design proposals and community contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Built in Rust for performance and Python for extensibility; relies on inference engines like SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM.
en.hot: With 285 stars added this month and 7,813 total, it ranks #20 on GitHub Trending (Rust) monthly. As an NVIDIA-backed open-source project, it fills the orchestration gap above inference engines, drawing significant attention.
uses: AI infrastructure teams: building large-scale multi-node inference services to optimize GPU utilization and cost.
Model deployment engineers: designing high-throughput, low-latency serving architectures for LLMs, multimodal, or video generation models.
Platform developers: extending or customizing inference orchestration logic with Rust and Python.
Research and experimentation: testing advanced techniques like disaggregated serving and KV caching at datacenter scale.

zh.tag: 多服务器构建与部署平台
zh.what: Komodo 是一个开源的 DevOps 平台，用于在多个服务器上构建和部署软件。它提供统一的界面来管理服务器、部署应用、监控状态，并支持自动化操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档、截图（亮色/暗色主题）、演示链接和构建服务器链接。主要组件包括核心服务、外围代理（periphery）和 Web 界面。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，可能涉及 Web 框架（如 Actix-web）、数据库（如 PostgreSQL）和前端技术（如 React）。
zh.hot: 随着多服务器管理和自动化部署需求的增长，Komodo 提供了免费开源的解决方案，吸引了大量开发者。其 star 数接近 1.2 万，今日新增 19，持续受到关注。
uses: DevOps 工程师：需要跨多服务器管理部署和监控。
小型团队：希望自托管部署平台，避免云服务成本。
开发者：想要自动化构建和部署流程，提高效率。

en.tag: Build and deploy software across many servers
en.what: Komodo is an open-source DevOps platform for building and deploying software across many servers. It provides a unified interface to manage servers, deploy applications, monitor status, and automate operations.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation, screenshots (light/dark themes), demo links, and build server links. Main components include core services, periphery agents, and a web UI.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, likely using web frameworks (e.g., Actix-web), databases (e.g., PostgreSQL), and frontend technologies (e.g., React).
en.hot: With the growing need for multi-server management and automated deployment, Komodo offers a free open-source solution, attracting many developers. Its star count is nearly 12k, with 19 new stars today, maintaining steady attention.
uses: DevOps engineers: need to manage deployments and monitoring across multiple servers.
Small teams: want a self-hosted deployment platform to avoid cloud costs.
Developers: looking to automate build and deployment processes for efficiency.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 打造的极速 Python 包与项目管理工具
zh.what: uv 是一个用 Rust 编写的极速 Python 包和项目管理工具，旨在替代 pip、pip-tools、pipx、poetry、pyenv、twine、virtualenv 等多个工具。它提供统一的锁文件、脚本运行、Python 版本管理等功能，并兼容 pip 接口。
zh.content: 仓库包含 uv 的 Rust 源码、文档、基准测试（BENCHMARKS.md）以及安装脚本，支持通过 curl 或 pip 安装，无需 Rust 或 Python 环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Cargo 构建，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。
zh.hot: uv 因其比 pip 快 10-100 倍的性能而广受关注，star 数已达 88k，本月新增 1485，成为 Rust 月度趋势榜第 20 名。
uses: Python 开发者：需要快速安装和管理依赖，提升开发效率。
项目维护者：使用统一锁文件和项目管理功能，简化多环境配置。
DevOps 工程师：在 CI/CD 中加速依赖安装，减少构建时间。

en.tag: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.
en.what: uv is an extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust, designed to replace pip, pip-tools, pipx, poetry, pyenv, twine, virtualenv, and more. It offers a universal lockfile, script running, Python version management, and a pip-compatible interface.
en.content: The repository contains uv's Rust source code, documentation, benchmarks (BENCHMARKS.md), and installation scripts, installable via curl or pip without requiring Rust or Python.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, built with Cargo, and supports macOS, Linux, and Windows.
en.hot: uv gains attention for being 10-100x faster than pip, with 88k stars and 1,485 new stars this month, ranking 20th on the Rust monthly trending list.
uses: Python developers: need fast dependency installation and management to boost productivity.
Project maintainers: use universal lockfile and project management to simplify multi-environment setups.
DevOps engineers: accelerate dependency installation in CI/CD pipelines to reduce build times.

zh.tag: 无需客户端的全能堡垒机，支持SSH/HTTPS/K8s/数据库/RDP/VNC
zh.what: Warpgate 是一个智能且完全透明的堡垒主机（bastion host），支持 SSH、HTTPS、Kubernetes、MySQL、PostgreSQL、RDP 和 VNC，无需客户端应用或 SSH 包装器。它部署在 DMZ 中，可管理用户并分配访问权限，记录所有会话供实时查看或回放，并提供基于浏览器的访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的单一二进制文件，内置 Web 管理界面、会话录制与回放、2FA/SSO 支持、暴力破解防护，以及 Docker 部署和文档。
zh.stack: 使用 100% 安全 Rust 编写，无外部依赖，支持 TOTP 和 OpenID Connect，可运行于 Docker 或裸机。
zh.hot: 本月新增 319 星，总星数 7701，登上 Rust 月榜第 20 名。它解决了传统跳板机需要客户端配置的痛点，提供透明代理和内置 Web 访问，备受安全团队和运维青睐。
uses: 企业安全团队：集中管理 SSH/RDP/VNC 访问并审计所有会话。
运维工程师：无需客户端即可安全访问 Kubernetes 和数据库。
开发人员：通过浏览器快速访问内部服务，支持 2FA 和 SSO。

en.tag: Fully transparent bastion/PAM for SSH, HTTPS, K8s, DBs, RDP/VNC with no client software
en.what: Warpgate is a smart and fully transparent bastion host for SSH, HTTPS, Kubernetes, MySQL, PostgreSQL, RDP, and VNC, requiring no client app or SSH wrapper. It sits in your DMZ, manages user access to hosts and URLs, records sessions for live viewing or replay, and offers browser-based access.
en.content: The repo contains a single Rust binary with a built-in web admin UI, session recording/replay, 2FA/SSO support, brute-force protection, plus Docker deployment and documentation.
en.stack: Written in 100% safe Rust with no dependencies, supports TOTP and OpenID Connect, deployable via Docker or bare metal.
en.hot: Gained 319 stars this month, reaching 7,701 total and ranking #20 on the Rust monthly trending list. It solves the pain of traditional jump hosts requiring client config, offering transparent proxying and built-in web access, popular among security and ops teams.
uses: Security teams: centrally manage SSH/RDP/VNC access and audit all sessions.
Ops engineers: securely access Kubernetes and databases without client software.
Developers: quickly access internal services via browser with 2FA and SSO.

zh.tag: S3 兼容的高性能对象存储，比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍
zh.what: RustFS 是一个用 Rust 构建的开源分布式对象存储系统，兼容 S3 API，专为数据湖、AI 和大数据工作负载优化。它提供比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍的 4KB 对象性能，并支持与 MinIO、Ceph 等平台迁移和共存。
zh.content: 仓库包含 RustFS 的完整源代码、CI/CD 配置、Docker 镜像构建、文档链接（包括多语言 README）以及社区资源（Discord、讨论区）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 S3 API 兼容层，支持分布式部署，提供 Docker 镜像，并集成 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成和发布。
zh.hot: 凭借 31k+ 星标和本月新增 1307 星，RustFS 因其卓越性能（比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍）和宽松的 Apache 2.0 许可而备受关注，成为 Rust 月榜第 20 名。
uses: 需要高性能、S3 兼容对象存储的数据湖和大数据平台开发者
希望从 MinIO 或 Ceph 迁移到更快速、内存安全存储方案的用户
对 Rust 生态感兴趣，希望贡献或学习高性能存储系统实现的开发者

en.tag: S3-compatible high-performance object storage, 2.3x faster than MinIO
en.what: RustFS is an open-source, distributed object storage system built in Rust, S3-compatible, optimized for data lakes, AI, and big data workloads. It delivers 2.3x faster performance for 4KB objects than MinIO and supports migration and coexistence with other S3-compatible platforms like MinIO and Ceph.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of RustFS, CI/CD configurations, Docker image builds, documentation links (including multilingual READMEs), and community resources like Discord and discussions.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, featuring S3 API compatibility, distributed deployment, Docker images, and GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
en.hot: With 31k+ stars and 1,307 new stars this month, RustFS gains attention for its superior performance (2.3x faster than MinIO) and permissive Apache 2.0 license, ranking #20 on the Rust monthly trending list.

Users migrating from MinIO or Ceph to a faster, memory-safe storage solution
Developers interested in Rust ecosystem, contributing to or learning high-performance storage system implementation

zh.tag: 终端里的代码审查工具，支持 vim 键位与多平台导出
zh.what: tuicr 是一个运行在终端里的代码审查工具，提供类似 GitHub 的连续 diff 视图，支持 vim 键位操作。它可以审查未提交的更改、提交范围或远程 PR/MR，并支持将审查结果导出到 GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket 或剪贴板。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、安装脚本、演示 GIF 和文档。核心功能包括行级/范围级注释、审查进度跟踪（跨会话持久化）、多种导出方式，以及自更新命令。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 git、jj 和 mercurial 进行版本控制交互。通过 crates.io 分发，支持多种安装方式（curl、brew、pacman、cargo 等）。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1725 星，总星数达 2883，进入 GitHub 趋势榜（Rust）第 21 名。它填补了终端代码审查工具的空缺，结合 vim 键位和跨平台导出，受到开发者欢迎。
uses: 喜欢在终端工作且依赖 vim 键位的开发者，可高效进行代码审查。
需要审查远程 PR/MR 并直接推送评论到 GitHub、GitLab 或 Bitbucket 的团队。
希望将审查结果导出为 Markdown 或管道输出以集成到自动化流程的用户。

en.tag: A terminal code review TUI with vim keybindings and multi-platform export
en.what: tuicr is a terminal-based code review tool that provides a GitHub-style continuous diff view with vim keybindings. It can review uncommitted changes, commit ranges, or remote PRs/MRs, and export reviews to GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or clipboard.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, install scripts, a demo GIF, and documentation. Key features include line/range comments, review progress tracking (persisted across sessions), multiple export options, and a self-update command.
en.stack: Written in Rust, it interacts with git, jj, and mercurial for version control. Distributed via crates.io, with multiple installation methods (curl, brew, pacman, cargo, etc.).
en.hot: With 1,725 new stars this month and 2,883 total, it ranks #21 on GitHub Trending (Rust). It fills a gap in terminal code review tools, combining vim keybindings and cross-platform export, gaining popularity among developers.
uses: Developers who prefer terminal workflows and vim keybindings for efficient code review.
Teams that need to review remote PRs/MRs and push comments directly to GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
Users who want to export review results as Markdown or pipe to stdout for automation.

zh.tag: DeepSeek 原生终端 AI 编程代理，专注前缀缓存稳定性
zh.what: DeepSeek-Reasonix 是一款面向终端的 AI 编程代理，深度集成 DeepSeek 模型，通过保持前缀缓存稳定来降低推理成本并提升响应速度。它可常驻运行，持续辅助开发者完成编码任务。

zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，通过 npm 分发（reasonix 包），支持扩展和 ACP 协议，集成 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 凭借 DeepSeek 原生优化和前缀缓存稳定性，在 GitHub 月榜 Go 类排名第 9，star 数达 3.5 万，月增 8020，深受开发者青睐。
uses: 终端重度用户：希望在命令行中直接获得 AI 编程辅助，无需切换 IDE。
DeepSeek 用户：利用 DeepSeek 模型的高效推理，降低 API 成本。
自动化工作流：需要常驻运行的 AI 代理，持续处理编码任务。

en.tag: DeepSeek-native terminal AI coding agent engineered for prefix-cache stability
en.what: DeepSeek-Reasonix is a terminal-based AI coding agent deeply integrated with DeepSeek models. It leverages prefix-cache stability to reduce inference costs and improve response times, and is designed to run persistently to assist developers with coding tasks.
en.content: The repo includes the Go-based core agent, npm package releases, CI workflows, extension mechanism, ACP protocol support, comprehensive docs (guide, extensions, spec), and multilingual README.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, distributed via npm (reasonix package), supports extensions and ACP protocol, with GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: With DeepSeek-native optimization and prefix-cache stability, it ranks #9 in Go on GitHub's monthly trending, amassing 35k stars with 8k added this month, gaining strong developer traction.

DeepSeek users leveraging efficient inference to reduce API costs.
Automation workflows requiring a persistent AI agent to handle coding tasks continuously.

zh.tag: AI 工程化开源控制平面，编排跨工具工作流
zh.what: SuperPlane 是一个面向 AI 驱动工程的开源自动化引擎，用于编排跨 Git、LLM、CI/CD、可观测性等工具的工作流。它提供持久执行、审批和操作 UI，确保人类与 AI 安全地交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎（Go 编写）、命令行工具、文档和示例。核心概念包括应用（Apps）、画布（Canvases）、组件（Components）和事件驱动编排，支持自托管或使用云服务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，依赖 Git、Docker 等，支持与 CI/CD、可观测性、事件响应等工具集成。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1444 星，位列 Go 趋势榜第 3，因其为 AI 代理提供安全护栏和持久执行，解决工程自动化痛点。
uses: 平台工程团队：统一编排跨工具链的自动化流程，增强 AI 代理的安全性。
DevOps 工程师：将复杂运维任务转化为可审批、可审计的工作流。
AI 应用开发者：为代理添加人工审批和策略检查，确保可控执行。

en.tag: Open-source control plane for agentic engineering, orchestrating workflows across your stack
en.what: SuperPlane is an open-source automation engine for AI-driven engineering, orchestrating workflows across tools like Git, LLMs, CI/CD, observability, and more. It provides durable execution, approvals, and an operational UI to ensure safe human-AI interaction.
en.content: The repository contains the core engine (written in Go), CLI, documentation, and examples. Key concepts include Apps, Canvases, Components, and event-driven orchestration, with options for self-hosting or using the cloud service.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with dependencies on Git, Docker, and integrations with CI/CD, observability, incident tools, etc.
en.hot: Gained 1,444 stars this month, ranking #3 on the Go trending list, as it provides guardrails and durable execution for AI agents, addressing pain points in engineering automation.
uses: Platform engineering teams: unify automation across toolchains with enhanced AI agent safety.
DevOps engineers: turn complex ops tasks into approvable, auditable workflows.
AI app developers: add human approvals and policy checks to agents for controlled execution.

zh.tag: GitHub 官方命令行工具，将 PR、Issue 等带到终端
zh.what: gh 是 GitHub 官方推出的命令行工具，让你在终端中直接管理仓库、PR、Issue、Actions 等。它与 git 无缝协作，支持 GitHub.com、GitHub Enterprise Cloud 和 Server。
zh.content: 仓库包含 gh 的完整源码、安装脚本、文档以及用于编码代理的 Agent skill。支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 多种安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 git 和 GitHub API。

编码代理 —— 通过 Agent skill 让 AI 代理直接调用 gh 命令

en.tag: GitHub's official CLI, bringing PRs, issues, and more to your terminal
en.what: gh is GitHub's official command-line tool that lets you manage repositories, pull requests, issues, Actions, and more directly from your terminal. It works seamlessly with git and supports GitHub.com, GitHub Enterprise Cloud, and Server.
en.content: The repo contains the full source code, installation scripts, documentation, and an Agent skill for coding agents. It supports multiple installation methods on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, depends on git and the GitHub API.
en.hot: As the official GitHub CLI, it has over 45k stars and is a daily essential for developers. It gained 16 stars today, showing sustained activity.
